The "Avalokitesvara Riding a Dragon" was built in 1979 (the 68th year of the Republic of China) and is located between the two towers of the Chunqiu Pavilion in Lianchitan. Its origin is due to a myth: According to legend, Guanyin Bodhisattva once appeared in the clouds riding a dragon, and instructed believers to build a statue in this form between the Chunqiu Pavilion to "compassionately save the suffering and save the lost."

### 🏯 **Architectural Features**

- **Giant Dragon Statue**:
The total length is 25.7 feet (about 78 meters) and the height is 3.6 feet (about 11 meters). The dragon's body is winding like flying in the clouds. Guanyin holds a pure bottle and stands on the dragon's back. On both sides stand Shancai Tongzi and Longnu.

- **Secret Realm in the Dragon's Belly**:
The dragon's mouth is the entrance, and there are 108 steps in the belly. The wall is painted with reliefs of Guanyin's 32 incarnations and 18 Arhats. The exit at the end of the tunnel faces Wuli Pavilion, forming a worship route of "entering the dragon's throat and exiting the fairyland".

### ⚡️ **Cultural anecdotes**

1. **Controversy over the origin of the appearance of the God**:
During the August 7 flood in Taiwan in 1959, the image of "Dragon-riding Guanyin Appearing" was circulated among the people. It was later confirmed to be a remake of the 19th-century Japanese painter Harada Naojiro's oil painting "Dragon-riding Guanyin". In 1984, the color version copied by Taiwanese painter Cai Zhongxun became more widely circulated.

2. **The mystery of Feng Shui balance**:
It is said that because the imperial palace (Yuan Emperor Temple) in the southeast of Lianchi Lake was too majestic, the Spring and Autumn Pavilion was eclipsed by it. Believers then built a dragon-riding statue to balance the Feng Shui and enhance the visual impact of the religious landmark.

### 🌿 **Current situation and experience**

Open to the public for free, under the night lights, the dragon's body and the reflection of the lake are like a dream. Combining the lotus scenery of Wuliting and the palace outline of Chunqiu Pavilion, it has become a "mythological scene" that must be visited in Lianchi Lake.

Located between the Spring and Autumn Pavilions (Spring Pavilion and Autumn Pavilion), on the Half Moon Pond, it presents a spectacular image of Guanyin Bodhisattva riding on a dragon. It is said that Guanyin once "appeared on a dragon" in the clouds and instructed believers to erect a statue based on the appearance. Therefore, this statue was built to show the meaning of compassion and salvation.

reviews.text:
I stayed at a hotel near Tainan train station for a short trip. The location is convenient, with a bus stop right outside and proximity to public transport. The price was low, but the overall experience was far from ideal.

Upon arrival, I noticed a cockroach in my room. I reported the issue, and staff promised deep cleaning. However, when I returned, the problem remained. When I raised concerns again, the manager offered a room change to a higher floor but refused to guarantee a pest-free environment. A staff member eventually climbed a ladder to catch one roach with a tissue. They cited that finding roaches on the ceiling was not normal and they mostly were found on the floor.

Amenities & Features:

The hotel advertised a "great view" on Agoda, but the only view was of bare walls and a thin frosted glass window which has a view of a corridor. The building lacks soundproofing, leading to disturbances from other guests during the night. Toilet paper is not allowed to be flushed down the toilet. Instead, guests are expected to use an open bin next to the bowl. There was no bidet either. The Wi-Fi connection was unreliable.

Facilities & Safety:

The hotel’s luggage storage area is in an open room and we were told to walk in ourselves to collect the luggage unsupervised. Additionally, anyone can walk into the lobby and access any floor without a keycard. The only microwave and vending machines in the lobby seems to require staff supervision to use.

Service & Reviews:

The service was inconsistent. While we were not explicitly told to leave 5-star reviews for free gifts, past reviews have described it. The manager's response to our complaints were dismissive and lacked genuine concern for our comfort.

Conclusion:

The experience was far from satisfactory. I would not recommend staying here unless absolutely necessary. While the area is accessible, the hygiene concerns, outdated amenities, and unhelpful service have ruined my trip and I will not be staying here any longer than I have to.

reviews.text: 5 stars to all the staff in this hotel: from the front desk to restaurant crew to the cleaning crew.  Everyone was delightful and courteous.  The room is well designed and spacious (given we booked a room big enough for 4).  Their breakfast buffet has a decent variety too.  Walking distance from the main station.

The hotel styles itself as five star accommodation, but three star may be more fitting.

The hotel features pleasant rooms with plenty of space, modern features and good amenities. The hotel also features a cafe/restaurant, but no bar. There are no bottles of water to the rooms, but there is a water dispenser on each floor.

Located very close to the station, but a reasonable walk away from many of the main attractions of Tainan. There are convenience stores, an ATM and several bars and restaurants within a five minute walk.

Staff were generally polite but overcomplicated check-in and subsequent dealings. During check-in, there were times when the receptionist would simply go quiet and stand smiling awkwardly; it fell to us to ask if there was anything else (there was, it turned out). No information about the hotel was given during check-in (locations of facilities, opening times, check-out time, etc) but left to us to consciously ask about.

We had a terrible experience at this hotel in May 2025. The facilities are lovely, but the service we received from the front desk service staff was appalling.

We accidentally double booked with two booking platforms (Agoda and Booking.com) and thought we'd cancelled the Agoda booking before we arrived in Tainan. On arrival, we were told we had still two bookings and a male assistant manager named Jayden Cai said that they would assist us to cancel the Agoda booking. The following day, no one contacted us and when we followed up at the front desk in the evening, we were informed that there was nothing the hotel could do to assist us with a refund from Agoda. This was a lie, as Agoda advised was that the hotel could authorise Agoda to cancel the booking and issue a refund. After a lot of pushing at the hotel, we managed to get half the booking fee back the following day, but then the situation got worse.

We had made two international calls from our hotel room to our bank (approximately one hour in total), to clarify the double booking issue as the hotel were so unhelpful. The hotel charged us NT$4,200 for these calls which was extremely expensive. However, there were no notices or visible rate information regarding international call charges inside the room before we used the phone. Only after we complained did the hotel write a line in their online 'precautions'  information page to say that enquiries regarding external call charges should be referred to the front desk. I have photo evidence of the before and after information sheets. After a further complaint, a customer service manager, Mina Wu, agreed to refund the second half of the Agoda booking, but we would still have to pay the phone charge, with a small discount.

When we checked out, the Agoda refund still hadn't come through, so we had to call Agoda to request that it be processed on the spot. We were treated with disdain by the hotel staff at the front desk, which made the whole experience very stressful and uncomfortable.

I do not recommend this hotel. The entire situation could have been avoided had the hotel authorised Agoda to issue a refund when we arrived, as they were able to do this. Instead, the staff were obstructive and dishonest about the refund and changing the room information about the telephone charges. It gave us an uncomfortable experience, very poor impression of the hotel and completely ruined our holiday in Tainan.

Expecting a comfortable experience, but we ended up incredibly disappointed. Aside from the excellent service from the concierge team, every other part of our stay fell short.

Check-in
The check-in process was unorganized and lacked clarity. The staff member assisting us didn’t provide basic information about our stay. We had to ask for everything ourselves, and even then, her responses felt unsure and lacked confidence. While she was friendly, she clearly needs to improve her knowledge and be more proactive in sharing essential details with guests.

Concierge
The best part of our stay was the concierge service. The employee working the evenings of June 11 and 12 was friendly, professional, and helpful. He gave us useful information about the hotel facilities and even escorted us to the elevator. Another staff member working with him on June 12 was also great. Although we didn’t experience other concierge services, both of them stood out and deserve recognition for their excellent service. Overall, the concierge team was consistently excellent throughout our stay.

Lobby restaurant
Our experience with the lobby restaurant staff was quite the opposite. On the mornings of June 12 and 13, a female employee with a ponytail and straight bangs was noticeably rude and unfriendly. On the first day, she was stationed at the entrance checking in guests. On the second, she was clearing plates. Her attitude made us feel uncomfortable, like she didn’t want to be there at all. It’s disappointing to be treated this way when you’re simply trying to enjoy breakfast. If staff aren’t willing to engage with guests professionally, they shouldn’t be on the floor.

Front desk
The front desk team needs the most improvement. Although they were overall friendly, it felt like they were either quite new or simply not motivated to improve their service. In addition to the underwhelming check-in, we approached the front desk on the evening of June 12 and the morning of June 14 to confirm some details, but the staff seemed unsure, unengaged, and unable to provide clear or accurate answers.

Room condition and amenities
While we understand the hotel promotes environmental sustainability, the lack of bottled water was inconvenient. Each floor only has one water dispenser, which isn’t ideal when you’re in a rush or just need a quick refill. The room door was also extremely heavy and shut very quickly, which actually hurt our hands when we weren’t expecting it, guests should be warned. In one of the rooms, we also noticed mold around the air conditioning vent, which was both unpleasant and unacceptable.

Breakfast
We booked a 4-night stay with breakfast included daily, but the food never changed. The variety was limited and the overall taste was just average. By the second day, it already felt repetitive and unexciting. Even the simplest egg dishes we tried, sunny side up, omelet, and eggs benedict were poorly cooked.

Laundry
We used the self-service laundry every day. Each time, we registered at the counter as required. We had used the facility more than 6 times during our stay and not once did we go past the stated closing time. We always finished and collected our laundry well before 10pm. Despite this, every time we showed up around 9pm, the staff would repeat the same warning that they close at 10pm and made us feel like we were causing a problem. It became increasingly frustrating. If staff want to leave early, then the hotel shouldn’t advertise the laundry as open until 10pm.

The hotel is rated as a 4-star property but promotes itself as 5-star. Aside from the concierge team, the service felt more like what you’d expect from a 2 or 3-star hotel. Even the breakfast, which we had enjoyed during our last visit, was a disappointment this time in both quality and variety.

Based on how things are, it doesn’t seem like the hotel takes feedback seriously. I’m sharing this so other guests can consider these points before booking.

Nice

We didn't stay in the Japanese house because they said there was an internal error and we booked a double room. They moved us to a four-person room in the Xiaobei Monthly Rental House and said it was not far away by car in ten minutes and let us use two motorcycles for free for two days.
Not to mention the trip was messed up, the Xiaobei Monthly Rental House cannot be called a B&B, and the level is very different. The prepared towels are dirty and you have to go to the first floor to get the self-service supplies. The soundproofing is so bad that you can hear the snoring in the opposite room at night. The floor shakes when you walk on it and is connected to the wardrobe rack. Replacing it with a new one is worthy of praise, but to be honest, I came here to stay in a B&B, not to use water and electricity. This room is not worth the price. reviews.text:
Unbeatable Value at Quiet Hostel Minquan
Quiet Hostel Minquan stands out as one of the best-value hostels I've found anywhere in Taiwan. At just 400 TWD a night, and an even better 360 TWD for the second and third nights, it’s an incredible deal that doesn’t compromise on quality.
What truly sets this place apart is the immaculate cleanliness. Everything, from the common areas to the dorms, is super clean, a rare find for hostels at this price point. The attention to detail is remarkable.
The owner and staff were incredibly generous. I was treated to free fresh fruit like dragon fruit, pineapple, and kiwi, which was a lovely and unexpected bonus. They also provided a free small towel, something many other hostels charge for. This level of hospitality makes you feel genuinely welcome. Quiet Hostel Minquan is a true hidden gem for budget travelers seeking a clean, friendly, and exceptional stay in Taiwan.

I would like to put more stars if I could. This hostel is one of the best managed hostel I have every stayed in my life. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming. The common room at the entrance is very convenient for meeting other travellers, at the same time it is incredibly convenient for getting some work done on a laptop. The hostel is incredibly clean, I had the impression there is always staff cleaning something. I initially booked for a few days but extended my stay because it was very nice. Also there is very good local ginger beef soup down the street at the roundabout.

I ended up staying here for multiple weeks, and it was a fantastic stay! There are busy periods and quiet periods, but the environment was great throughout, and a mix of local and foreign visitors. The owners/workers are lovely, very friendly and helpful, and always offered little plates/bowls of (delicious) prepared fruit! There are plugs by the beds and in the ground floor common area, Wi-Fi was good and consistent, and many other things about the place were very positive. I would highly recommend this hostel.

When I checked in, I asked for the free towel which is advertised, however, it was just a tiny one. It’s way to small for an adult and for taking a shower. I asked several times at the front desk but they didn’t understand or didn’t want to understand me, they just gave me a second tiny towel. I translated using google translate but they laughed at me. I didn’t feel welcome and I would not come here again.

I had a really rough first night here due to the worst snoring person, that has no right to be staying in dorms. Nobody got sleep that night because of him.
The following day I begged to move to another room because of this, and the manager was quite helpful, which I am hugely grateful for.
The manager is friendly, and gives free fruit and dumplings or cakes daily to guests.
The common room is quite clean and functional.
The first room I was in was kind-of tight and not super comfortable, but the second room was a bit more open.

The pods could be cleaned a little better as there was a used tissue in mine, and the walls were kinda gross in both rooms I occupied, though the bedding is clean and comfortable.

Downside, I tried to do laundry... The sign says 10ntd per load for any load, which I found out to be untrue. After my load had stopped halfway through the rinse cycle, I finished washing my clothes in the sink because I thought the machine was faulty until the girl staff said it's 10 per 16 mins... So you might need 20 or 30ntd for a load.
The clothes drying area was outdoors so despite drying for two nights, my clothes were still wet when I left.

reviews.text:
Nice hotel. The location was great, the staff is very kind and helpful. However it seems like they put more attention on the lobby design rather than ensuring the rooms are well maintained. Our room felt pretty old and not very clean.

They "upgraded" us to what they said room with a view, but what we actually got is a greenhouse. The room was so hot and the AC almost couldn't handle the cooling even when the curtains are closed. So the room was hot, dark, and not very clean..

It was just amazing. We got a really good deal and got upgraded to a 4 people room for free. The staff were super friendly and helpful. The bed was comfy and soft. Theres TV with MOD.   Shower with nice water pressure. Shampoo and body wash was provided and smell good. Theres bathtub but we didn’t use it. I love the the sink is separate from the bathroom. It’s so practical and convenient! The nicest thing was on the second floor they provided free snacks, coffee, soft drinks and projector with big screen to watch matches like badminton. The location was so good. Theres YouBike, bus, and spots with short distance to walk to. Only thing we think can improve was it wasn’t very soundproof. We can hear people from other rooms. But overall we had a great experience and definitely highly recommend it!

Pros: Common area with free cookies and drinks, some staff can communicate in English, good location
Cons: No room cleaning every day, no laundry provided (need to walk 5 min), poor soundproofing — can hear the next room doing work very hard and speaking loudly throughout the day.

This is one of the best hotel (among 5) that I stayed during my solo travel at Tainan.

There’s a very welcoming atmosphere the moment you are at the entrance to the interior of the hotel. I was attended to by Neol at the front desk. He demonstrated great hospitality in serving me throughout my stay and provided me with some great recommendations on what to explore around Tainan.

The room come with a bathtub and its well cleaned without any visible dust. Good job to the housekeeping of the hotel.

There’s a level 2 lounge that serve coffee, tea, drinks and snacks with board games. It make for a good hotel if you are coming here with your friends.

I would return to Finders Hotel the next time I visit Taiwan..
Staff was accomodating and friendly. They even gave me a free upgrade! Rooms were neat and clean! Can't recommend this hotel enough, will definitely be staying here the next time I come to Tainan

reviews.text: I had an extremely comfortable stay here for a few nights. The rooms were clean and well furnished, and the service was friendly. The price was great and the location very convenient to the train station. I would definitely return!

We have been like a regular customer and have stayed at this hotel a lot of times with my family already in the past this place was very very good.
The food,the service,the cleanliness,but…it fell off hard. Recently when I visited this hotel I found out that the breakfast standards dropped so much,it was still edible but…it wasn’t as good u know? I’m also about to say something that might make you guys freak out and not want to stay here, there was a glass shard on the floor. It wasn’t big but I stepped on it and my leg hurt,maybe the staff didn’t vacuum the floor thoroughly but I’m just saying that a child might get hurt, so…and room even didn’t provide toilet paper roll. Anyways ,the whole room is a square bro,other hotel are like rectangle and shit but this room is a square which make it so claustrophobic! Anyway on to the good part, The hair dryer was so nice! It wasn’t very hot like your scalp was burning when you used it. And as you might know,there are earthquakes and so electricity might be cut off and they provided a literal torchlight!
First time! Like they all say safety first am I right? Another thing is that the lobby has a little book to write or draw some stuff to show that you have visited and stayed in that hotel which is so cute. Overall ,this place is quite ok.

A very cozy hotel located in an excellent location. The breakfast they provided was excellent and very worth it. Our rooms were super clean and the shower was spacious. We also especially liked the provided shampoo and body wash, they had a really nice scent.

The staff went above and beyond to accommodate us during typhoon Gaemi. We were in Hualien the day before, and because of the typhoon we were unable to commute to the hotel on that day. The hotel staff allowed us to change our dates of stay last minute free of charge and we are extremely thankful for that.

reviews.text:
The place is kinda rundown but also has an exotic charm.

My room is the single bed with shared toilet on level 2.

The security side of things are pretty nice. They would message you the code every day.

The aircon in my room is rather noisy.

They give you a jug to collect cold/hot water from lvl 1.

There's toilet and sink on both level 1 and 2. The lvl 2 toilet is simply too small. There is barely any gap between the toilet bowl and the door. That's the one thing I cant stand. I had better time using the toilet at the HSR station. During my time there, the mosquitos are also present.

I stayed there for 2 nights. During the 1st night, there were a few girls that came back around 11pm and sang, laughed, chatted loudly into the midnight. There is no people to stop them it seems.

Value for money is good for the area.
The room is clean, and the linen smells nice.
A lot of mosquitoes, but the anti-monsquito lamps work fine.
No common area, shared bathrooms are decent and clean with high water pressure in the shower. The sink is outside and behind the bathroom.
Free water and tea, and some accessories/toiletries for a small price at the self-service kiosk.
Very nice washing machine for less than 2€ with a free dryer.
In the room there is a TV with Chromecast, towels, hair dryer and AC.

1. The room was barely bigger than a queen bed. We were not big but it was very tight. If you have big luggage, make sure you don't get the room we had.
2. The sewage smell was very overpowering even with the AC on, we tried covering the drains with garbage bin and shampoo but it didn't help much
3. Overall the room needs a deep clean. Plus the paint was peeling off the wall.
I wouldn't return, not too happy with the stay.

Such a charming boutique hotel located in the colourful West Central district! I loved the eclectic interiors and all the considerate little touches in the room. I didn’t have a problem with noise as some of the other reviewers mentioned, although it is an old building with shared bathrooms so you have to be willing to forgo some luxuries. Many thanks in any case to the lovely staff, who gave me some great recommendations and helped me book my train ticket to Hualien 🫶🏻
My stay was pleasant. The room was clean and comfortable, and the check-in/check-out process was smooth thanks to the friendly staff. The location was convenient for exploring the area.

My family spent a week in this wonderful BnB. I am very lucky to be able to spend time in such a beautiful and fun place with my whole family across 3 generations.

This 5-floored-building has 5 master bedrooms which allows each family to have a very convenient yet private time together. The elevator is a great addition, so my father can access anywhere easily in his wheelchair. The roof is an outdoors paradise especially for kids for it has a big swimming pool and is wonderful in a hot day. The living area has many different games for great entertainment. The open concept design makes it easy for people preparing the foods in the kitchen, for they don't feel left out and can see what's going on in the living room and vice versa.

My favorite place is the 2nd floor, not only because it has a nice jacuzzi, but also it is big enough for everyone to watch a movie or play board games at the same time comfortably. The balcony brings the outside in and creates a calm and Zen feeling to the space.

The owner is very kind, helpful, and supportive. I appreciate his thoughtfulness and generosity. I will never forget the wonderful time and the memories we created during our stay. I hope you and your family will feel the same. :)

reviews.text:
Friendly reception staff, they are very helpful, free shuttle front the train station.  Our room is on the top floor (10th), 1001 beside the water dispenser, it has a king bed, quiet with a city view. Free laundry with detergent, washer and dryer on B1, gym is well equipped.  Hotel is well located, lots of sightseeing spots close by.

Breakfast is included but was disappointing.  We stayed here 3 nights, 2 out 3 mornings, at 8am, 75% of the hot dishes are empty and very slow to refill, most dishes are merely luke warm, even the buns inside the steamer machine. The first day, at 7am, hot dishes are full but I found a baby roach inside my congee 🤢, I did added some pork (from hot dishes) and pork floss into my congee, so the roach could have came from these instead.  Also, no in room safe, slow wifi.

I honestly did not expect much because of the budget price, but the hotel is really, really good, including the location, the breakfast, and the amenities. I think the main selling point of the hotel is its location, there are just too many things to see at walking distance. And Tainan's transportation is one of the best I've experienced, it's so easy to get around. Although the room is quite small, I only slept in it because I was away most of the day. I will stay here again if I visit Tainan.

Prime location in the West-Central district around the corner from the Confucius temple and steps away from the new Tainan Art Museum, with the train station and Hai'an street both 15-20 minutes away on foot. The staff is friendly and helpful. Rooms were comfortable and spacious; the shower had very hot water and good water pressure. Breakfast options were plentiful and different each of the 9 nights we stayed there. My only complaint would be that the wifi was slower than I'd expected, but it wouldn't keep me from staying here again.

I booked through Agoda, and when I arrived, they upgraded me to a new room (most likely due to school holidays, so flooded by families).

I was surprised by the hotel service, I requested some ice for my husband's injury, and they sent it within 5 mins!

We used their free washing machine service together with the dryer, and it just happened to be our mid point before moving south, so we're happy to get clean clothes!

It was just opposite Hayashi, and we get to rest in between visiting Confucius temple and Chikan Tower (since he injured his foot).

I slept through the night and woke up realising they provided fruits too.

All in all, great service, very affordable price, will definitely book again!
Nice room, great breakfast and lovely staff. Would definitely stay again

reviews.text: A comfortable stay. It seemed a bit dated on first arrival (old fashioned lift/elevator and a key for the room) but the room looked recently renovated and had everything I needed. The breakfast is very good with a wide range of choice. The pillows, though, are very firm!

Despite its age and reliance on keys for room access, Hotel Tainan maintains a high level of cleanliness and upkeep. Staff are exceptional. Conveniently located as it is within a short walking distance from Tainan Railway Station, providing easy access to the city’s transportation.

Hotel Tainan is well located, iconic and has a retro yet personal feel. Rooms are clean with excellent and polite services from staff. I am especially impressed by their attention to details. Restaurants are good with an unexpected delicious international buffet spread. A very happy value for money stay. 👍❤️

DO NOT BOOK – Unprofessional and Possibly a Scam

I had an extremely disappointing and stressful experience with Tainan Hotel. I booked my stay months in advance and had been in regular communication with the hotel via WhatsApp the entire time. Everything seemed confirmed and in order—until just 5 days before my arrival, they cancelled my booking without informing me.

To make things worse, they attempted to charge my credit card before my check-in date and asked me to pay in advance months ago, which is against Booking.com policies. I only found out my reservation had been canceled because I checked myself. No email, no message, no explanation.

I immediately contacted Booking.com, who confirmed that the hotel was in clear violation of their policies and that the situation was mishandled on the hotel's end.

Now, I'm left without accommodation days before arriving in Vietnam during peak tourist season, with flights already booked. Finding a last-minute room during this busy time is not only difficult but also far more expensive.

This kind of behavior is completely unprofessional and unacceptable. It shows a lack of integrity, accountability, and basic customer service.

Avoid Tainan Hotel at all costs. They are not reliable, and based on my experience, they may be running a scam. Don’t risk ruining your travel plans.
It’s a clean budget hotel with an included  breakfast buffet and evening snack. Don’t expect anything luxurious there is a Starbucks in the lobby. The staff is extremely polite and helpful.

reviews.text: At this price point, it has to be one of the absolute worst Hotels I have ever been at. The hotel is apparently a little older, which is not a bad thing, but the Shangri La is just worn down badly. Everything looks old, from the rooms to the pool area. And the rooms are just disgusting. We had to change rooms twice because both rooms smelled extremely moldy. The third room didn’t smell moldy, but after the initial chemical smell disappeared, the room started to smell like an old dirty bar. Matching this smell, the bathroom now started smelling like someone smoked in there. Don’t get me wrong, the staff is super friendly and they try their best, but they can’t magically change a rotten hotel that only people without the sense of smell can safely stay at. We got two more nights to go and seriously think about leaving early. If we could get our money back, we would leave as soon as possible. Calling this a five star hotel got to be some kind of prank. Do yourself a favor, go somewhere else!

This Shangri-la was a pleasant surprise to me, location is ideal, fantastic service and good attention to details. The restaurant staff were kind and concerned about me as an Indian on the kind of meat offered, food choices and any allergies to food types.
The rooms that I got had a fantastic view, and the room service and house keeping is excellent.
One can exchange currency at the reception desk and cabs are available just outside of the hotel which makes it convenient to visit any given location. The local train station is bang next door and a shopping mall within the vicinity.
As this hotel is situated around the local university, there are many local eateries that offer lots of different cuisine choices.

Had a wonderful stay here! The hospitality was warm and welcoming, making the entire experience comfortable and pleasant. The café was definitely a highlight — especially the India counter run by Chef Akki. The food was delicious, and the service was excellent.

A special mention to Dora, Amber, Naomi, and Yan from the Horizon Club — their hospitality and service were truly fantastic. They were always attentive, friendly, and made every interaction feel personal and genuine.

Overall, it was a lovely stay filled with good vibes, great food, and amazing people. Highly recommended!

Consistently Excellent: The Gold Standard of Hospitality (Diamond Member for Life!)

Shangri-La Tainan is truly my preferred residence when traveling. I've stayed here for more than 100 nights now, and the experience never falters.

As a Diamond member (achieved after 50 nights), I especially appreciate the complimentary Horizon Club Lounge access, which elevates every stay and makes the property a genuine urban sanctuary.

The team effortlessly creates a serene, dream-like atmosphere that makes you forget the world outside—they truly embody the essence of the "Shangri-La" name. This attention to detail extends to personal touches, like the lovely mocktail and cake they served me today to celebrate the Moon Festival in Taiwan.

A special shout-out to Miss. Dora Amber in the Horizon Club today, October 6, for her outstanding service and genuine care. She is a true asset!

From the warm welcome to the luxurious rooms, everything is handled with genuine care and professionalism. My loyalty speaks for itself; if there's a Shangri-La nearby, I'm booking it! A flawless experience, every single time.

Daniel makes excellent drinks during happy hour! This evening he made shadow of flower cocktails and they were spectacular! Naomi was our waitress and she was very attentive and her service was exceptional! The rest of the team Penny, Yan, and Amber worked great as a team to care for every guest. Thank you!

reviews.text:
Great hostel. Common area is spacious and well equipped with free flow coffee and tea for guests. They even have 4 different coffee beans to choose from. Bed is comfortable and have sufficient toilets and showers.
The common area could use more electric outlets near the tables.
Hotel is close to many delicious restaurants.

We stayed in the hotel rooms here and absolutely loved it! This place is super stylish with comfortable rooms and gorgeous products.
The breakout space, which also services the hostel, is fantastic - a relaxed ambience with sparkling water on tap, kitchen facilities and well curated music. Would certainly recommend.

The perfect hostel for the executive backpacker or for extended stay. The hotel itself would probably be 4-star rated by the international standard, except that UIJ doesn't have the extra amenities such as a swimming pool or room service. Aside from that, the facility itself is top notch.

An entire floor is devoted as a common area, with a full kitchen and expansive terrace. There are plenty of tables for eating or working on your computer, a couple of coffee tables and a relaxing tatami area, where one can nap.

Out on the terrace, are multiple secluded areas where small parties can gather, or for someone to enjoy a romantic evening.

The kitchen facility is fully equipped, except that it doesn't have  a smoke vent. There are multiple water dispensers and even a sparkling water machine. Free coffee beans are available, along with an electric grinder, where one can brew the perfect cup.

There is also a  bar with snack service, by the spiral staircase if one wants a beer.

The dorm rooms are also spacious and well equipped.  The mattress is comfortable and the overall design of the sleeping quarters is well designed. The ventilation was excellent.

All in all, this is a five-star facility and a huge upgrade from the typical backpacker, budget hostel. As such I have encountered other vacationers or digital nomads here, however none of the usual backpackers I encounter out on the trail. Let's call it the business grade hostel for the executive backpacker.

This is a very nice hotel. Having a coffee shop on the ground floor is great, as is the common area on the third floor (though the music choices there are... not relaxing). The location is fantastic. The rooms are very well-equipped and the staff is friendly.

Unfortunately, the walls are thin. We could hear every door open and close on that hall. We could hear the shower of all the rooms in our proximity. We heard the phone calls and of the people in the next room, as well as them having sex. The worst night, we briefly moved rooms at 2am because of noise. Again, the staff was awesome, so they quickly fixed the problem, but it's a problem that shouldn't exist at this price.

If you value your sleep and don't want to wear earplugs, I can't recommend this hotel.

Smaller note - if you go on their website, the deluxe room says that it includes breakfast. We booked a deluxe room then were surprised to learn when we arrived that we didn't get breakfast. There's a second option when booking you have to check for it which we didn't notice.

First time experience of taiwan hostel, the room and the setting, interior design, all very comfortable and classic. All the staff were really nice and helping, I left my hair soap in the room asked the staff checked for me, they checked twice per my request and finally found it, without being any impatient. But the reason I left a not very positive rating Is because what happened when we came back to pick up our luggage after we checked out early in the morning. There was a very long queue of people who just arrived waiting for check in. There were 3 staff at the counter. I approach the one near the elevator, a female staff with short hair, waited for her to finish the guest so I can hand in our luggage card, instead of asking us to wait aside and assign another staff to help us, she asked us to wait at the end of the line with all the other new Visitors. I then further explained that we just pick up luggage not check in, she insist that we need line up at the end. I was really disappointed and I find this is very unreasonable. I would understand that we need to wait until next available staff can help us or we might need wait long if there is only one staff. Otherwise, picking up luggage is very different from counter checkin. Clients picking up luggage most time means they will head of to station or airport, a bit more understanding and better arrangement will be really helpful as well as under professional customer service. We ended up waited half an hour till all the visitors finished the check-in. More ironically, when we were about to leave, I saw a different staff helped another lady to get her luggage while other staff were servicing the check-in of new visitors. I don't understand what is this staff's issue with us,but I felt very differentiated service. Very disappointing. Staff should be trained not only following the policies also show genuine care and understanding of customers when they need some help.

reviews.text: This hotel is great! Wonderful rooms and service personnel. The morning buffet breakfast was delicious and fresh. Only drawback is it is a bit annoying to access via public transport, only having one bus line get close.

Room is comfortable. As most hotels in Taiwan do not provide combs,
toothbrushes, shavers, etc anymore, so best to bring your own if you do not have to habit to bring these. Free beverages in the room and there is laundry service with coins. Two washers and two dryers. There's swimming pool as well. Breakfast is OK.

We booked the hotel because it was right next to the museum. The front desk was friendly and we really enjoyed the afternoon snacks. I forgot to bring my swimsuit so I didn’t get to use the pool. Breakfast was decent. I really liked my room because it was clean and big compared with other hotels. It had 2 beds with a couch living room setting. I also had great views for my room.  I am happy for my stay with the just sleep hotel.
A very nice hotel! Room is spacious and comfortable. It’s not in the city, better to drive there with your own car.

Excellent hotel- new, clean, lots of places to lounge indoors and outdoors to relax.  We had the bunk bed glamping  theme room, which was a neat experience.  The room also has a big patio where you can sit and relax.  Free coffee machines and snacks.  Laundry room is very useful for travelers.  There’s also a big pool.  Overall, a comfortable and laid back hotel.

Breakfast is buffet only.  Would recommend to let guests also order a la carte.

Location was tough. Although next to attractions (Chi Mei Museum, Ten Drums theme park) there’s no restaurants or convenience stores to walk to.

reviews.text: They do not change bed sheets or towels daily, only provide one towel per person and they charge extra for almost everything, even drinking water, claiming it’s for environmental reasons… The location is fine, about a 15-minute walk from the train station. The room size and bathroom were okay, and the water pressure was good. The room and towels were clean, and they at least provided free soap. Overall, it’s a mid-level hotel, but it is definitely overpriced.

No provide room cleaning if stay more than a day. We are staying for 4 days 3 nights. Hotel inform us no provide change towel as well. However, the cleaning service change on our last day inform they change the policy and able to provide change towel on our last day. Window full of dust & dirty.

Roaders Hotel is an excellent choice in Tainan, offering incredible value for its price!

What I especially appreciated was the inviting 2nd-floor lounge, which served as both a comfortable open workspace and a convenient snack bar. It truly made me feel at home rather than just living out of a hotel room. The hotel also boasts stable Wi-Fi, strong water pressure, and a comfortable bed. Furthermore, the staff were consistently helpful and professional.

While the lack of daily room cleaning and towel changes for multi-day stays might concern some, it honestly didn't bother me. In fact, I appreciated the hotel's approach to resource management for a budget stay, including the option of using my own toiletries, which aligns with environmental consciousness. Overall, I highly recommend Roaders Hotel and would definitely book again on my next visit.

Greetings from Hanoi! 🇻🇳

This hotel is fantastic! The rooms are spacious, the beds are comfortable, and the facilities are top-notch. The rooms are exceptionally clean, making it a cozy and comfortable place to stay. The value for money is great, but the only downside is the location. The surrounding area is not particularly interesting or exciting.
Highly recommend to stay here if visiting Tainan!

The strong smell of cleaning detergent and sewage made it impossible to sleep. I couldn’t sleep the entire night. If you’re considering staying here, think twice.

Although the staff genuinely tried to help by showing us other rooms, the strong unpleasant odor was present in all of them. Unfortunately, there was nothing they could do about it.

Arriving at the hotel, it initially made a pretty good impression, which is to be expected for this price per night.
The receptionist was also friendly.
Once we got our room key, we started to find our room. Our room number wasn't listed on any of the signs, so we felt like we had to walk all the way up the floor until we finally found it in the last corner.
Then, in the room, we were shocked: a huge room without any furniture and only one bed. The bathroom looked more like a butcher's shop than a bathroom. Apparently, there used to be a sauna in the bathroom, but it's no longer in use, and all that's left is the door with holes through which you can see into the brickwork or somewhere else.
The toilet looked like it had never been cleaned; there were still piss stains on the rim, and it was generally just barely clean.
After a brief complaint, we were given a new room, smaller and a bit more modern, except for the bathroom. The mirror and sink were dirty, there was hair on the toilet rim, and the bathtub wasn't exactly clean either.
Overall, the hotel isn't worth the money and is very dated.
The only good thing is the location near the train station, but nothing more.
Once and never again, this is the worst hotel we've stayed in on our travels. I don't know where the good reviews come from.

The hotel is very conveniently located directly across from the train station. Overall, it's a good value, with a double room (no window view) for under NT$900 a night on Friday. Minor drawbacks include a slight odor of cigarette smoke upon entering the room, and the lack of a separate wet and dry area in the bathroom. Everything else is fine.

The transportation is convenient, the room is clean, and the air conditioning temperature varies from person to person; I personally prefer it to be quite cold. The price is also quite reasonable! I'd definitely consider staying here again next time I'm in Tainan!

The service is great and the staff are wonderful. The location is nice since Mitsukoshi is right next door and they have everything you may need and then some. It makes dining easy also.

Excellent check in service, early arrival at 8:30 🕣 am and the Receptionist Ryan helped with finishing the check in process, answered all my questions with friendly smiling face and written notes of my questions. WONDERFUL service!

Waiting for the call to get into the room if any availability possible, happy to catch up with friend and attend the event first!!!

We booked this hotel for 2 nights but as soon as we both arrived we both noticed the room had a strong musty odor. But we both avoided saying anything to each other to try and make the best of the situation. But after awhile it was just unbearable and we had to call down to see if we could change our room. Max, the manager on the night shift came upstairs to assess the room condition and agreed to a change.  It was very late and we had traveled for almost an entire day so we were very exhausted. Max was very helpful and wanted to accommodate us as best as possible he must have showed me atleast 10 different room suites but they all had the same musty mold smell. I indicated to Max that all the rooms have the a/c turned off apparently to save on energy cost but if the room is unoccupied for a time it can cause for development of mold. Most high end hotels leave the rooms with a/c on constantly to avoid this problem and maintain furniture, textiles, bedding, walls from mold. We were exhausted and about to just checkout but Max knew it was late and just wanted for us to be able to rest. He showed me what looked to be the presidential suite it apparently didnt have the odor the other rooms had ( maybe because the a/c was kept on in this room or turned on in advance). The only problem was that it only had one bed but I just wanted my mother to be able to rest and I agreed to sleep on a roll-in twin size bed . Max was great he did everything possible to accommodate us but the rooms I have to say has seen better days. We decided to check out the following morning and Max had already informed Sylvia the day shift manager of the situation and we were not charged for the night. Sylvia was very helpful and had the hotel driver take us to another hotel of our choosing. I give the staff a 5 star but the rooms do not live up to a high end  establishment it claims  to be I can only give it 1 star as mold is a very serious health issue. My mother has stayed in this hotel about 2 times previous  times to this and enjoyed those stays very much and was actually looking forward to it but this time it was just disappointing.

Overall service is decent.
Especially the staff help me to take photos in front of the gate with my car. That was really a good part of this trip. All of my friends said the pic is superb.

The inner part of this hotel is luxurious when it's with designed style in dark colors. I like it. Thanks.

Booked this room for my family travel because Chilin Lin got married here haha. Glad that I chose here. Great details from pillow to mattress to face mask to snack&drinking bar. I really enjoyed staying here. Will book again if I visit Tainan again.

Awesome place to stay in the west central of Tainan. Super nice host. Large space with big window, natural sunlight and very clean. Would definitely recommend my friends to stay here when visiting Tainan. (Photo taken after two nights of stays please ignore the used towels and the mess. It’s much nicer when checked in)

Good service and very kind,nice B&B

reviews.text:
Cheap, good location. Perfectly adequate, but a few simple things could improve these rooms a lot.

1) cleanliness - rooms are superficially clean but when I looked under the bed to find a missing sock I saw A LOT of dirt including old food packaging under there

2) no shower curtain makes water go everywhere

3) the shower attachment is very low for me

These simple things could easily be improved to make this place much more comfortable.

That being said, the location is great and it’s cheap so I’d probably stay again

Cheap price, that was the main reason I choose to stay here when I was cycling around Taiwan. If you just want to have a room to shower, rest, sleep, this is the place, it's easily one of the cheapest stay in Tainan city center area. Room is spacious, kind of clean, with a bit of smoke smell.

And then, I guess this hotel is more for couples having a short "good time", if you know what I mean. Why? First of all, during my one night stay, I realized there are lot of couples going in and out. Second, the hotel front door is hanging a promotion banner about their cheap hourly rate. Third, when I first get into my room, turn on the TV, it's a adult film channel, and when I try to change channel, there are lot of drama different adult film channels that you can watch for free... So I am pretty sure my guess is correct... Hahahaha and I guess that's why it's that cheap to stay overnight, because no one stay overnight, almost everyone stay for 1, 2 hours only...

For those who mind, beware. For those who don't care, it's your place, very very cheap to get a private room.

The hotel is in a great location — it’s about a 3to5 minute walk to PX Mart and convenience stores.
The service attitude is also excellent, very friendly and welcoming. 讚讚
Rooms were cleaned than I expected and the hotel staff were super friendly, giving us recommendations for things to eat and visit in the area.
Very nice hotel with 1 free drink per day per person

reviews.text:
The B&B "Guangfa Residence" in downtown Tainan, where I stayed on this business trip, has a diverse array of businesses on the first floor: a coffee shop, a wig shop, and a bar called BAR MIU. After 9:00 PM, they offered a soft opening for a tipple, with complimentary welcome cocktails 🍹. The cocktails were sour and sweet (based on white wine with a hint of plum wine), and were delicious.

The room's furnishings are simple and understated. The two large closets resemble an ordinary bedroom. The exposed concrete walls and high-legged table lend a modern touch. The double bed 🛏️ is topped with a small round table. It's a shame the potted greenery 🪴 by the window is plastic; otherwise, a short nap in the slanting afternoon light would be so relaxing.

This B&B, which opened at the end of 2023, formerly housed a local department store. The original site was demolished and rebuilt over seven years, reflecting the owner's deep remembrance of his elders. FAAA Coffee on the first floor also serves as the B&B's check-in desk. It closes at 6:00 PM and check-in is available until 7:30 PM.

The second floor is a common area, offering drip coffee, a refrigerator, and a water dispenser. After 9:00 PM, the adjacent bar, BAR MIU, offers a welcome drink.

The surrounding area is well-equipped with amenities, and the popular dining and entertainment districts of Guohua Street and Hai'an Road are nearby. This stylish and sophisticated guesthouse is a must-see for those who enjoy an industrial feel.

I love this Tainan B&B! The location is super convenient, less than a ten-minute drive from the station and close to the Anping coastline!
Guohua Street is a one-minute walk away, making it super convenient for snacks. 😚
The first floor houses a cafe and bar, which has a great atmosphere. The overall architecture is beautiful, and the gray concrete has a very classy feel.

The B&B's housekeepers are also fantastic! They're always responsive to any questions. If you extend your stay, they'll even help with cleaning and tidying up. Although it's in a busy area, it's very quiet at night. There's a bathtub for soaking in, and Netflix is ​​available. It's simply perfect. 😍
Love it! I'll definitely be back!

As soon as we stepped through the door, we were pleasantly surprised by the rich aroma of coffee, and the entire space was filled with a warm and relaxing atmosphere. The service from the front desk staff was impeccable—friendly and attentive. They not only proactively upgraded our room but also took extra care when my girlfriend was feeling unwell and in tears. They not only patiently inquired about her condition but also quickly helped find a nearby gastroenterology clinic. These thoughtful gestures truly warmed my heart.

Furthermore, from the amenities to the hardware, every detail was exquisitely crafted, with attention to detail and a truly satisfying experience. This stay far exceeded our expectations and made us want to return to Tainan just for this hotel. Highly recommended to anyone seeking a hotel that combines quality and warmth! (It's also close to popular attractions.)

The bathroom sink was small, the hair dryer was weak, and you had to take off your shoes and change into slippers on the first floor, which was a bit inconvenient.

The decor was clean, beautiful, and simple. The elevator was a bit slow, so if there were multiple groups of guests, the wait was long. The stairwell was not air-conditioned and was quite hot and stuffy.

Check-out was at 11:00. I realized I had forgotten to bring tofu, so they rented some at the front desk. The service was excellent, and communication was conducted via Line.

The last picture shows the welcome cocktails you could redeem at the bar next door with your room card. They were white wine, plum wine, and apple juice (if I remember correctly). They were not overly alcoholic, but rather sweet.

This stay was truly wonderful!
From the hotel's amenities to the attentive service, everything was truly amazing!

A special thank you to the staff for noticing we were feeling unwell and for proactively checking in and helping us find nearby clinics. That moment of care was so heartwarming, I almost cried (; ;)
Even better, they even upgraded our room for free, making our entire trip even more perfect.
Thank you for your thoughtfulness. I'll definitely be back when I'm in Tainan!

reviews.text:
The staff is extremely helpful in giving transportation information and the rooms might not be super well furnished, but it’s very clean and comfortable.

Love how creative they package the toothpaste, brushes and etc, plus the small snacks they provided in our room and water. To save the environment, maybe next time they could provide one big ml of water bottle instead?

The body wash, my gosh! Such a wonderful experience.
The toilet, honestly is a love and hate relationship 😅. It looks like what you see in the public toilet, however, it does it’s job.. so I love it too 😅
the tissue holder, it’s installed way to the back, should be more to the front for easier access.

I asked if they could just help us throw the trashes and no need to clean the room. When we got back, not only are our trashes all cleaned, but they refilled our tissue paper, gave us another set of toothbrush, comb and etc which is very thoughtful. Sorry had take some home 😜

Walking distance from this hotel are the hang out areas and lots of restaurant options. Love to stay here again next time we visit, however, the pillow is too soft for me 😊 and the bed is quite comfortable.
I think it is above the average budget hotel
very good

The price for a four-person room on a weekday was only NT$1,300 per night. It's a steal! There are two bathrooms, one with a bathtub and one with separate wet and dry areas. There are also 2-3 different brands of toiletries available. There's also a TV. Parking is in the underground parking lot on Hai'an Road, about a 5-minute walk from the hotel. You can buy a parking coupon at the counter for NT$200, giving you 24-hour unlimited access. The hotel is also about a 5-minute walk from Guohua Street and Hai'an Road. I'd definitely stay here again next time I visit Tainan. Highly recommend!

The room and bathroom are really small, and the hygiene is really terrible. The bathroom is so small that two people can't fit in. The room was not cleaned when I first checked in, and I was only able to move to another room later. The bed was very hard to sleep on, and the air conditioner was not cold at all. It didn't feel like 24 degrees Celsius even when it was on all night. Seriously, I will never go back. This is the first time I've stayed in such a bad hotel.

reviews.text: Stayed two nights and really enjoyed it. The room was larger than average, clean, and matched the website photos. Staff were welcoming and helpful throughout. Breakfast had plenty of choice, though hot dishes could be warmer. The location is very central, close to temples and old streets, and about a 20-minute walk from the main train station. The place has laundry facility with washer & dryers as well as provided detergent for free. A few more toiletries such as hair conditioner & body lotion would make it perfect, but overall a pleasant and comfortable experience.

I changed to this hotel few days before departure due to poor review of the previous booking. No expectation but turn out to be quite a good experience. Rooms are spacious, clean and well equipped. Very friendly concierge service from Mr Chiang. Thank you so much!

This 4 star hotel is pretty decent and well maintained. The rooms are large and clean, the toilet is also spacious and clean and comes with the Japanese style toilet biget. They don't have much dining option but they have a free laundromat which is great. It comes with 4 washing machines and 4 dryers. Would be great if they have English instructions. Location wise is not the best but they have shuttle to the night market. Overall was a good stay.

Excellent hotel with updated amenities for the international traveler. They offer multiple watering dispensers including an ice machine, which is a rarity. Appreciate the courtesy clothes washer/dryer center. Rooms are spacious and include multiple outlets for charging devices. Highly recommend this hotel!
Good location. Its walking distance to Tainan Gardens night market. Room were clean and comfortable. Its a more grand hotel around this location.  Price was reasonable.  Car parking was provided.

reviews.text:
Disappointing Front Desk Experience, but Decent Stay Overall

My experience at this hotel was unfortunately overshadowed by the front desk staff, whose attitude was unprofessional and completely lacking in basic customer service. I felt unwelcome from the moment I arrived, which really set the tone for my stay.

The only highlight was the breakfast staff — they were warm, attentive, and provided excellent service, which somewhat balanced out the negative impression left by the front desk.

Great hotel. Loved the service and professionalism of the staff and the location is convenient to a lot of great places. The free breakfast morning buffet offers a variety of new foods daily. Really enjoyed our stay here and would 100% recommend.

The Hotel is excellent. Check-in was fast and the reception team was friendly. The bedroom was fantastic with modern,new fixtures and fittings. The bed and pillow were comfortable and at night it was quiet so I slept well through good room layout and sound insulation. The views from my tenth floor window were great too. The water pressure in the shower could be a touch higher and the shower head wall attachment is a bit weak,loose & not easily adjustable at the right angle (Room 809). The fridge is a bit too noisy especially at night.

The breakfast was excellent with an extensive selection including freshly prepared and cooked local dishes. The hot drinks included a range of teas and hot  soja milk. I found all the waiting staff to be friendly and polite especially Ya-Hui. We decided to extend stay for 3 nights.

The internet in the room or communal areas was fine. I also used the washing and drying machines on ground floor (F5) 50$ per machine.

The location of the Hotel is super close to all services and facilities. Overall this Hotel is really well run, has a good design layout, is well maintained and has friendly employees like Ya-Hui & reception team. It also a perfect choice for people that are mobility impaired.

Not a good experience at all. We chose the hotel because of the reviews we had read. Front desk attitude is poor and we don’t feel welcome. Bedroom is small, pillows are not comfortable and bathroom like 2 star hotel only, poor ventilation so don’t do big business in the your own toilet, given a handsoap to wash hand but you have no where to put the handsoap. And totally not looking forward the breakfast provided. Why did we pay more for that quality of services and lousy room? And we won’t come back again.

Would give this hotel 0 stars if I could. This hotel lacks many basic amenities. No hand soap in the bathroom. No lock box/safe. No slippers. No suitcase rack or any space available to open a suitcase. These are things that are supplied in all other hotels in Taiwan, even lower-tier ones. The hotel room has a basic kettle and some snacks, but no tea/coffee. Tiny bathroom with barely any counter space, and no bidet. There is mold around the bathroom sink. There is a hair dryer but it's placed in the room and not in the bathroom because there is literally no space for it there. They provide the basic necessities - bed, toilet and shower, mini-fridge...that's it.

They play music in the room hallways all day long, even in the evenings.

Extremely disappointed and will not come back again. Don't bother booking with this hotel.

reviews.text:
Wow! Definitely recommend staying here if you visit Tainan! We stayed for 4 night when we initially booked 2.

The hotel itself and our room were beautifully designed and everything was very high quality. The amenities were very modern and well-made. I loved the communal area and the self-service laundry.

We were positively surprised throughout our stay by the service and the friendly staff. When we arrived, we were too early for check-in, so we left our luggage at the front desk. The hotel had then brought it up to our room when we went out for lunch. The housekeeping was amazing, and they pay attention to every detail. Moreover, the hotel provided many free amenities such as daily bottled water, free coffee in the communal area, and a drink and snack coupon, and the self-service laundry was a big plus! The breakfast was delicious and diverse.

Conclusion: don't look any further when looking for a hotel in Tainan

What an incredible hotel. Stunning rooms and common spaces . Great breakfast. Luxury toiletries and very comfy beds. All the staff were lovely. Easy walk from the station and to lots of restaurants and bakeries

I had an amazing time chilling at the hotel. The decor had this cool Tainan fusion vibe that I really dug.

We had breakfast at the rooftop restaurant, and it was seriously impressive—five-star decor with an awesome atmosphere. The elegant chairs, lights, and wall tiles all screamed Tainan history. I loved how they set up the space.

If you stay here, breakfast is a must. The croissants were way better than I expected, and they were super generous with the all-you-can-eat beef and grilled fish.

The 8th floor is a co-living space where you can cook, make coffee, and read. It's really beautiful and spacious, with some hidden corners for quiet reading.

Parking was also super convenient.
Very well worth the price! The design is thoughtful and professional, easily the best hotel we stayed at in our Kaoshiung and Tainan trip

What a gorgeous hotel with friendly staff. Honestly one of the best hotels I’ve ever stayed in. Loved the fit out of the rooms, everything was so well thought out. Breakfast was spectacular with both Taiwanese and Western food options. Really enjoyed my stay here and will come back when I’m back in Tainan.

reviews.text: Agoda photos are quite different from the actual photos. The price is affordable and feels like Airbnb. The four-person room has two rooms and a small living room. It is very comfortable. I met Xiao Xiaoqiang as an episode.

There's no hot water at night, so I have to shower with cold water. The water is super hot during the day. Do you use solar heating? The water heater is broken, so I should replace it.

The hair dryer is clogged with dust. The wind has turned my hair white. The quilt is terrible, too. Even with a cover, you can clearly see yellow spots inside. I feel itchy before I even fall asleep.

The location is in an apartment building. Go up to the elevator and enter the door code provided. Go to the door of the room and enter the room code. It is suitable for a small trip of two days and one night with less luggage. The luggage is stored on the iron rack outside the door. It feels unsafe. It can be seen as soon as the elevator door is opened. It is not convenient for people who need luggage storage.
The room itself is spacious and comfortable, clean and bright. It also has a TV, refrigerator and clothes racks. The air-conditioning makes it feel stuffy, and the bed and pillows are very comfortable.

The room rate was very cheap, but it felt like a rental apartment.
We didn't see any legal accommodation signs, so we were a little nervous. There were no escape routes marked in the room.
We didn't receive any check-in notifications before check-in, and we didn't get the password to enter via QQ. So, a bunch of people were outside the main door, and it was crowded and hot. We urgently called the reception desk, but once inside, the door wouldn't lock. We had to randomly press buttons before the window clerk replied. It was a disappointing experience.
The room was clean and tidy, but there was a persistent, musty smell, which was a bother even with the AC on. The AC didn't cool the room very well; even at 25 degrees Celsius, it was still stuffy. Because of the room layout, the bed on the edge by the window had almost no AC, while the other bed had direct airflow.
Otherwise, since the room rate was very affordable, there wasn't much to complain about.
The soundproofing was good; we couldn't hear any noise from other rooms, but nearby planes taking off and landing were still quite noisy.

The room had a dehumidifier, so the musty smell was gone. However, the sheets were infested with dust mites, and my skin started to itch as soon as I lay in bed. The location is far from shopping areas, and there's no parking. I didn't use the disposable supplies, including cups and shoes. Compared to my stay at the Chiayi Back Station Hotel during Chinese New Year, which cost $2,600 for a room for four and included parking, the room amenities were better, there was a buffet breakfast bar, and water dispensers on each floor for refilling, I found it quite a bit worse.

reviews.text: The room is a bit small but the bathroom is clean. The receptionists are very friendly and help us with all of our questions. If you have no issue with outside noise this place is great choice.

It exceeded my expectations, and I appreciate staff's kind attention, such as calling me back to ask if I was lost. Additionally, thank you for helping us carry the luggages to the 2nd floor. The staff speak some English and are incredibly helpful and kind.

The room's name is in Chinese, so I cannot provide a review, but the decoration is in Japanese style. We are thankful for the free room upgrade.

The location is just 10 minutes walking from Tainan train station, not the High-Speed Train Tainan station. It's important to note the difference. This hotel is situated close to Tainan train station and the university campus. It is surrounded by shops, Taiwanese and Japanese dining options at affordable prices, and sports facilities like basketball courts and running lanes. It would take around 15 minutes by bus from Tainan center.

Please note that it's somewhat difficult to find on Google Maps. To locate it, you can search with the Chinese name: 慢步南國 台南故事民宿.

Lastly, the Wi-Fi signal is strong!

Booked this place at the last minute without realizing how cute it was, or that it had historically-themed rooms. We were in the 1860s room. It was clean and downright cozy, and we thought the concrete shower was especially nice. The woman who sorted us out was so helpful and kind! Definitely recommend for travelers who want a unique place to stay.

- the location is not convenient and noticeable.
- the bed is dusty and the mattress is moist.
- both the locks of the room and locker are not working.
- the staff is totally unfriendly! Claimed my misunderstanding and my fault on the “Dorm Room” instead of “A room for single person”. (And they changed the wordings after my visit)
- very limited hardwares provided. An old and semi-working washing machine. No drying machine. No towels and so on.

Will NOT recommend!!
We had to change our reservation last minute because of a typhoon and they were very accommodating. Great service!

I really don’t understand some bad reviews, I stayed 3 nights was amazing. We need to support this authentic places. I highly recommend!
Very good place, highly recommend !

The location is great, but it's hard to find in a small alley. I could never get through to the owner's phone. The housekeeper came to my rescue. There were a lot of mosquitoes. The room was small, a small Japanese-style room. There was no storage for luggage. No toiletries were provided. For this price, you can find hostels with toiletries in Taipei. By youth hostel standards, it's a very good accommodation.

There is no sound insulation at all. The door of the room is just a sliding door. The stairs are also very steep, making it inconvenient to go up and down the stairs. The ceiling beams in the room on the third floor are very low. You have to bend over all the time to walk in the room, which is inconvenient and it is easy to bump your head. The quilt is not very clean and you have to make the bed yourself. Overall, it is very poor and not recommended.

FX Hotel Tainan: Budget-Friendly and Well-Located

If you're looking for an affordable stay in Tainan, I recommend FX Hotel Tainan. It's a decent hotel that offers breakfast. While the rooms are a bit dated, they are perfectly adequate for a comfortable night's sleep. The location is fantastic, situated right along the main road and within easy walking distance of popular attractions like Shennong Street and Snail Alley. The staff were also helpful during my stay. I booked a room for around PHP 2500 without breakfast, which felt like a fair price for the overall experience.

If you need a budget-friendly base to explore Tainan, this hotel is worth considering.

reviews.text: The room is comfortable and clean. Recommend to those ppl visiting Tainan!❤️.

There's a large, free public parking lot just before entering the alley. It's not far from the B&B, just a few meters away. This time, I stayed in a quadruple room. It was very clean and had a private balcony. The first floor has a place for children to play with building blocks. The second floor has a sofa and a water dispenser with tea bags, coffee, and paper cups. While there's no elevator, it's really not a big deal. Everything is spotlessly clean. It's definitely worth a return visit. 👍👍👍

The price was very good, and the room was clean and spacious. It was a good value for money, and it's a simple, affordable B&B.

One minor drawback was that the air conditioner remote was a bit fiddly, and the temperature fluctuated a bit.

However, the downsides outweighed the benefits, and overall, it was a very good stay!

The room is very clean, the space is large enough, and the public space is also clean and comfortable. The owner's service is good, and he will take the initiative to inform us of precautions. The check-in is self-service, which makes people feel comfortable. The location is close to tourist spots such as Yuguang Island and Anping Port, and the transportation is convenient. The only inconvenience is that there is no elevator. If you have elderly and children and live on a high floor, it will be a bit difficult. reviews.text: Disrespectful to non chinese speakers!   I made a reservation on booking.com the day prior around 15h00 to arriving in Tainan, with website specifying that NO PREPAYMENT was needed, including my LINE account in the booking message to the homestay as I know some hotels will ask for a deposit; I explained to them my arrival mode + time, asking them to contact me directly on LINE if any issues.  I never got any LINE message from the establishment.  The next day I checked the address of the homestay to make my way to it, to realize they had simply canceled my booking!  They messaged me on booking.com about 30 min after my reservation, in Chinese only!  I later realized they indeed wanted me to contact them!  I added their LINE before heading to the hotel, asking for explanations, trying to find out if they still had a room, apologizing that I cannot speak Chinese, and showing that my LINE does not provide translation! They sent me screen shots of their messages in Chinese on booking site, which I could not translate (being only on my phone).   They simply stopped replying to my messages!  This is not respectful to tourists from foreign countries, contrarily to the overwhelming majority of Taiwanese people who go out of their way to help. Shame on you.

The Lost Circle.
Clean, nicely decorated and spacious room with a kitchen, fridge, heater, fan, washing machine in side the room. Our friend book the room for us so we did not know that the check in time is until 6pm and was caught by suprise when arrived at the address and see an apparently closed building. However the friendly neighbors call the guy and he arrived in about 10 mins to led us in.
Complimentary is 2 milk tea in the fridge.
Except the hiccup when we arrived, I'm satisfied with the stay.

I absolutely love this place! The room is huge! Besides the quilt, they also came with a blanket. It also comes with a sterilizer, a kettle, and all the necessary utensils: a fruit knife, a cutting board, scissors, pots and pans, and bowls. I could even cook instant noodles in it. I love the small, family-style kitchen design. There's even a dining table for dining, and the refrigerator is huge. I'll definitely be returning to Tainan if I ever visit again.

The facilities were very complete and clean. Everything you need was there. You can cook your own food. You can even do laundry. The bathroom was well-ventilated. Excellent!

The bed was a little too soft. This part is just my personal opinion.

The entrance is relatively hidden.

You can store your luggage before and after check-in, which is very considerate👍

Really cute hotel in a great neighborhood with lots of things to see and do. Rooms are spacious and clean and staff is very kind and helpful. All their restaurant recommendations were excellent.
Great place to stay although the parking is difficult to enter into
A friendly, very clean, and very well-located hotel. If you are staying in An-Ping, this is a great spot to be and the price was good. Room was spotless, AC worked, building felt pretty new.

I chose An-Ping Inn Here, that was a no-brainer due to its great location.
After arriving at the lobby, the check in went very smooth. I was warmly welcomed by the staff and felt so homey！
The room is nicely decorated. The bed is huge and the mattress is really comfy! I slept like a baby during my 3 nights here.
I was also very satisfied with the location. You can just walk or get a bicycle to cycle around the main attractions in Tainan, which is very convenient in the city.
During the time I was staying here, I want to give a shout out to the staff. All of them made my stay here so pleasant, especially they are the locals and perfectly willing to give me secret recommendations of local restaurants. All my cravings for Tainan famous food were fulfilled.
I will definitely be back, sooner or later ;)

The man initially let us cancel for free due to our date change request not being possible due to the hotel being full.

Then we booked again for other dates, and I can say that the man is ready to help. We messaged him with different questions and problems, and he was quick to find said solutions and support us. For example, we had taken the key from the previous accommodation by mistake, and he posted it back for us.

The place is quite central.

This B&B is lovely and cozy, located near an elementary school and directly across from the police station. The owner was very friendly and upgraded our room. I stayed in a simple Japanese-style room, which had a spacious bathroom and room.

I think the owner keeps the place very clean! We were asked to change into slippers upon entering the B&B, and each pair of slippers was collected and cleaned after check-out. The bed sheets and pillowcases were also scented and cleaned very well, and they were allergy-free.

This B&B is a renovated old house, so the soundproofing might not be perfect. The water dispenser and refrigerator are only on the first floor, and I didn't mind them, except for the steep stairs.

The owner also secretly placed some toiletries next to the water dispenser for guests who forgot to bring their own.

When I checked in, I found that there were many small insects in the room on the first floor. In addition, the smell of disinfectant was quite strong, which made me feel uncomfortable. Although the B&B provides cancellation options and refunds, it is recommended that the pest control issue be further improved in the future. I believe the overall experience will be better.
The room is clean and comfortable, the price is affordable, not far from Guohua Street, a good accommodation experience
