The location was brilliant with a short walk to most places. They had a washer and dryer on the 1st floor but didn’t provide a towel unfortunately unless you paid extra. Staff were a little rude and disinterested but overall a great experience

I agree with the online good reviews for this hotel / hostel. and I would highly recommend it, especially if you find a good price on the booking platforms. It is a good experience to live in a space shuttle capsule.
I can sense / feel that the staff put in their heart and effort to the hostel. The colors, the decorations here and there, the signs (please keep quiet, keep tidy & clean), the common place bookshelf etc. speaks for the staff.
The common space has 4 tables and have at least 15 chairs. You can look up online photos of this hostel. Throughout my stay, I saw many staff working around this hostel and I feel that they are adequately staffed.
About the sound proofing, I can hear snoring in the room from the adjacent common space table outside at quiet late night, can hear people coming down the stairs from the common space. But for the price and for the good environment of this hotel, I'm okay with it.
About the cleanliness of this hostel, although it does not reach the level for A+ 5 star or 4 star hotels (see online comments pointing out some imperfections from other people), it is above standard and I feel comfortable in the capsule, in the shower room and in the toilet room, especially consider the affordable price on week days.
The entrances to the common bathrooms for men & women (if you book shared bathroom options) are next to each other but the shower booths and toilet booths are all inside and have doors.
About online comments of climbing up the ship like stairs to the upper bunk bed for various room types and configuration, yes I can see some rooms open for cleaning at check out time, and yes I do feel you need two firm hands and pay attention when you climb up and down. Look up online photos.
Overall, this is a good hostel among other good hostels you can find. I would come back.

Too many mosquitos. After asking the staff to do something against the mosquitos they couldn't provide a solution. They offered an electric flyswatter. The whole hostel is full of mosquitoes. A flyswatter won't do the job. Some mosquito spray would be much more helpful.
Honestly the beds were ok but I peaked through the crack under the capsules and it was clear it hadn't been cleaned under there ever. Disgusting. Try to get a top bunk room if you can.

reviews.text: Good price and location but very small room, not private bathroom, you can hear everything. Way small for a couple. It is clean though. NOTE: you only get two tiny hand towels, if you want actual bath towels, you have to pay 50 NT extra, which is INSANE for a hotel

THANK YOU FOR LATE CHECK-IN! We arrived at 3am and needed a place to stay that was in walking distance from Taipei main station. With their directions, it was easy to locate the lock box and get our room key. The room was very small. The bathroom has soap, floor mat, and hand towels only. It was just enough accommodations for us to stay one night. The location is conveniently located on top of a 24h 7Eleven and other nearby restaurants. We walked to local shops for breakfast.

I enjoyed my stay here, everything was clean, the beds were comfortable, the comforters were nice quality. The space is a good size for a solo traveler. It had everything I needed. Just wish the water shower got alittle hotter. I got lucky and didn’t really hear much noise at night but you can hear alittle. I would stay here again for the reasonal price of the hotel and recommend you trying it out.

Really good place to stay for a few nights. Located next to the main station & underground. Room with excellent A/C, tv & clean tidy washroom. We asked for an extra night and was cheaper then anything online. Rooms are extremely quiet, perfect for a good nights sleep.

Great central location for getting around town and lots of food options in this area as it's where all the after school study classes are. Small rooms but it's user friendly and best for busy folks looking for a convenient place to sleep. If you're looking for extra storage space, room service and lots of room amenities, this is not for you.

reviews.text:
We stayed here for 2 nights, check-in was smooth, everything was within our expectation. The room is consider small for 2 big luggage, toilet was clean and bed is soft. Among the amenities in the hotel, we love that they provide free flow of coffee and milk tea. The lift is small and could only take up to 2 pax with 2 luggage each time. When we asked for luggage storage for later collection after check out, we notice the luggage are placed outside at the reception instead of inside a room, perhaps consider keeping in a room instead for more customer assurance.

Otherwise, the location is perfect, near the metro station and eateries. Overall we are happy with our stay here.

The hotel offers many thoughtful service arrangements, such as booking Fuhang Soy Milk breakfast for guests, purchasing souvenirs on their behalf, discounts at nearby massage parlors, and arranging driver pickup services, etc. The staff are also very friendly. Additionally, the hotel's location is extremely convenient, close to Taipei Main Station, making it easy to arrange transportation.

The only thing I was concerned about the room is relatively small, and the TV position might bump your head— you have to be careful every time you walk by. Also, since the hotel is always in a busy downtown area, you can hear traffic noise from the street outside in the morning, but it's not too noisy and is at an acceptable level.

Cityinn Hotel Taipei Station One has always been my top choice for price and accessibility. The staff working there are always so welcoming and friendly. The rooms are clean, may not be the biggest considering the price you are paying for. You might also read reviews saying walls are thin which can be true at times if your neighbours are loud. But the room is sufficient, clean, beds and pillows comfy. Toilet is clean. They also replenishes your bottled water everyday, provides clean towels daily. For people who wants supper, complimentary cup noodles are provided every night. And they have milk tea and ice tea provided all day as well. Pantry at 2nd floor is small but good enough. The hotel also allows you to store your luggage before check in and after check out if required. Will definitely be back again. Thanks for the hospitality!

We stayed for almost a week.

Rooms were a little small (stayed in the room without windows) but rates were friendly so can’t complain. Staff was always so friendly and nice. Consistently ensuring our stay was well taken care of. Special mention to the auntie(s) that do the housekeeping that were so friendly and chirpy.

I really liked the part where there’s washing machine for your use. (It’s free) there’s a dryer here too if you want.

There’s water dispenser for boiling, warm and cold water in the pantry so that’s very nice. Coffee machine and some drinks dispenser too. All free of charge. They have nice interesting feature where they offer some cup noodles after 10pm. Be careful, it’s always very popular. Sometimes when I’m too late there’s no more left :(

Guests were a mix of locals during the weekends and tourists. Sometimes families with children.

Be careful though, the walls are a bit thin, but nothing too serious.

Overall enjoyed my stay. Will probably be back if possible.

I really enjoyed my stay here. Hotel is very easy to get to from Z4 Exit at Main Taipei Station. The front desk is very pleasant, friendly and professional. They are extremely thoughtful and noticed it was my birthday and wrote me a card and a cake. Thank you to Nina, Wendy and Helena. The hotel room was very clean and I liked how cosy the room is. It is good size for mum and daughter. I will stay here again and recommend to my friends and family.

reviews.text:
The hotel is located conveniently near the mrt station. The lobby is spacious. clean and welcoming. The hotel staff, Olivia, is helpful and friendly as she assisted us with the booking. The room is spacious and well-maintained.

Another plus point, you get to enjoy complimentary coffee and cup noodles.

We will recommend Tomorrow Hotel to anyone who is coming to Taipei.

Good location but do NOT trust these reviews. Staff forced me to give them 5 star review before giving me my room key at check in.

There was hair on my bed and in the bathtub. The space is super small for the amount of money paid, they also don’t do housekeeping and there is no shower curtain so the water gets everywhere. I would not stay here again, only good if you are tight on time and want to be in ximending for max. 1-2 nights.

I had an amazing stay at Tomorrow Hotel! The staff were incredibly accommodating and friendly, making me feel right at home. The rooms were spotless, well-maintained, and smelled wonderfully fresh. The hotel’s location is excellent, very convenient and surrounded by great spots to explore. Every corner of the hotel reflects care and attention to guests. Highly recommend for a comfortable, hassle-free stay!

Pros: Very great location for tourists, same area as the red brick building and rainbow Teipei road. On the edge of downtown Ximen (a very touristy place with shops, night markets, bars, and anything else you can think of). Less than a block from MRT and bus stops. Affordable for those wanting the bare minimum in their stay. We only used the room to sleep so this was a good choice for us. They allow you to store your luggage there if you arrive too early or need to leave later. You get free coupons for drinks and snacks from their vending machines which they restock every night.

Cons: Staff insisted on us giving them a 5 star review before we even got our rooms, this may account for their high score despite being a below average hotel. No housekeeping service “unless requested”, this would be fine except we requested it two days in a row without them coming and just gave up. You need to go to the front desk for fresh towels and drop off the dirty ones yourself. There’s no shower curtain in some of the rooms (3/4 of our rooms didn’t have one) so water got everywhere. Little to no wifi in the rooms, we went into the lobby if we needed to access it. The rooms are the size of the bed and don’t even have a closet, they even told us we got the “large/upgraded” rooms, so I’d hate to see the others. The window in one of our rooms was boarded off with a plank of wood, the other 3 rooms had real windows.

So here’s the deal. This place definitely has a scheme going on. They first show you the “small room” you booked, then try to upsell you to a “better room” for more money. They make it sound like some special offer with lines like “only for you, last room available” basically pushing you to think you don’t have a choice but to upgrade.

When I refused and stuck to my budget, guess what? They still gave me a bigger room without charging extra. But here’s the catch. They made me wait about an hour, and in return, they pressured me to give them a 5-star review. They even asked me to open Google Maps, searched their hotel themselves, and wanted to click the stars right in front of me.

Now I get why their rating is 4.9/5. It’s way too good to be true. I looked through the lower-star reviews and boom, it’s the same story over and over again. On top of that, the noise and cleanliness complaints were spot on. Housekeeping doesn’t really clean the room, they just fix the bed and maybe swap out the towels.

reviews.text: The room is overall spacious and reasonably priced given its convenient location. Just a 5-6 minute walk from the closest station. The rooms have no windows in it, but you won’t feel stuffy inside as the ventilation is working well. No single-use amenities nor towels provided though.
Perfectly fine rooms. Both the Chinese and the Western parts of breakfast were underwhelming. The advertised fitness room was a corner in the reception behind a curtain. Had no wish to try.

Finding the hotel's location and signage can be a bit challenging both by car and on foot. However, this is somewhat expected for businesses with long-standing management styles from the 20th
century.

The room I stayed in was spacious and comfortable. The mattress, reminiscent of a 1970s waterbed, was quite soft, and the pillows lost their shape easily. FX Hotel is popular among budget-conscious travelers, especially those from Southeast Asia. Please note, weekend rates may be higher than expected given the hotel's offerings.

UPDATES: 08/2025
Returning to FX Hotel Taipei on numerous trips since 2024, I’ve seen fit to re-evaluate. While there were shortcomings in the past, the property has steadily found firmer footing and now stands out as a solid option within its price bracket.

The rooms are spacious and well-equipped (2 telephones like it was in 1995!), a notable advantage over many competitors that lean too heavily on minimalism. FX provides proper furnishing that makes remote work both comfortable and practical — a real plus for business travelers and digital nomads.

That said, there remains one consistent drawback: bathroom maintenance. Across different rooms, I’ve noticed recurring mildew and mold issues.

Laundry facility is well-meaning but drying units are substandard in timely delivery of dry clothes, took absolutely insane long time of 1:30hrs to dry at 10NT per 12min, better off at self-service laundromat. Advisable to have commercial-grade laundry machines!

NOW the last surprise...COCKROACHES. Found 1 cockroach running across room and 1 in bathroom. Informed front desk attendant.

It is a budget hotel with minimalist service.  The breakfast menu includes sausages, fried eggs, and bacon, with two special items, usually local pastries.  They have porridge and soups catering to tour groups from Thailand, Vietnam, and HK and sporadic business guests.  Spartan offerings. Service is, at its best, minimalist.  If asked for towels, you must wait until the next day for housekeeping to begin their work day. Counter staff seems to merely stating the house rules while the team at the mroming’s breakfast exhibited some hospitality and warmth. The hotel is integrated with offices so expect workers going in and out of hotel lobby.  Room is clean. Need to manage expectations if hotel quality is a concern

The location is prime, the price was the best for a 4 star hotel, and the room is very comfortable. Don't expect a high end hotel, and you will be happy. Service is good, though minimal. There's a free coffee machine on the 15th floor, and laundry available (pay per use). The dryer doesn't work all that well though. Would stay here again!

reviews.text: I selected and enjoy staying alone at this hotel for 3 nights due to affordable, clean, convenience and location. Front desk staffs are friendly and helpful. My room is little small but enough for myself. Room service is tidy. Without high expectations, I highly recommend this hotel and it's very convenient to go around Ximenting area like The Red House etc. The only downside is no parking, but it's facing street and easy to  call cab or Uber, and walking distance to Metro or subway.

The bathtub was a great way to relax after walking all day. That said, there is no bidet! The staff at the front desk are professional. The place is close enough to public transport, but it's also very convenient for the night life. We were lucky enough to find a room with windows, so we picked this hotel.

I found this budget hotel 2 weeks before my journey to Taipei. Unlike some bad comments, I found this place is affordable, quiet,  comfortable clean and at prime location. Room is clean, organized and good for 1-2ppl max. Bathtub is a little small but good enough to take shower. Although the carpet and wallpaper may seem old but it's clean enough and no dirty spot. Staff and room service are friendly and helpful especially I myself carry 3 luggages. They allow to help hold your luggages at counter after you check out by 12pm with string and tag# to claim your luggage so it won't get lost or mixed up. The hotel located in walking distance (5-8mins) to The Red House, subway Ximenting district, rainbow bars, shops and restaurants. I recommend this hotel if you are in the budget, wanted clean, comfortable and less demand. The only downside is no hotel parking except an alley and main street to order Uber or pick up.

Great location (close to metro and bus), decent clean room (no view though).  Workers are nice, professional, and helpful.  If you arrive too early, you can leave the luggage with them without extra charge.
One thing to remind fellow travellers who book any Taipei hotels (not just this one) through Expedia: a twin bed can comfortably sleep 2 but not 3 as what Expedia tells you so probably it is Expedia problem.  If you look to accomodate 3 people, in Expedia, select 4.  If you look for 4 people room, in Expedia, select 5.  Again, for Taipei (or whole Taiwan) only, not US hotels.

Went there last January which was winter season and there was no heaters. We were just told to open the windows and/or off the aircon. Where there is only one vent in the toilet. And the rooms that we got (we got 2 rooms) both has the smell of smoke. Although both were smoke-free rooms and when we told the staff about it, they did put an air purifier in our room. However, it did not do much. But staff were nice and introduced us to the area and answered all out queries.  I guess you can say 一分钱一分货(the amount paid for equates to the qaulity of the product).

Be aware the hotel s entrance is not on the Main Street. It is behind a small street. The room is very small. The hotel is very clean. It has everything you need. Great value for the money I paid. Very close to the Ximen station. I would come here again. It is also looks to be recently renovated.

Room was not as good as I thought. It was an interesting location which all access to the main road and 5 mins walk to Ximenmetro station. It was quiet and peaceful within community. If you are seeking budget-friendly and don't worry about city living appeal, this might be the place for you.

The room is quite clean. I have got one private room. Perfect for one person. The receptionist lady is kind. A disadvantage is a checki-in time is pretty late, but it happens that the room is ready earlier than that time.

reviews.text:
The check-in area at the main entrance is quite large, featuring two substantial statues that don't seem very inviting and may come off as somewhat intimidating, resembling a Buddhist meditation center. Personally, I found the staff to be lacking in warmth and hospitality; they felt more like administrative personnel simply performing their duties rather than delivering the welcoming experience one would expect. The overall ambiance felt off, with stale air that didn't have the refreshing scent of hotel fragrances.

We reserved two types of rooms—one executive and one standard. We experienced both, and while the executive room was spacious and carpeted, it didn't significantly enhance our stay.

Overall, I believe there are better options at this price point, where you might enjoy a more pleasant experience.

One of he best hotel i have ever stay. Modern, luxury,  large room, very cleeaaannn, quiet,new bed sheet and towel... so perfect.
And the price is very cheap. Thanks JSL👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍
Wonderful property. Easily 4.5 stars IMHO. However, I was not staying here long enough to be able to evaluate the service aspects.

This review is for front desk Rita and room 232 cleaning stuff. We received an email from Rita after we checked out, they found out a watch which is my husband left in the room didn’t notice when we left . We were really appreciate and impressed by their service. Will definitely come back.

Review for JSL Taipei
Currently staying here, and it’s been quite disappointing. The walls are so thin I can hear conversations from next door, including a lady who kept singing. The toilet has a dingy smell, and there’s dust everywhere—feels like the room hasn’t been properly cleaned. We booked a more expensive room with an Onsen, hoping for relaxation, but it’s just not possible. Strangely, the cheaper rooms in this hotel have heated toilet seats and bidets, but our pricier room only has a basic toilet bowl. The rooms are also dark and give off a dingy vibe. Definitely not worth the price.

Also, be aware there are bed bugs i believe. I observed a lot of bites the next day
Love this hotel ! The room was so clean and luxurious. Right next to the best night market ! If I come back I’d definitely want to stay there again. Also the staff was super nice !

I like this hotel, very accomodating, the staffs are approachable and very clean. Comfortable to sleep didn't hear a loud noise. Outside the hotel are MRT station, Raohe night market and a lot of convinience store.

Good hotel. 👍 we managed to get free upgrade to bigger room n it comes woth free breakfast at vegan restaurant at level.1. Level 10 can see taipei 101....v close to train station. Wifenpu wholesale market...Rao he night station.. v good.

Exceptional service, comfy rooms, and a brilliant location; right next to the Taipei metro, and across the road from Raohe Nightmarket.
The rooms are kept clean every day, and the value for money is superb.
Whenever we had any problems or questions the staff were able to help; from how to get to Alishan mountain, to helping us get our passports back to us at the airport when we forgot them in our room! (Thank you again, guys!)

If you're looking for a place that will take care of you, this place takes the cake. Will come here next time I'm in Taipei!!

reviews.text:
Great stay, way better than expected! The staff were super friendly, and there’s an elevator to the lobby. We loved the free food bar with unlimited drinks, cup noodles, snacks, light breakfast in the morning, and even a free washing machine.

The room was clean and modern, honestly better than some 4-star hotels I’ve stayed at in Taiwan.

We heard the area might not be safe at night, but we didn’t experience any issues. Overall, amazing value for money. Would definitely stay again!

Rooms are a great value for the price.  Books up quick on the weekend.  Unfortunately not the best neighborhood but 5 starts on the soundproofing.  Definitely a top notch job filter out the noise that many of the other hotels in the area cannot.  If you don’t get good sleep here it’s all on you.  24 snack bar and 24 desk service.  Hard to beat.

Despite the somewhat dicey exterior, the interior of the hotel was very nice , modern and clean. Staff were super friendly and there are great amenities which include a small gym, free laundry and snack bar. The area is also very convenient, just minutes away from MRT yellow line and lots of shops and restaurants just downstairs.

Some complaints would be that wifi was extremely slow and the TV is a bit old so there was no option to use Netflix, etc. Also, the soundproofing was not great, we could hear the noises from outside pretty clearly.

Overall, however, I would recommend this hotel if you're not after anything super fancy. The prices were very reasonable during our stay and we felt we got more than we paid for.
Doesn't look like much from the outside but the rooms on 7F are quiet. The snack lounge and laundry service are very nice extras that were unexpected. Friendly staff. I'll likely stay here again!
Awful would not recommend.  Booked wrong dates, and tried to cancel within the hour and the would not accept.  Rude customer service.

reviews.text:
Hôtel is too old and not well maintained at all, most of the area I found dust, hair etc…. Suspect where those positive comments were coming from.

Photos in trip.com doesn’t reflect the real situation at all.  However I found more valid comments are in Google.  Felt being cheated.

Hotel is too old but i found they are more willing to invest on public areas but not the rooms.

The whole building full of mold smell, you feel it once you entered the building so this is why they air-con maintained in high fan and coldest temperature.

The room was filled with of mold smell even with the air purifier in room and air-conditioning set to 10 degree with high fan.  I requested for room change but was told all rooms smelled the same which I believed so.  I end up wearing mask while sleeping like I’m staying in a hospital… insane.

Posted this comments but rejected by trip. Com

The property is old and moldy.  They only seem to upkeep the public area.  Like other reviewers, I found mold, dust, and hairs on the bedding indicating it may have not been changed before my stay.  The location is very good and the price is low, but I don't think it's a value; you can get a similar price at a older, but clean hotel.  The booking sites will tell you there is only one room left, but there are actually several empty (I asked for another room and was shown others that were just as bad, mold and grime)  I won't be staying again.

Location is 5⭐️ Super easy metro access. Staff are friendly! Clean room!
Downfall: our room doesn't have hand soap [I had to go buy some at Poya] or hair conditioner. They states they were moving away from 1 use items, great! But fill some bottles and leave them in the room like hair shampoo and body wash! The cleaning lady took all pur towels and left 0 and the next day things were turned upside down.

We stayed for 3 nights and felt what the hotel physically lacked, the staff made up for it with their kind hospitality. For context, comfort is not critical when we travel as we only need a bed for rest than for luxury. However, while the hotel obvi is old (cracks showing in ceiling lights, dated design etc), we enjoyed the free (and nice smelling) shampoo, bath tub, HUGE basin, very hot shower, super comfy bed and feather comforter, and humidifier. Also free local snacks and drinks! And of cos free luggage storage upon check out as we spend our last hours in Taipei before leaving for airport. 10/10 recommend this hotel and will stay again :)

P/s: example of the staff's kindness: on our first night, we ordered food delivery and completely forgot abt Taiwan's garbage sorting and we mixed all our garbage in one bag. The next day, I took the garbage bag out and enquired with the staff where I could throw, and they said they would take care of it. I believe they helped sort through my rubbish and I was very embarrassed at the thought of them seeing my leftover supper.. the next few nights, we tried sorting into plastics, paper and leftover food (throw yr liquids and wash your take away containers!)

Very well located among small eateries, convenience shops, a pharmacy, bakery and even a TCM practice. It is in the centre of town within walking distance of the MRT. SOGO mall is also nearby.

Great location, once u get a hang of the public transportation, it becomes a nice base.  It has all necessities for a good sleep. Breakfast spots a couple of minutes away, a lot food options nearby.

Booked via Agoda. This is their Bunk Bed. The room has a musty smell that doesn't go away. The bathroom is nice, shower gel and shampoo is provided. Bottled water is provided. Condoms are available in the lobby. Bed is pretty stiff and hard. Location is pretty nice, around 10-min walk going to Taipei Main Station, Ximen Station, or NTU Hospital Station.

They did housekeeping even though we didn't request for it. Self check-in and check-out is available. After check-out, we left our luggages in the lobby and returned for them later in the night.

The property was nice and clean. It is close to some museums and the 10 min walk to the MRT to the airport. They have coffee for free in the common area and a place to eat. Great budget hotel to stay for a few nights.
There were people smoking in the room next to us and couldn't sleep. Hotel did not have air freshener so we had to get some. The common area to eat can use some cleaning.

the location of the hotel is very stratetigic. TRANSPORTATION is very easy, it is near train stations and bus stops. reviews.text:
As much as I’d like to gate-keep this hotel, I have to thank them for saving our trip when our first accommodation turned out to be a roach motel. Hotel Bchic is comfortable, convenient, and at a good price point for our family vacation. We had a long stay of about 3 weeks and found the experience to be excellent - will be booking again when we visit Taipei next.

Transportation and Walkability to anywhere in the city and out is excellent - we traveled all over from Jiufen to Maokong and from Wanhua to Nangang - there’s nowhere a little walk, bus, train, HSR won’t get you there. Plenty of food options within 10 minute radius and lots of department/specialty stores within walking distance. Convenience stores in just about all directions for those late night cravings.

When we did have some issues with the room, the front desk was very quick to address and resolve them. Excellent service!

Will definitely stay again! (Also, booking directly with the hotel turned out to be the best price all around)

Ps - WiFi isn’t the best here - better use your travel sim or pocket wifi

I enjoyed my stay. I was here for three nights. The room was clean and comfortable. Asian beds are harder than the USA. I have learned to adjust. I was on the seventh floor. The elevator is quite small. I only heard my neighbors The final night of my stay. The nearest train station is about 10 minutes walk. Due to environmental laws hand soap and disposable items are not provided.

The staff is polite and trys to help to the best of their abilities.

The Hotel is in a great location, super close to Bus and MRT Station. There are banks and convenience stores at every corner as well as shopping district about 15min by foot.

However the wifi connection is so freaking bad. There are multiple wifi channels per floor and neither of them really work. So if wifi is important for you, then look somewhere else to stay. Additionally air circulation is not good, the hotel room smells musty like and old persons house. The beds get "made" but the sheets won't be washed during the stay. You can tell that they are trying to save money since you're only given additional toilet paper if you ran out of it or specifically ask and there is no free water.
Also all the mirrors are really dark so if you're looking to do your make-up this is not the place for you.

Dirty (unlceaned floor and sufaces and bathroom), very old and dated, smelly (musty and old cigarettes) dusty, uncomfortable bed, loud, wifi not working, linen smelly and no hand towels provided, no breakfast included in the very, very overpriced cost.

Staff also quite rude. By far the worst hotel I've stayed in for a very long time. The only good thing was hot water in the shower and location.

Don't ruin the start or end of your Taiwan holiday by booking this hotel. Avoid at all costs!

The worst sound isolation i ever had in a hotel, as you can hear what the neighbours are talking about. My neighbours decided to use the room next door as fun time room and had 2 loud moaning sessions that lasted for an hour in total.

Other than that the hotel is quite old, and I will describe the service as a bit cold. Only positive is the room is quite spacious and the bathroom are nice.

reviews.text:
While the hotel shows signs of age, it offers a great value for travelers looking for a convenient and budget-friendly stay. Its location is definitely a top tier, only about 3 to 5 minute walk to Ximen Station, making it easy to explore Taipei and access nearby shops and restaurants. The room itself was larger than expected, with ample space to move around.

One thing to note is the staff... we had an interaction with one of them who wasn’t particularly warm (I observed Taiwanese are like that so not a big deal), but he was considerate. I saw a sign saying guests would be charged for any damages, so when I accidentally broke a clothes hanger, I informed him right away. Surprisingly, he just said it was okay, no need to pay. They also let us use an iron for free, which was a nice added convenience.

Overall, if you're not too picky about decor and just need a clean, spacious place in a great location, this hotel gets the job done. Strongly recommended if you're into a budget hotel.

Ps: haven't taken any room pics as we were so busy for a week stay and we only went back to the hotel to sleep in.

It’s in a good location. About 5-10 minutes walk to Ximending MRT station.  Lots of food around.  Rooms are ok.  Decent size, carpet is kind of old.

My experience with staff was great.  Tin Tin was friendly and amazing at helping me with my room issues, and Billy was also very friendly and helpful with my Agoda bookings.

Nice place overall! The hotel is conveniently located near Ximending, with plenty of nearby convenience stores. It’s also very affordable. We just needed a safe place to keep our things while exploring Taipei, and this worked perfectly.

If you’re a type of tourist who uses hotel just for sleeping. This place is doable. Yes, it’s old, but the room is really really big and decent. I just sleep at night and go out the whole day so this is good for me. Bed and pillows are comfortable

Some rooms are without windows. Not a luxury hotel, ok for short stay. It’s appx 5 mins walk to Xi men ding. Staff at reception were friendly. Not recommended for family with kids as the place is not super clean+ there’s KTV at level 2 + I witnessed a gang fight during my stay there :)

Except for “centrally located” - there is nothing good to rate for this hotel. I went through a few hundreds of reviews here before arriving at the hotel and totally disappointed with the service.

We checked in as tour group and I think they upgraded us to a quadruple room instead of twin room (appreciate for this). Still the room is really old, no soundproof and didn’t give that “luxury” touch as they claimed themselves “luxury hotel”.

Staffs attitude really really needs to be improved. TV remote is not working and the staff came after we called the operator twice. Is the management team reading all these reviews by guests? It is so bad, guys.

Many rooms have a terrible view  of the wall of another building from which people can look directly into your room just a few meters away.. No privacy curtains either.

The door frame in the bathroom was covered in MOULD.

Stay somewhere else if you can.
Very small, quite shabby rooms but comfortable bed. Convenient location. Breakfast included is ok. Staff is nice

Location is neither here nor there, 10 mins walk away from 北门 train station, and a similar throw from 西门顶.
Price is ok. 2700nt for queen room for 2 nights.
In summary, it is ok, but if I were on my own I wouldn't stay here.

reviews.text: The quality just doesnt match the price. Rooms are damp, moldy, dirty and cramped. In shower hot water runs out after 10 or so minutes. No service at entrance as everything is automated. Also no noise insulation so could be hard to sleep for some people. At least there was clean towels and bedsheets but theyre not changed daily. You should pay at most 500twd per night for this quality.

The owner has been very helpful since we arrived around 2am. She helped us to open the door and check-in, and she was also very responsive in the booking.com

The room and comfort room are small, but I think that’s fine. Sometimes, the hot water from the shower is lacking.

I want to be as honest as possible for this review.

Perhaps it was the season, but our booking for 3 nights was quite expensive (over 10,000 TWD), so it didn't offer good value for the price, and I expected at least a decent standard. I had seen some reviews and pictures, so I had an idea of what to expect, but it was much worse.

- **Size**: The rooms are extremely small, as you may have seen in other reviews. There's almost no space for luggage, the sink is next to the bed, and the "shower" is directly above the toilet. Warm water is limited. After we arrived, I flushed 4 tissues, and the toilet got clogged. The reception ladies (who also seem to work as cleaning staff?) came to help.

**Cleanliness**: I think they are trying to keep the rooms clean, but the main issues are the room size and humidity. Taking a warm shower, of course, leaves humidity in the room, which leads to mold. Mold was present in most of the corners, the toilet, and behind the sink. I think they tried to cover it with wallpaper, but it was still visible. Having mold right next to the bed wasn't the best experience. We also found hair on the toilet upon arrival, which wasn't very appealing.

**Other Issues**: The rooms have a small window without curtains, so you'll be woken up by the sun in the morning. Around 9 AM, they start playing music throughout the hotel, making it hard to sleep. The worst part was after our first night, when a sudden fire alarm went off, waking us up and forcing us to leave the room with everyone else in the building. They said someone triggered it by smoking, but everyone was already out, and no one was questioned about it. I saw other reviews mentioning this fire alarm problem, so it's easy to think it was a malfunction. Some people outside were really upset and scared because of the sudden alarm.

**In the end**: I canceled the full booking after the first night and moved somewhere else. If I were on an extreme budget (500 TWD per night max), you might consider it, but otherwise, I think any other hotel would be absolutely better than this one.

**Vote: 0**

So, after my partner gave an accurate review listing the pros and cons of this hotel, they called offering a full refund to remove our review. However, after a few days they went back on this offer and tried to bargain with us. We gave this a fair 3 star review for a 3 star service.
Our room was 511, and while bargaining, the owner admitted that they wanted to clean and update it. So I hope you have a nicer experience.
The room width was the same size as the double bed that fit in it meaning that if you are any taller than a double bed you will have to sleep in a semi crouch. And it touches 3 walls, so one person will have to climb over the other.
It is a self-service hotel meaning that the staff are only available for a short amount of time during the middle of the day. So you will have no luck calling down to the desk.
The air conditioning has some sort of timer built into it, so you will wake up feeling warm.
It is roughly 15 mins away from the night market and train station which is nice, but it's a bit of a sweaty walk.
It has a mini fridge which works, but only when pushing things to the back.
The bathroom is serviceable, but has some black looking mould in between the tiles and on the ceiling which does concern me.
They will only provide one room key, so if you are splitting up for any reason during the day, one of you will need to wait for the key holder to get back.
And lastly, when asking for a room clean, they will do a great job except sweeping/hoovering the floor.

I have tried to be as detailed and accurate as possible, without being unnecessarily petty. And if they hadn't offered a full refund, we would have left the less detailed and fair 3 star review. It's just a bit underhanded to call us and try to scrub a fair review.

10 minutes to a night market. Some nuances are:
No staffs. Check in and out are all strictly machines operated. So you need to check in on or after 2 pm. The machine has no leeway to let you in earlier.

reviews.text:
We’ve stayed at this hotel 2–3 times over the past two years. Overall, the experience has been decent. The rooms are clean, and the beds are comfortable. However, only one pillow is provided per guest, and it’s quite soft and thin, which might not suit everyone.

During our most recent 7-night stay, we encountered a few issues. On the first night, we left a pair of socks on the bed. After housekeeping cleaned the room, we noticed one sock was missing and one of the room lights was flickering. We immediately informed the staff, who took photos of the light only and said they would look into both the missing sock and the light issue.

Later that same night, staff informed us that only one sock had been seen during housekeeping and did not update on the lights. The next evening, we informed another staff member. This time, the light was promptly repaired in our presence. However, we were later informed that the missing sock could not be found. We suspected it might have been accidentally taken away with the bedsheets during laundry.

After 4–5 days, we finally received a call saying the missing sock had been found.

Additionally, there was another minor issue during our stay. We ordered food via Uber Eats and asked one of the front desk staff to pass it to a companion of ours. Unfortunately, there was a miscommunication among the staff. Initially, we were told that the hotel does not collect food on behalf of guests. However, another staff member overheard the conversation and promptly retrieved the food for us.

This service was not expected from a 5 star hotel as showed signs of unclear communication and not checking thoroughly before informing customers.

Location is the key advantage.  Right above train station and steps away from metro.  Negative is there are some homeless around the train station.  Overall it is a safe place.
Room (3 single beds) is spacious and quiet.  The only bad is the bathroom design has no hanging...
Buffet is so so but price (after discount) is reasonable.
Staff are polite.

After months of booking and cancelling and choosing for hotel options for our Taipei trip, I finally booked 6 nights with Caesar Metro Taipei because of its price, location, good reviews, and facilities. My family of 5 - 2 adults and 3 children ages 11, 8, and 4yo had a pleasant stay in the hotel's Family Suite. It has 2 queen sized beds (150x200cm), 4 pillows and 2 comforters. We asked for an extra pillow and comforter and they were given right away. There is free drinking water in the 19th floor where we stayed and we refilled ice for our water bottles from the 17th floor where they have an icemaker. They will not deliver to your door. The beds are comfortable and the sofa in our room had very good cushion and not sagging. The CR had a Japanese toilet (we all enjoyed it) and a spacious bath tub with an incredible view of the mountains surrounding Taipei. I had to buy several bath bombs from Don Don Donki in Ximending to further enjoy the tub for my children. The shower has good pressure but you have to wait a few minutes for the water to become warm/hot. Room and CR were clean but there is a bit of dust on some surfaces. We had a bad experience during check in. We were there at 3pm but we only had our room at 430pm. They gave us 4 Starbucks GCs (4 drinks you can redeem at the 5f where they have an automatic coffee machine of Starbucks beans) and we were allowed to check out one hour later on our departure date. So instead of 12nn, we can check out at 1pm because of their delay in check in. The hotel is in a quiet area but we greatly benefited from its location that is only 2 min walk from the TRA Wanhua station that is only one station away from Taipei Main Station. Because of this, we never used Uber or taxi. My family and I used the metro and the bus in our entire stay! I loved the experience. The bus station is right in front of the hotel's side entrance. There are also lots of options in google maps to commute because the hotel has a great location. Overall, I will really recommend this hotel because of its cleanliness, safety, excellent room layout, room views, location (you can use the TRA until 12mn which is useful if you are visiting night markets), and luxurious feel (lobby entrance, clean elevators and hallways) of the hotel. Thank you Agoda for this excellent booking. It made our Taiwan trip memorable!

The room service lady is very friendly, wonderful swimming which is really large enough! Room is not very spacious but clean and neat, I like the street view and when the light comes in the morning! My only complain is the gym has no weight training equipment just treadmills and cycling machine and the breakfast buffet has a long queue so we didn’t try it :P

I enjoyed my stay at Cesar Metro Taipei. The room was a little plain but a nice layout. The view was great, the breakfast buffet is fantastic, and the location is ok but the trains close by help with that. My only criticism is the shower door seal leaks and floods the bathroom floor - taking multiple towels to soak up the water.

reviews.text: It was okay stay fort solo trip. Like others pointed out, good value for the cost. Good location but the hotel is a bit old.
Room had mould. No soap in the bathroom. The linens did seem clean. And the location is good, price was decent (3000 TWD)

My family stayed here from Sep 10 - 14, 2024. Clean room, comfortable shower pressure, amazing front desk services. Arrived 7 am and way too early for check in. Free checked bags. Loved the continental breakfast.

The hotel is super clean. The staff are very supportive and friendly. In my last trip, I left some stuff at the hotel and went back to Vietnam. The hotel staff managed to send the clothes to my address in Vietnam which was incredible. I’m so grateful to her help. 5 star service!

For the price and a last-minute booking, I felt the room was worth the stay for a solo traveller. The location is decent as well, there is a direct bus to the airport. Service is good, staff are there 24/7 and they will keep your luggage for you (even on the checkout day). Do keep in mind it is a rather old hotel but the rooms are spacious and clean. What you may want to consider are the beds - mattresses may not be long enough for you if you are taller than the average Taiwanese. I also found them a bit hot to sleep in because of the thick duvet, so bring light clothes (and conditioner). The rooms are non-smoking rooms.

reviews.text:
Great hotel, really enjoyed our stay. Booked a Luxury room and had a great view, spacious room, and a very comfortable stay.

The only odd thing was that we could not get the entry way and hall lights to shut off. And the main lights in the room could only be shut off via the in room AI service.

Breakfast was decent, nothing spectacular but was tasty. Had lunch in the dining hall once and it was a lot better than the breakfast we had. Much more options and the dessert bar was surprisingly exquisite.

Great location to pretty much everything. Very close to the famous 皇家帝國麻辣火鍋 which is a must try

Unlike the terrible week I spent in a five-star hotel in Bangkok surrounded by a musty smell,
Taipei is hot but this hotel has no moldy odor, making it comfortable.
There was nothing worth eating at breakfast. Among all the hotels I’ve stayed at, this breakfast doesn’t even deserve one star.

The room is a very reasonable size and one of the places you can have a family with two kids in the same room. The shower is good and there's a deep tub nice for 1 person to soak. The bathroom does have some windows and although they are covered it gives up some privacy. The location is decent, with many buses, but a bit of a walk to the subway.

We stayed for 3 weeks there. Great service. Close to every thing. Professional staff. Great international hotel。 larger room and love the snacks they provided. Jimmy the manager is great and professional.

They have a great theme too. Easy to get to all tourist spots. Close to big supermarket for every thing you need. Easy to get to 西門町。

Taipei Garden Hotel is an excellent choice for families seeking a comfortable and convenient stay near Ximending in Taipei. Located approximately a 10-minute walk from Ximen MRT Station and just 3 minutes from Xiaonanmen MRT Station, the hotel also offers a complimentary shuttle service to Ximending and Longshan Temple. Guests wishing to use the shuttle should make a reservation at the service center or by phone (ext. 6) in their guest rooms one day in advance before 6:00 pm . ￼ ￼

The hotel provides family-friendly amenities, including a free limited supply of baby cribs, baby bathtubs, bottle sterilizers, and bed guards upon request . This makes it a suitable option for families with young children who prefer to stay in a quieter area while still having easy access to nearby attractions. ￼

In terms of nearby conveniences, the hotel is surrounded by various dining and shopping options. Guests can find a hotpot restaurant, 50 Lan bubble tea shop, a dumpling eatery, 7-Eleven, and PX Mart in the vicinity. Additionally, a Carrefour supermarket with a 24-hour food court is located diagonally opposite the hotel . ￼

For children, the hotel offers complimentary snacks, with a quota of two bags per room. Guests can also request the concierge to make restaurant reservations, providing their budget and preferences. The concierge service is known for its efficiency and can be contacted via LINE for added convenience.

As of the latest information, a three-night stay at Taipei Garden Hotel booked through Trip.com is priced at approximately NT$19,000. This makes it a recommended option for families seeking a balance between comfort, convenience, and accessibility in Taipei. ￼

reviews.text: Nice and clean hotel with good price. Very good location near Dihua market and other sightseeing spots. Nice and helpful staff.
It will be our second time to stay at Giant Rich King Plaza Hotel and we love every bit of it. Aside from the clean and spacious rooms, my daughter enjoyed playing in your claw machine. :)

The location is convenient and the staff are nice too. However, the room floor and window screen are worn out,  the bathroom floor isn't properly sealed, leading to ants and other bugs, and the dryer's power is particularly low. My average amount of laundry remaining damp even after drying for an hour.
Great value for money in a fantastic location. Short walk from metro stations and the night market. Staff are attentive and welcoming. Highly recommend!

IT IS A BUDGET HOTEL - this is for you if you’re looking for one. It’s not posh nor luxurious, in fact the entryway at the ground floor even looked a little “intimidating”. But just get in the elevator and once you’re on the 3rd floor (hotel location) you’ll feel more at ease.

The Pros :
I booked it for its location & very decent price (for Taipei hotels) given I’ll have my own spacious room & a bathroom. It is clean, comes with a mini fridge, study table, tv, free & stable WiFi, hairdryer, air con & dehumidifier etc. Outside the room, you have other amenities like microwave, water dispenser (hot & cold), toaster, coffee / tea, free snacks & electric kettles, sitting area for use.

It is within 10-13 min walking from
Zhongsan or BeiMen MRT （Taipei Main train station 5min drive - also direct train to airport). Right next door there’s a great grocer store (全聯福利）, opposite and nearby you have all the convenient stores & night market.

The Cons：
Probably the worst bit is the noise, you can hear everyone and everything around you. I could hear everyone’s phone alarm beeping at different timings. The walls are pretty “paper thin”, so if you’re a light sleeper this is probably a no-go. The mattress is also on the hard side, if one is used to soft mattress. I came during winter (8-11C) so I have to say, the pillows were great & blankets kept me warm throughout the night without the need to on the heater. One of the receptionist is a bit inpatient while others are rather friendly. Also the check in time for this hotel is at 5pm… so that’s quite late compared to most, though you can leave your luggage with them.

There are 3 of this hotel in taipei, so make sure you book the correct one & check the address and outlet location (because I went to the wrong one!)

I do recommend this if you’re traveling on a budget, otherwise I’m sure there are many other hotels to choose from while in this city !

Very kind and accommodating staff no matter how simply my questions.

Room is very simple and clean. Perfect for a temporary stay.

Great location too, right behind the station. Near the old street, lots of food and history and culture to experience.

This place is convenient. Close to everything, a few walk to train station (Taipei Main Station and Train station to airport) close to mall, and there's restaurant in the down part of the building.

We stay here for 7nights last May 26, really like the shower, the bed is fit just for two person. Free laundry where you can do by yourself until 11pm just pay 40NTD for the dryer.

It's hard to find the location at first, you can't see the sign easily(we found it when we get out of the elevator after check in) , we just try our luck by pressing the elevator in front.

Overall we had a nice stay in this place.
Cozy and comfortable room with great location of 5 min to Taipei main station, nice and kind staff to recommend great local foods and attractions, will definitely recommend!

Everything okay, room big and clean.
Near 711 and taipei main station also shuttle bus just 5 minutes walk.

A bit hard to find the hotel even you follow the instruction on google maps.
Its direct to elevator w/o sign, I need to ask local people arround to find the place.
Hotel should make a sign for foreigner since the picture on google is not the same anymore.

This is I share on how to find the place when you come from taipei main station :
You may follow the instruction from google
You may look for the building with sign on fly inn hotel 900 and you may see theres a elevator when local people also using it,
Just go to elevator directly to 3rd floor for checkin or directly search for fly inn hotel on google instead of new lion hotel.

We get the room on 6floor, a bit noisy since we can hear everything outside but still okay to stay.

The room is larger than in most comparable hotels in this area and the bed is very comfortable. As a foreign guest it seems a little unusual that in the street is no obvious sign of the hotel. You have to take the elevator next to the "129" sign and go to the third floor. I liked my short stay and would not hesitate to come back in the future. The staff was friendly and everything seemed clean. The surrounding area is interesting.

reviews.text:
Beautiful lobby. Lifts you up when you enter your hostel.
Staff were nice.
Location was amazing. Near main station, many convenience stores, a park, museum, and near a police station.
A downside is that double capsule was a little warm as it was enclosed further. But I got used to it. But my bed was otherwise very comfortable and the full ledge beside my bed felt like a luxury

stayed one night, man I had to say this place is goated. clean room and quiet, with warm welcome from the reception that runs 24/7. highly recommend for someone who is seeking for short term stay. the common area is also emitting peace and chilling vibe.

My favorite hostel in Taipei! The bunk beds are comfortable, spacious, and offer a good level of privacy. The common areas are cleaned daily, and the location is excellent—just a short walk from the Main Station. The only downsides are the relatively high price and the somewhat unfriendly front desk staff. Still, I’d definitely stay here again.

Very poor value for the price.
The staff was unfriendly.
We were two people in a double bed in the dorms — it was freezing at night, and they said blankets were for an extra charge.
In general, the bathrooms and common areas were not clean.
I do not recommend this place at all.

Stayed for 3 nights alone in female dorm, I booked double for more space. Best part of this is the double  bunks are located at the end of the room, separated by a door. There's more privacy & quietness. I had to work and could do so much in the quiet space.

Really appreciate that all boarders respect the 9pm lights out, keep noise down rule. Everyone gets to enjoy good rest and sleep.

4 toilets + 4 showers + 3 toilets w/ showers in women's bathroom - never had to wait or queue. Hair dryers, mouthwash are more than enough provided. Bathroom is most of the time clean except for late nights after heavy uses when everyone's back. But pretty much all cleaned up by the next morning.

Nice & spacious common space in kitchen (coffee, tea & water provided, light toast w/ jam in morning) where I could rest, read (lots of interesting Taiwanese works) and do more work.

Finally, fantastic location - short 5 mins walk after exit M8 from (the ever confusing & huge) Taipei main station. And just next to one of the biggest police station in Taipei, you can count on safety.

Too much food options around, fantastic choices, I can't get enough seriously!

Main con for me:  this place is located in basement 1. The walls are thick (assuring for earthquake fear), I lose my phone network completely when I'm downstairs. I needed it for my work when I'm not allowed to connect to wifi, that caused some inconvenience for me. But then again, I'll take thick wall strong structure building anytime.

Overall, super value for money.

reviews.text: I had the best time at this hostel. Great beds with big lockers. They gave us keycard access for the room itself as well as the lockers. Felt super safe with the area, location was great as the Taipei Main Station was just a few mins away by foot. The service was great and everyone was so nice. I got the top bunk but had no issues with it. There were power sockets to charge my phone next to my head with a light switch, also there was a bar to hang stuff in the bunk. The kitchen and bathrooms were super clean. And they provided us girls with some feminine products ready by the vanity in the bathroom (amazing). Would recommend to stay here and would definitely do again! Thanks!!

My third time staying at star hostel - once in dorms, and twice in a private room. I wouldn't even look to stay anywhere else.
It is in the perfect location, off the y13 exit of the main station. the area is interesting with lots of little shops, 7-11, and food stalls (at least one is vegan) and near lots of other good malls, the subway, etc.
Free breakfast is great and they have a vegan option every day! You tell them at check in and you get a card to show if you are vegan, vegetarian, etc.
Free special drinks like plum lemonade and little snacks are available. Two big fridges for use. Lots of hang out areas, fun activities, or else the rooms are quiet. The showers have body wash, shampoo, and conditioner, and in the private rooms there are 2 hooks for towels which is somehow rare to find!
It is the best hostel!

I moved in around 12Sep, so far so good , great design & comfort with super clean environment  . Only thing is a locker is a bit small , but you can put your big luggage next to your bunk bed.
I love the mattress that is firm and not too soft - i  actually slept very well ..  This hotel is inexpensive and nice place to stay even I share my bedroom with others ,but everyone mind their own business so actually is great !

They provide daily morning breakfast with delicious Chinese soup .  Staff members are all very kind and helpful . i really appreciated their hard work and great service while I am staying here to visit my family .

They had laundry machine and dryer for the guest to use, reception sale laundry soap (only NT$10), and each of washer and dryer only cost NT$40 . It is a really inexpensive, I am really feel relax and enjoy to stay here for two weeks .

well, I am planning to back to Taiwan once a year , and will definitely come back to this hotel to stay again . Because this location is so perfect that you can easily walk to Taipei main train station to either take a Bullet train, subway , or normal train or buses, and even Y-Bick (public bicycle that you can rent and park ) are everywhere. This hotel fit into a perfect convenience location for one's living when one traveling.. plus they have a super advanced toilet which is my favorite....you can surely enjoy so much when you go to the bathroom 😂..💕

here for 4D3N on June 2025 in all female dorm, love it! calm, clean and good ambiance. the bathroom area always clean, the provide free towel and the toilet has bidets. there are communal kitchen that you can use for microwave or simple cooking, they also provide utensils for eating. it was very cozy, smell good and cool. very short walk distance from taipei main station. the overall area is safe, although a little bit dark after 8pm. really love it here

Star Hostel is phenomenal - the location is incredibly centralized and the day staff are more than hospitable.

I unfortunately arrived early to Taipei (around 4am) and I was unable to check in early to my room. Check-in time is at 3:00pm and I highly recommend folks plan or notify the hostel in advance about early check-in. I did this via whatsapp however there was a strong language barrier with the night staff and he did not allow me to enter into the common spaces. I was not allowed to rest in the main common room either which was difficult considering the 12 hour wait to check-in.

Besides this early hiccup, the rooms were comfortable, surprisingly very quiet (for an eight bed dorm), and all of the amenities were streamlined. There are activities to engage the guests throughout the week and the common spaces are lush, diverse, and highly suitable for co-working (for the other digital nomads out there).

I am so glad that I followed the reviews and booked early - this place fills up fast in the summer! Also, they are very generous about letting you store your luggage even after check-out (until 10pm of the same day) which allows for further exploration of Taipei without stress. I am going to hold STAR hostel near and dear to my heart.

reviews.text: Very good location. Staff are accommodating. Rooms are clean. Do not inspect  for a quiet environment because the price is affordable and cheaper than other accommodation. For us its a reasonable price so we are expecting it that it would be that not so good in case of the noise of the surroundings. But thank you I hope to book again in the future.

I booked the room on Sep 22 for the Oct 10 stay and got the confirmation but on Oct 7, the booking system had already deducted the money from my bank account but then I received the email said that the hotel declined my payment to later on declined my stay. Taipei cheap hotels always set the dorm room price so low to trick customers on online booking platform then later on decline the payment

Easy access to.Taipei Main Station and eateries nearby. Wholesale market downstairs allows convenient shopping for daily groceries. Helpful staff. 24hr front desk.
However, I noticed room price has increased >20% compare to last year 2024 for the same period.

I stayed for 2 nights. I think their double room is perfect for solo, might be too small for 2 people. The room was a little smelly but I bought air fresheners at Watsons nearby.
The wifi for the rooms is different from the wifi at the lobby so make sure you check the sign in your room for your network so you get the best connection.
The location of this hotel is the best feature. Lots of really good food nearby and a Daiso. You can easily find the hotel by exiting from M6 from Taipei main station and walking straight.
There is only 1 plug by the bed which is used by the minibar and 2 USB outlets. I unplugged the minibar so I could use the outlet for my charger.

I book the hostel to stay just for a day. It's cheap and really convenient location. Connected to Taipei Main station, the room and bathroom is just fine. Not bad but not very comfortable. But considering the price, it's nothing to complain :)

reviews.text:
Located right opp the cinema, at a quiet end of xmd walk, there is a couple of 711 around the corner.

Lift lobby at level 1 might look abit scary / rundown.

But the Hotel lobby is at level 4 and the staff is always there to greet you!

Staff are all friendly and extremely helpful.

Not much issue with the sound proofing that everyone complaints about, slept like a baby for all nights.

But i did woke up every morning with the birds chirping by the window, feeling much like a Disney princess.

Facilities in room are well maintained and clean, there’s a smart tv where u can watch Netflix via the room’s account & youtube!

No disposable toothbrush or other items being provided other than toilet rolls and shampoos ( Chatzutang is love )

Also do look out when you are in the hotel lobby and dont step onto the cute hotel rabbit.

Absolutely loved my three nights here at Art'otel. The staff is so kind and wonderful, providing recommendations on local attractions and transport, always greeting you/wishing you a good day, and making sure you have enough water in the summer heat. The rooms are clean, the beds are comfy, and the shower is refreshing when you're dying to scrub the sweat and city off after a long day.

We had a great stay here during our family holiday in Taipei. The location is very convenient—close enough to Ximending for easy access, but just far enough from the hustle and bustle, which we appreciated as a young family.

The room was clean and comfortable. We chose to upgrade, though it was still a bit on the smaller side. It would’ve been nice to have space for a bigger table, as we often prefer to order takeout or UberEats with the kids, but the setup wasn’t ideal for that.

One big plus was that they provided a baby cot at no extra charge, which was very helpful. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and they even kept a super cute bunny that our child absolutely adored!

All in all, a pleasant and family-friendly place to stay in Taipei—we’d definitely consider coming back.

They OVER CHARGED us of 20 USD $ that the price on the booking and after asking I didn't get any refund!
The floor was super noisy at night, not sure if they do construction downstairs but almost all night there was big and very loud noise from the floor during 2 nights!
Only good part, the staff were nice.

Really enjoyed my stay! I only wish I stayed longer. The check in staff were lovely. There was a pet bunny rabbit in the lobby - one of the highlights of my trip. The room was clean, with an exceptional view. I love the Ximending district. I felt safe, and there was a lot to do. Would recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.text:
This hotel have 2 buildings which is a few shops apart. The location is excellent, only 5-10 minutes walk from train station, few streets away from city enter so its not very noisy during night time. The room is quite clean and with openable windows.
However, my room could hardly receive any WiFi signal and the reception was helpless after we reporting the problem.
The hotel security was so worrying. I went to one with reception desk closed to enterence. There was only one reception at the desk but she was very nice and helpful and told us that our room should be at the building few shops away. Another hotel building with reception desk a bit further away from the entrance was the one im staying in. The receptioness never looked up when anyone entering or leaving the hotel. Checked-out customer's luggages was left unattended at a side and anyone can just grab and go. Anyone can take the elevator to the rooms as no restrictions on entering each room floor. I saw few teens kept the fire door opened at my room floor for smoking and I didn't sure if they are customers or just random people. We only have 1 key for 2 people bed room. The room door lock structure was so simple that I decided to locked all my valuables at the train lockers everyday during the trip. And there was platform outside my windows. This is another security concern. As a tourist, we only stayed in the room during night-time and the room was usually empty during daytime. There was so much time for thieves and i can't see any extra measures against threats from windows.
The attitude of staffs and security are the major defects.
I took a photo of the room lock and you will only received the key for the lower lock.

The location is really a plus point —right in the heart of Ximending (XMD), super convenient for food and shopping. But the rooms really quite basic. There’s basically no soundproofing, so you can hear sound from next door or the hallway. The toilet is efficient, but the space is really tight, which makes it a bit uncomfortable. You may also need to wait awhile for the lift, because the lift can only accommodate 6 pax, and there’s only 1 lift.

Wi-Fi can be an issue too, you might need to disconnect and reconnect from time to time. On the bright side, they do offer complimentary coffee at the lobby. And there’s also water dispenser.

Would suggest you book a room for four when you have 3 pax just to have more space and a more comfy stay. Also if you don’t wish to check out too early, you can extend your stay at TWD 200 for an hour.

I stayed at Ximen Citizen Hotel for 5 nights. The building’s interior is definitely on the older side, so it’s not the place if you’re after something modern. That said, the room was clean and comfortable enough for my stay.

I had a single room, which was a bit small for me since I have a medium-sized luggage. If you’re planning to stay here, I’d suggest booking a budget double. I think you’ll get a bit more space. The staff were really helpful and cleaned my room every day, change my towels and beddings.

The staff spoke English pretty well, which made communicating easy. The hotel’s location is okay (just a few minutes’ walk from Ximen Exit 6).

Other notes:
- No bidet
- They offer shampoo and body wash
- Small fridge (it looks old, but still working)

Overall, it was a decent stay for me 😊

Xie xie!

Just had some issue with the WiFi but overall, it was a great experience. Only checked in for 3 nights but ended up extending for a day in the same room. Hotel staff were friendly and helpful. Free coffee offered and early arrival allows you to leave the luggage on their lobby while waiting for your check in time.

How could a hotel not have their own generator? Electrical supply was cut off by the authority for some investigations purposes and they just made a PA announcement to people like me that power supply will be disrupted 12mn to 5am.
Saw many hotel guests making a big fussed which I could understand.
Why no back up generator???

reviews.text: Spacious room, windows with sunlight, blackout curtains, air conditioning, large bathroom, shower, closet and INSANELY soft bed. Felt like a baby😍🥰🤌
I was out with friends and we separated, so I needed someone to open our door. The guy tried to charge me 500 bucks, so I just had to wait an hour.

I paid an exorbitant amount (~12000ntd)for this hotel room due to some events going on in Taipei that weekend, so admittedly my standards will be a little bit higher.
The staff were fine, the decor was pleasant enough for an older hotel. The room and btahroom was clean
A/C: it took hours to cool down the room, I had to keep it on the whole time.
My "queen bed" was just 2 single beds pushed together. And as with so many hotels today, they had a down comforter. This means you are always boiling underneath it and will sweat all night.
The one thing that I found really unbelievable is that there are no electrical outlets next to the bed. Well, they are there if you pull out nightstands, but neither are connected to electricity!! You have to keep your phone and anything else on the other side of the room where the only two working outlets are. I hope you wake up easily because you might not hear your alram go off on the other side of the room
Overall, very disappointing for a place costing ~370USD/night

Nice and clean hotel, not too expensive. No need to give money deposit. The bathroom is clean and there is a bath tub. The hotel is muslim friendly and there is an official certificate from islamic authority stated that this hotel serves halal breakfast

No breakfast anymore, They canceled it since October 2023.

The room is mediocre, office chair tilt back is broken.
Dual shower head handle is missing, So water only can coming out of it one shower head.
Mildew in the grout follows exactly where shower sprayed area.

good affordable accommodation.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this hotel, from the moment I arrived, the staff were warm and welcoming.

The room was clean and good value for money. The hotel's location was also perfect, with easy access to local attractions and public transportation.

Overall, I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for great value for money and good location.

Good location. Clean rooms.  We are group of 6 friends taking 2 rooms with 2 double beds.

Many restaurants, shopping and eateries nearby the hotel. So convenient. Taipei Main Station also within walking distance.

Nice and clean hotel, the sheets are towels feel fresh ✨ i booked last min and checked in at night so i only paid 50$ but even double would be amazing. the receptionist was next level kind! he even came up to my room to give me some snacks because of the late hour and my long travel. there isn't too much going on at this location but its just a 10 min walk to taipei main station! even at 1 am i walked it solo (im a female) without feeling uncomfortable!
they have a really cute kitchen/lounge area with coffee tea and snacks.

I browsed through many hotels in Taipei and my requirement was that the room must have a window. Many hotels in Taipei do not have it which I don't understand. Finally chose this hotel and am very happy with it. The room looks exactly like the photos and is clean and spacious. The reception is on the 2nd floor and you need the keycard to access the main door so it is secure. There is daily housekeeping. The only con is that there is no bidet. The location is also perfect, walking distance to main station where u arrive and depart n also near to Ximending. There are also free snacks n water refill behind the reception. The rate is value for money. Would consider staying again!

reviews.text:
I had a very pleasant stay. All the staffs were polite and helpful. And the receptionists were friendly,  kind and helpful! I had the same lady when I checked in and checked out.

For Muslims,  their toilets equipped with hand bidet and the dorm is spacious enough for you to pray. I stayed in a mixed dorm for a little bit over a week.

The common area is cosy and all necessary patnry n kitchen facilities available.  Free tea and coffee, too.

Walking distances to multiple bus stops and about 10mins walk or so to nearest MRT. There's familymart few steps away FYI.

Highly recommended for my fellow Malaysians and Muslim travellers!

I did not have a pleasant experience in this hostel at all. The rooms were extremely small with no space to do anything. The showers were in very poor condition with no air-conditioning in the bathrooms or hallways. I found the staff very unfriendly and rude. For my last 2 days, I had to move out from this hostel to a different one (We Come hostel) for a more comfortable experience.

Only 4.1 stars? I'd give it 5.1 stars if I could!

I've been to a fair few hostels around the world and this is honestly the BEST hostel I've ever been to! (No that's not cut & pasted:)

The staff are so sweet and sincere. No superficiality or impatience like in some other hostels.  I even played the staff a little concert in the reception and they offered me cake.  It felt like a friends reunion 💃🎶🕺

The common room downstairs is also the best I've seen.  Huge Chillout room / Workspace.with lots of tables and comfy sofas.

All the other amenities are tip top and it's close to lots of great local street cafes where you can have a big meal for around 2-3USD and breakfast for under 2USD!

So thanks Ivy, Chen & Lee for making my stay feel like a home away from home ❤️🏠🌻

So come with a smile and enjoy😀

The place is a bit of a walk from TMS but if you like walking it's a good place. Amenities are ok and the rooms are good -- you get what you pay for. They have water, tea, coffee and cups available for everyone's use, also heaters in the shared showers. 0

It's alright!
Unfortunately, everyone keeps their shoes in the room.
Downstairs common room is amazing.
Great price and down a cute alley.
