reviews.text:
I stayed at Cho Hotel (町.記憶旅店) for the first time, and it was truly beyond my expectations.
The staff were extremely kind and always greeted me with warm smiles. Some of them can even speak a little Japanese, which made my stay even more comfortable and reassuring for Japanese travelers.

The location is perfect — just a few minutes’ walk from the nearest MRT station and less than one minute to the nearest convenience store. It’s very easy to access anywhere in Taipei.

The hotel has a cozy and nostalgic atmosphere, and everything is kept very clean. One of the highlights of my stay was the shared mini-bar area, which creates a friendly and relaxing space for all guests.
•	Spacious area with several tables and chairs — ideal for relaxing or doing a bit of work.
•	Free drinks, snacks, cup noodles, and even ice cream are available at any time.
•	The space is open 24 hours, so you can stop by for a quick bite or drink whenever you like.

Another great feature is the laundry corner — equipped with both washing machines and dryers. It was very convenient during my trip, especially for longer stays. Detergent was provided for free, and everything was easy to use.

The combination of great hospitality, thoughtful facilities, and an excellent location made this stay truly memorable. Cho Hotel feels more like a “home in Taipei” than just a place to sleep.

I would absolutely stay here again on my next visit to Taipei and strongly recommend it to anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and heartwarming service.

Quiet boutique hotel that is 5 min walk from ximending. The room is basic but clean. Compared to 4 stars and above, the rooms are pretty small. I would suggest getting the 3 bedded for a couple. The room price is value for money at that location.

There is lounge area at 2nd floor whereby there are cup noodles, biscuits and even sandwiches which you can help yourself to it for free anytime.

Exceptional stay, exceptional location for a reasonable price. I had a great time at Cho hotel. The staff are great, very responsive to requests, and will try their best to accommodate for you. Rooms are good, free laundry is awesome for the hot weather here, and the snack bar is the best!

We loved the style of the hotel which brings back so many memories of Taiwan growing up from the decor to the snack bar. The rooms are decent size and clean but lacks security box for those seeking one. Thought no breakfast is served, the hotel makes up for the wonderful variety of free Taiwanese snacks and drinks with instant noodles 24/7 and a short walk outside provides plenty of food options for foodies !
The hotel staff are very friendly and fluent in English which makes for easy and easy effortless check in and communication. There is also provision of self served laundry which was super handy especially during the hot and humid weather.

Cho Hotel – A Stylish and Welcoming Stay in Taipei
This was my second leisure visit to Taipei, and I chose to stay at Cho Hotel for two nights. The location is incredibly convenient—just a 10-minute walk to Ximending Walking Street, and very close to a Michelin-recommended beef noodle shop, which was a delicious highlight of the trip.
The hotel itself is beautifully decorated with a stylish and artistic vibe that adds character to the stay. One of my favorite features is the communal area, where guests can enjoy free drinks and cup noodles—a thoughtful touch that makes you feel right at home.
Overall, Cho Hotel offers a great blend of comfort, convenience, and creativity. I would definitely recommend it to others looking for a cozy and well-located place to stay in Taipei.

reviews.text:
Though the room is are small, the privacy option is very nice. Individual rooms are creativity constructed with beds located within an alcove, with one above the other. Each bed then has its own separate entrance, desk and door. There is an option for either single mattress or the double sized mattress.  The mattress themselves are think at 4 inches, however they are spring mattress and very firm, unlike foam mats which are common l used at other hostels or inns.

The dormitory rooms have four bunks and large lockers, which a suitcase can fit into.

There is a laundry and dryer on the third floor along with a clothing rack on the terrace.

The kitchen is full service, with induction stove top, pots and pans and a refrigerator, suitable for extended stay.

The common room is small, but comfortably located with stairs going up and down. Very well designed. There are a couple of small tables and a large dining table.

Given the coziness of the common room, I found it easy to engage and speak to others staying here. There is a blend of both Taiwanese and foreign visitors and I have met Americans, UK and Japanese while staying.

Perfect hostel for a budget. The rooms are 'capsule' style with around 20 double/single beds however very private when the blind to your bed is down. Very comfortable beds, good Aircon in the room, storage for you bags on the room. Bathroom was always super clean, fully stocked with toilet paper, shower gel and shampoo. A mixed dorm however very private with enough single cubicle showers/toilets. Great location near via routes and MRT. We also took advantage of the 'kitchen' on the top floor. Everything you needed to be able to cook meals utensils wise and a fridge freezer to use. Free hot water, coffee, tea, and drinking water from a dispenser at all times. Perfect for a budget in Taiwan

Stayed at this hostel for 6 days in a mixed dorm.  I would recommend it.

The shower and toilet were clean, and it gets cleaned daily.  Towels are available to rent and a few other amenities.

The bed was comfortable and clean.

Space can be limited (for mixed dorm single bed).  There are private single rooms, and double beds available.  Small storage is available enough to fit a carry on.  But guests with bigger luggage do store their luggage at the side.

The upper bunk is quite high so I suggest to those who have difficulty with heights to choose the lower bunk.

What stood out during the stay was the hospitality of the staff.  I would like to commend Ms. Liu at reception for her hospitality.  She attends quickly to matters.  Speaks great English so language barrier wasn't an issue. Definitely deserves a raise for her hard work.

Absolutely wonderful service at a budget-friendly price! The location is amazing—just a short 10-minute walk to the 101. Plus, there's a bus station right outside the door, and the MRT is not too far away either. How fantastic is that?

The location is really convenient. It’s less than a 5 minute walk to Taipei 101 and a red line subway station. There is also a small night market within 5 minutes. Lots of bus stops and convenience stores nearby too. The hostel itself is clean enough. I liked that each bed is its own “box”instead of did plain bunk beds like other hostels I’ve stayed in. Bathrooms are okay. They’re never really dry and the showers are small and making getting dressed annoying. They also don’t stock actual towels so bring your own or cough up the $39 NTD for a disposable body towel that doesn’t do much more than smear water around your body.

reviews.text: Highlight of the hotel stay is the breakfast buffet. Menu changes everyday and is good. DIY laundry service available for $50 (use the dryer). Room is okay in terms of size and cleanliness.  Sound proofing can be better so it's better you are not a light sleeper. Stayed 9 nights. Will recommend.

They took care of my baggage well before check-in. There is no water in the room. You gotta get it from lobby.
The room has poor soundproofing so i used earphone sometimes.

Best of the best! The breakfast is yummy and the staff are extremely nice and friendly. Even though it just a 3 star hotel but their service is definitely outstanding! I stayed 12 days with my mom, they really makes me feel like home. The room is clean and the location is AMAZING! 5 mins walk from MRT station.  I even got pineapple cake as a small gift in the NYE. I would highly recommend to this hotel if you wanna travel to Taipei.

Excellent service by a young chinese gentleman at the reception. Fast and efficient check in. He was very patient with elderly and young kids.

And friendly housekeeping staff (a pinoy lady) Will revisit this hotel again for a comfortable stay.

Note: pls avoid if you have walking issues as there's a flight of stairs to climb up to breakfast dining area

A very clean boutique hotel for a great sleeping night. The price is also very good for Taipei standards. It is so close to a train station and also a YouBike hire spot. There is also a little park nearby and there are plenty of restaurants, shops in this area so there is no need to worry about services. It is just 2km from the main Taipei Station and you can hire a YouBike to go back and forth to the Taipei Station!

reviews.text: The front desk team is quite helpful and warm. However, I can’t say the same about the bathrooms, unfortunately. Dirty is an understatement. The management needs to do something about it. Everyday cleaning is a requirement  for a bathroom.

I only stayed for one night, so I wasn’t too picky as long as it was clean and quiet enough for a good rest. Overall, the room was clean, with small windows allowing natural light to come in. However, the carpet felt a bit old, which gave it a less appealing vibe.

The bathroom design caught my attention—the floor was about 1–1.5 feet higher than the rest of the room, with only a single step to access it. While it wasn’t an issue for me, I can’t help but wonder if elderly guests might find it challenging. A slip could potentially lead to a tragedy, so I was extra cautious when moving in and out of the bathroom.

The bed was comfortable for me, with no issues, and the location of the hotel was great. There were plenty of shopping options and restaurants nearby. I even walked to Xi Men Ding from the hotel, which was very convenient.

Considering the price, I’d say it’s an average stay. I believe a 3-star rating is fair for what it offers. For me, considering the good location and fair price, I might consider staying here again if traveling solo. However, the dated decor and tired look of the hotel room do give me some pause. It’s a bit of a tough decision—good for practicality, but the oldness of the place might put me off slightly. Haha!

IS THIS REALLY A THREE-STAR HOTEL?
The bathroom is rusty and mouldy, the carpet has clearly never been vacuumed, and the wallpaper is stained. The location is not bad, but the quality of the room is disgusting.
I can't imagine how awful one-star hotels and two-star hotels are in Taiwan.

Pleasant service, wonderful rooms! Staff was very friendly and helpful, catering to our needs! The room was decently clean with no odd smells and tidy cleaning services! Excellent locality with splendid connections to the city’s metro and transport systems!

Its in a great location next to main station to get anywhere with public transport.  The place is old and very dated but clean. The staff is friendly.  They won't clean your room ea day unless you ask.  Its a bit tricky to find.  It shows on google maps, but note it's on the corner of the very busy road on the 3rd floor 3F. The sign on the building is only in Chinese.  See pics what to look for.

reviews.text:
stayed here for 4 nights and overall had a pleasant time! it was self check in at first and when we had trouble, the staff came to help us.
the room was spacious, was able to fit 2 big luggages and 1 small luggage with extra room to walk. only weird thing is that the sink is placed in the bedroom instead of the bathroom but we didnt mind that.
the hotel in general had a cozy vibe and was quiet when we stayed there. there was also a water dispenser at our level. would definitely come back!

I feel the only good thing about this hotel is the location is very near fengjia night market and i do not need to talk to another one to checkin to the room. Good for introvert people like me that doesnt like talking to people. Other than that it’s a no for me. I wish they have a dehumidifier and anything to remove the moisture from the air. You can literally see mould forming in the toilet. Also the room feel dusty. Called for housekeeping but they only fix the bed and refold the towels, i can tell they didn’t bother to change my towel (because the towel i use on day 1 have a hole, and after housekeeping, the “new” folded towel have that same hole) 🤦🏻‍♀️. Also the food crumbs that was on the dresser is not clean up during when they do the housekeeping. The room smells moldy too 🥶.

Cons
- Rooms have close to no ventilation and it smells like mould. as soon as you enter the hotel room, you can smell the sewage from the toilet even when the door is closed and inside the bathroom has fruit flies because of the lack of ventilation.
- The sheets, the towels, the pillows most of them have yellow spots and at night it’s very itchy. and the towels are from different hotels for some reason. we love recycling 🤩
- The room is really weirdly laid out. The sink is inside the main room, not the bathroom.
- The carpet feels like it’s never been cleaned and it’s very dusty - it triggered allergies
- I listened to many reviews to not use the shampoo and conditioner supplied however my partner used it and immediately got dandruff the next day.
- The windows are very dirty behind the curtain with spots of mould everywhere.
- because of the lack of ventilation, the sheets were very moist

Pros
- close to feng chia night market (but not a 4min walk, more like 10 min)
- W customer service : when we were unsatisfied, the customer service immediately helped us and was very quick and nice with it immediately changing our room.
- The toilet is heated and the shower is big and clean 😊

DO NOT BOOK THIS SUBSTAND INN. It is not a hotel. There is no one to help on the check in, and check in time is a late 3pm. NO ONE TO CHECK on Book out, and once your lock the door that's it. Nowhere you can place your belongings, and have to leave at a open space at risk. The toilet is old, and dirty. The flush does not work. I wonder why there are STILL positive reviews given, most likely to SABOTAGE you or next person. The ROOM HAS ZERO SOUND PROOF.  Motorbikes along the road screams at 2am till 4am. The layout of the room is insane, the wash basin point is next to the bed and not in the toilet. Other tenants can smoke and make noise outside your room as they like. If yon want to torture yourself, book this. I moved out quickly and did not bother. Now asking for money back.

Self check in/out service. However, there was a gentleman available if you have problems.
The room is small but the facilities are OK. No view. No bugs. No parking lot.
I'm not sure the price, this should be a budget hotel.

reviews.text:
We were so lucky to have chosen this hotel when we were traveling with my family to Taichung! It's incredibly close to the train station, and I give it a perfect score. We were so packed with luggage and worried about a long walk, but it turned out to be nothing! We were just a short walk from the train, and it felt incredibly relaxing.

Even though it was so close to the station, it was incredibly quiet at night, with no noise from outside. It was truly amazing. The location was convenient for everything, and it was a pleasant surprise for a last-minute booking. The quality was excellent, and the value was incredible. I'd definitely consider staying here again!

I originally just wanted to find a hotel near the train station to spend the night, but as soon as I entered the room, I felt that this one was great value. The decoration was simple and textured, and the bathroom was clean and bright, with a light fragrance that was very comfortable. I will choose to stay here again next time I come to Taichung.

I was on a busy business trip, and returning to my room at night was instantly relaxing. The room was well-insulated and the bed was incredibly comfortable, leaving me feeling refreshed for the meeting the next day. I highly recommend this hotel for business travelers.

I love the design of this hotel—simple yet warm. The rooms aren't large, but the space is well-utilized and doesn't feel cramped. The air conditioning is quiet, so it's completely comfortable at night. Breakfast is simple, but the coffee is delicious. The only minor drawback is the limited parking, so be sure to check in advance if you're visiting on a weekend. Otherwise, the overall experience was excellent.

This time, my family and I decided to stay overnight in Taichung. We found this Gll - Water's End and were pleasantly surprised. The room was clean and spacious, the children slept soundly, and the overall atmosphere was very relaxing.

reviews.text:
The Lin Hotel in Taichung truly deserves its reputation as one of the city’s most prestigious five-star accommodations. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the grand and elegant architecture that immediately conveyed a sense of luxury. The hotel’s expansive grounds are beautifully designed, offering not only a spacious outdoor pool but also a charming green garden area, which is an ideal setting for weddings or outdoor events. The atmosphere is both serene and majestic, making every moment feel special.

The staff were extremely professional and attentive, always ready to provide warm and efficient service. My room was remarkably spacious, tastefully decorated, and very comfortable. The soft carpeted floor added a cozy touch, making it especially pleasant to walk barefoot. Although my room did not include a balcony, the full-length glass windows provided a stunning view of the city, bringing in natural light that created a bright and welcoming environment.

The bathroom was equally impressive, equipped with modern fixtures and high-quality amenities that enhanced the overall experience. Every detail reflected the hotel’s commitment to luxury and guest satisfaction.

Another highlight of my experience was the breakfast area, decorated in vibrant green tones that created a fresh and welcoming ambiance. The buffet selection was outstanding, with a wide range of choices from Asian specialties to Western favorites, ensuring that every guest could find something to enjoy.
Overall, my stay at The Lin Hotel was nothing short of delightful. With its magnificent setting, excellent facilities, and top-tier service, I can confidently say that I was more than satisfied and will definitely return in the future.

Absolutely lovely stay at this hotel. We’ll definitely be back. The rooms are clean, spacious and luxurious. I adored the bathtub and separate rain shower! The view is gorgeous and the little touches made such a difference (like they had stocked the fridge with a coke can with my name on it! 🤩). Good service and everyone spoke Chinese and English very well. The fitness center is small but very nice, with towels and water available, and high-end machines. Adored spending time by the pool and the breakfast buffet was 🤤 out of this world. Can’t wait to go back.

Worst Hotel in Taiwan for Business Travelers
June 2025
I only take time to share the best and the worst. I tried this hotel because of its proximity to our international branch office located in Taichung NTC (National Trade Center), which is right next to this hotel.  Over the past twenty plus years of business travel to Taiwan, LIN is undoubtedly the worst hotel I have ever experienced. It is simply not a hotel for business travelers for the following reasons:
1.	No USB port to charge the iPhone. This hotel stays in the last century still.
2.	Even in the top-notch corner executive suite (#2124), the internet is unbearably slow, making it impossible to work.
3.	The executive lounge is important for business travelers to wind down after a long day of work. Unlike many popular loyalty programs such as Marriott Bonvoy and IHG One Rewards, the executive lounge at LINS is simply a joke:
a.	Who in the right mind would put happy hour from 3-5PM, purposely putting business travelers out of reach?!
b. The executive lounge on the top floor is not open most of the time. Instead, the bar on the 1st floor is used. The bar is nowhere near the comfort of the executive lounge. Worst of all, the food is controlled by the bar attender. One has to literally beg for some lousy finger sandwiches and bowl of salad. The main course for happy hour is usually one cheap dish like fried noodle.
4. It is important for business travelers to have the flexibility to change the schedule whenever needed. Over the past twenty plus years traveling in Taiwan, I have never had problem checking out earlier when business emergency calls for. However, I was not allowed to check out earlier w/o full payment, even when I gave plenty of advance notice. They simply ignore the difference between deposit and final payment and charge full payment upfront, thereby keeping guess hostage with money. Both my travel agent and Corporate travel director got involved, but in vain. We ended up checking out earlier with full payment, but blocking this hotel from our Corporate travel list going forward.

In general, this hotel is all about profit, without regard to international business practice and standard.  The front desk staff are simply rude as they have to defend un-defendable frequently. The breakfast buffet is chaotic, just like hungry peasants fighting for large selections of cheap food. It is not a hotel of class where guess will be treated with decency. It is a total embarrassment to the city and great people of Taichung.

Dr. Z

This is an absolutely stunning 5-star hotel that will give you resort vibes even though it is in downtown Taichung. The staff were above & beyond helpful. The facilities are breathtaking & the breakfast was on another level. 🫶🏻✨

Good rooms & amenities, large water bottles coffee tea complete with soft drinks and alcohol complimented, really no time to enjoy their Sky Bar but surely will return awesome hotel like it looking for next family trips.

reviews.text:
Good location but limited parking.
Hotel very modern & energetic style but the room too tiny. Overall, it is clean and comfortable.

We ordered the grilled pork rice, and the rice was sticky n hard just like reheat or overnight rice just warmed by the microwave 😅, food served with light warmed not hot. The fried platter was ok. The food served on the 1st floor could be better and improve to be better.

Moxy Taichung is a stylish and youthful hotel that delivers great value for money. I really appreciate its trendy visual design—from the bold colors to the fun neon signs, everything feels fresh, modern, and Instagram-worthy. The mobile key access is super convenient, and the gym is impressively equipped with proper weight training machines, which is a big plus for fitness lovers. I also enjoyed the nice city view and the cool rooftop bar with a fun vibe.

While I love the playful branding, some of the on-site activities feel a bit underwhelming. For example, the recent bubble tea event wasn’t very interactive—guests had to strain the pearls themselves, and the drink choices didn’t quite pair well with the pearls. It felt more like a task than something fun. I’d love to see more creative, engaging games that allow guests to interact and connect with each other.

One thing I truly hope can change is the restriction on bringing outside food into the lobby. The lobby is such a vibrant and cozy space—it would be perfect for relaxing with some snacks or takeout. Allowing guests to enjoy their own food there would really enhance the social atmosphere.

Overall, a well-designed and lively stay, with room to grow in guest engagement!

I’ve stayed at Moxy maybe five or six times, mostly because of  its great transportation access and all the nice places nearby.

It has such an impressive and unique style that I feel energized every time I’m there. As to the hotel design, the bold use of pink and black really makes the whole place special, creating a vibrant atmosphere across the interior design, promotional materials, and decorations.

The staff are quite friendly, and I really enjoyed the complimentary sparkling water and the great 24-hour gym. Plus, they seem to have a live DJ show every Friday, which adds an extra fun vibe to the experience!

The only downside is the limited parking. But honestly, I think they’ve tried their best and  make up for it by offering compensation if you have to park elsewhere, which I really appreciate.

You get what you pay for. It's a trendy budget hotel with a cool concept and chic branding. The location next to the MRT is convenient to travel to train and high speed rail stations. The room is very basic,clean and small. However the mattress, pillows and the bedding are quite comfortable. My room is on the 11th floor and very quiet. I love the water fountain which also offers sparkling water. Except for the young man who could be a bit more courteous I like this hotel and would recommend it for solo travelers who just need a one night stay.

Very cool and experience staying at Moxy!
A lot of cool facilities and cute corners to take photos. Although the rooms are a bit smaller than other Marriott hotels but it’s great for the price:)

reviews.text:
Hands down, hats off!

The Tempus Hotel is one of the best stays I have experienced in nearly 17 years of living in Taiwan!

In my opinion, the service, price and amenities surpass those of The Evergreen and The Splendor.

Seriously impressive.

The location is very convenient, with plenty of small and unique restaurants nearby adjoined with a warm, friendly atmosphere.

I was truly impressed and our front desk clerk, Stacia Liao, was incredibly helpful and professional.

My wife had one of the best birthdays ever.

Thank you, Tempus Hotel!
Not a bad walk from the train station. The room was fine - the mattresses were a bit hard. The listing showed washlets but our room did not have one.

The worst 5-star hotel I’ve ever stayed at.

1. The bedsheets were dirty, with a large reddish stain and several musty gray patches. The bathroom walls were also covered in mold.

2. The hotel's description on the booking platform was misleading.

---It indicated that access to the children's playground was included, but it failed to clearly state that additional charges would apply.
----Parking was extremely limited, so we had to park in a nearby private lot, as instructed by the hotel, which also incurred an extra fee that was not covered.
----Worst of all, we were only informed of these additional charges after making our reservation.

I loved it! Location is decent, near City Hall station. The interior is amazing for the price. My room was extremely comfortable and looks good. Even had a bathtub!

Some shortcomings: No pool or other amenities one might find in other hotels, and restaurant (breakfast at least) is quite limited in selection. However, this doesn't matter to me. Not like I would use them while I'm here. Breakfast was good despite the limited choices. A mix of Taiwanese style dishes and continental food.

Small things about the design of the room, using older key locks, lack of easily accessible power outlets make the say feel less than the number of stars on the hotel app. Overall, the stay was OK, and the convenience of the location to some personal business we needed to do made the stay worthwhile.

Hotel room is clean, service is good. Watch out is travel kit costs $ rather than free as other hotels. But super bonus point is its breakfast, high quality

First time staying here, loves the room that is spacious and neat. The staff especially from the F&B department, the chamber maid that in charge of our room clean up were friendly and giving their best service. Recommended to stay if you're looking for mid range .

For about $50 USD a night, it’s not terrible. Rooms are clean and there is a small gym and laundry facility is available. There is complimentary tea and coffee in the lobby, and you get water bottles daily. No disposable toiletries in the rooms, but they are available at the front.

However, walls are thin and I can hear the adjacent rooms. Fortunately, my neighbors were only loud the first night. Gym runs a bit hot and there aren’t many machines. Washers work fine but the dryers are absolutely awful - we dried our clothes for over an hour and they were still wet. There is a 24-hour laundromat a few minutes by foot, so we went there to finish drying.

Located close to Sogo mall as well as many small shops and eateries!

Really good stay here, 2 trips.
Amazing nights sleep, very comfortable and quiet, which is difficult to find in Taiwan at a reasonable price.
Powerful hot shower, clean bathroom.
Power sockets next to the bed, which sometimes not provided in Taiwan.
Staff are excellent, one young man with glasses during the day was particularly helpful.
Good breakfast, plenty options food and drink.
Free tea and coffee 24 hours. Laundry, small gym.
Good location for bars, restaurants, 7Elevens, sogo etc.
My new hotel for Taichung! See you next month!
EXCELLENT!!!

Ordered this hotel through Agoda, stating that the room is 725 sq ft. But this is more like 400sq ft. So not sure if it was false advertising or they simply didn’t respect what was offered. It was much cheaper than the other hotels in similar area.
Place is alright, nothing special considering it’s a 3 stars. Just a place to rest and sleep.
Had issues with insert for power slot but was quickly resolved by front desk.
Outdoor Parking available within the alley, first come first serve basis.
I ordered $3600 per/ night, totally over price!! It’s old and have a smell. When I asked for extra pillow I need to pay extra fee. Just can’t believe. NOT recommend at all!!

The light in the bathroom is way too dark. If you intend to shave your beard there you better bring a flashlight. The hotel in general is ok but way too expensive in comparison to other asien countries.

This is a gem of a place, we spent ten days here and the staff became like family. The food is amazing and the rooms are classic and comfortable. Good location and convenient to grocery shopping if needed.

Pretty standard for a downtown 3 star hotel, but rather cheap - got a deal with NTD 1,828 for a family room. The downside is bathroom smells like someone smoked in there. No tips required, but my friend tipped anyway.

The overall musky environment makes one feel physically uncomfortable. Spots and details of room are unkept, dusty and dirty. Hotel swimming pool is closed permanently, Good thing they have a big kid’s playroom to offer. At least the front desk staff was friendly.
Clean and value for money. Pretty spacious as I booked a family room. Got 2 queen sized bed and 2 bathroom. Parking is limited and you might have to parked opposite the sister hotel

There is an older main wing, and a newer wing across the road. We stayed in the new wing in a large room with two comfortable king size beds and two bathrooms/showers. The room was comfortable, clean and attractive. House keeping polite and efficient. Front desk staff helpful and efficient. The included buffet breakfast was a bit lacklustre, but plentiful and filling. The hotel stops the buffet at 10am weekdays. There is an adjacent large gym and swimming pool. Looked in the gym- seemed good, and quite busy. The pool is old-ish and outdoor, but large with plenty of space for loungers & tables. Water a bit cold for kids but ideal for swimming laps. There is a steam room, large jacuzzi (12 people easily) and another pool set up with high pressure jet massagers.

My daughter cut her foot on a sharp stone in the pebble-dash pool lining. The lifeguards very quickly got the first aid kit and patched her up very skilfully and gently (thanks lifeguard Tina!).

Didn’t try the seafood restaurant in the foyer of new wing, but it has beautiful salt water decorative tanks outside that the kids loved.

Good safe bet for a family hotel.

Very happy about the room layout as we dislike noise (especially with 2 little kids) and they put the bathroom most close to the road and the bedroom      is noise shielded by another door from the bathroom. Breakfast was nice varieties and staff were very friendly. Another puzzle is that in the night we can hear noise from other rooms, not sure it’s from upstairs or next door, luckily it went away as it got late.

Room is comfortable but all the hotel facilities are in another building which is not quite convenient, neither in the Dadun building nor the main building!
The swimming pool is big but remember to have your own sandals! The only one disadvantage of the pool is that the step ladder is made up of rock / granite, no matter you are coming up from or going down into the pool, it hurts and extremely uncomfortable! It’s really a stupid design!

The breakfast is normal, and there is only one coffee machine, queuing up for a century just for a cup of coffee! Besides, the food is normal, do not expect too much! The ventilation there is not good, full of oily cooking smell. How can a 5-star hotel manage like this?

Umbrellas near the door is a nice touch in this shower season.
Good hotel to stay but no swimming pool facility. Rest are ok. In dining hall items are limited. We have to self return the used utensils to the return area when finished.

overall, rooms are well kept, facilities are basic but works, air conditioning is lacking in several areas due to an emphasis on electricity saving.
Location is quite bad as it’s located in a rather rural area of taichung where there traffic lights doesnt even work.
Buffet is pretty good.

The location of this hotel isn’t very convenient and not accessible for public transportation… The quality of  the buffet is worth the price not a whole variety for dinner or breakfast… It needs more improvements to welcome more customers… The quality of the foods are not tasty as expected… As of the room service… hmm… not cleaned properly… It make you feel like the employees are lazy and not as efficient if the problem comes up…  The service of the front desk is not efficient and not effective on asked to be done service…. So!! If I have friends coming to Taichung I certainly won’t recommend anyone in this chain branch hotel… I think the owner and employees should be aware over the comments given in google for a better business on the future… It is a disappointing for the price and quality…

reviews.text: The location of this place is excellent. It manages to maintain a quiet atmosphere despite being in a busy area. It's not far from the Civic Square and the adjacent pedestrian street, yet the rooms are very quiet. The room isn't large, but I really like the hair dryer here. Usually, the hair dryers in hotels don't have much power, but this one is great. There is a small issue though. There's always a smell of paint wafting into my room. I'm not sure if it's from a new installation or fresh paint somewhere. If you're traveling with kids, it might be a good idea to check with the front desk. Since I'm only staying for two days, I didn't dwell on it too much and didn't ask to change rooms. That's about it. Looking forward to the next time.

The hotel is situated in a part of the city which is choc-a-bloc with both shopping and eating outlets. It is also
across from a pedestrianised area which turned into a vibrant area on Friday as families and young couples came out to take part in  the Christmas festivities.
The rooms are nice but have some quirks such as no drinking water in the room but has to be fetched from a water cooler. There was teaching and coffee but no milk and sugar, and no spoons to stir either. The bathrooms have some basic amenities like shampoo and a basic toiletries kit but spending from 2025, those have to be purchased as new government regulations on conservation kick in.
The breakfast was really good, especially the variety of dumplings on offer for breakfast.
Staying there due to a 2-night business trip. The room really shows the history, but still comfy enough. It is quite nice that some floors have free sparkling water dispensers.

Rooms appeared clean, but the overall atmosphere was stifling. It reeks of decades old furniture with a musty odor. 1 of the toilet doors cannot be closed fully as the hinge was off. Toilet was quite clean, but you can definitely feel the age as everything was yellowed out. One good thing was the huge and spacious room.

Parking was difficult to find initially, and there wasn't any staff around to guide us into the hotel parking lot. Someone from our car had to get down and rush to ask the counter the location of the carpark.

The breakfast buffet was a standard Chinese spread, but it wasn't very spectacular. The gym was downgraded to a single room with very limited equipment.

I will not recommend this hotel to anyone, due to its aging facilities and rooms.
Room is clean. Service is excellent. (The person at the door could called the cab for you.) Central to every place that's interesting. I will definitely coming back.

reviews.text: Rooms are great, clean and comfortable. I do wish lotion was included with the hand wash, body wash and shampoo. The robes were tiny, definitely not for a more typical Western body size. The breakfast was consistently good with a small selection. I found the sweetened fruit juices too sugary for my taste. Good coffee. When I first stayed there, the coffee, tea and snack amenities were refreshed each day and included sugar and stir sticks. Subsequent visits did not. The price is quite reasonable and the staff friendly and helpful. The bathroom mirrors have fun messaging and the bed headboards have great little reading lights. The vein matching on the tiles throughout the hotel are well done. The showers are great! Some rooms have nice city views. Unfortunately I didn’t have time for a tub soak or pool time. Maybe next time. Laundry service or laundromat are close by.

Nice rooms and a good price if you're getting the weekday special. Front desk staff were professional, but the cleaning staff came into our room even though the do not disturb light was on. The buffet staff was hiding behind the bar, eating breakfast. Fine. But, it was not clear where we should go and seemed quite unprofessional.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The staff were warm, attentive, and made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect—convenient to local attractions, restaurants, and transportation. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches and attention to detail throughout the property. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable experience!

Great place would definitely return. Only complaint - the lifts/ elevators are terrible. Three different ones with three different buttons. They need a software / system upgrade that syncs for certain floors if you press a button e.g. if you are on level 6 and press down, all 3 should sync and first one should come. Otherwise if you press one button, you wait for THAT lift. If you press all 3, after the first one comes the next two will also come, slowing down for everyone else.
Spacious rooms, decent breakfast, and nice pool. Unfortunately, from a western tourist point of view, nobody speaks decent English, which complicates all communication.

this hotel has Old School Charm with a modern vibe.  The staff are awesome, the location is close to many places, including the train station. The room is small but well-designed so it felt spacious enough. the bfast didn't have a lot of choices but the service was extraordinary and it was adequate.

Had an amazing stay at Old School Hotel. Rooms were super clean and quiet, the beds were very comfortable, and the pillows/blankets were so soft. Service was great as all the staff were nice and provided local recommendations. Location is also super central as it is close to restaurants & major attractions. I especially LOVED the free breakfast, it was probably the best free hotel breakfast I’ve ever had! Highly recommend this hotel if you are looking to stay in Taichung!
Location is central and room is spacious for accessible room. Nice staffs in assisting us too. Overall recommended to stay here if you are nearby. Lalaport is 6 mins away by taxi.

Worst hotel breakfast we ever had on 15/1/25. We were told set meal will be served and we have to choose one of two choices the day before, which is fine with us. What is not ok is they didn’t tell us it’s takeaway breakfast set they ordered not made in house. They don’t even bother to heat up the food and put them on a plate to serve you, but hand you the cold, soiled pancake in the plastic takeaway bag!!! Might as well don’t serve breakfast with this kind of do not bother zero effort attitude.

reviews.text: This hotel needs renovation, it was once a luxury place, now time has taken a toll on it. Still a good place to stay.

Our first stay was in pre-pandemic times. This hotel wowed us with the beautiful and clean rooms, courteous staff and delicious breakfast. On our second stay 5 years after, the rooms looked aged, dusty, and worn out. Definitely not as clean as before. The breakfast was changed from set menu to buffet style. It was good, but not as amazing as our first visit. They do offer a crib if you need one. We still had a good stay, but the 5 star quality is more of a 3-4 star now.

Room is not very clean, there is mold on the curtain, paint is peeling off of the ceilings, and carpets are heavily stained. Sheets are thin. There is no soap in the room and the staff would provide it—every other place I’ve stayed in Taiwan has, even the cheapest hostels. For the price, not worth it.

This is the second time live in this hotel, and I took my wife and my one-year-old son living two night. I will say anything all right here, which has excellent service, clearly room, and relaxed atmosphere. I think so it a smart choice to living this hotel if I take a trip to Taichung next time.

The room is clean and comfortable, and the bathroom facilities are also very complete. The air-conditioning blower is very quiet and cold; besides, the location is very close to Yizhong Street. The most important thing is the price is not very expensive. The breakfast provided is also very diverse. But the place which we use breakfast is not very large. The waiter who took the passengers to their seats was not very thoughtful. I saw a person sitting in four seats; therefore, I had to wait for a long time to have breakfast. Moreover, sometimes the door card could not be good at induction, I had to try a lot of time.

reviews.text: I'm hoping to share my recent experience at Kloud Hotel. The staff was incredibly welcoming and went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. We were greeted with warm smiles and helpful attitudes from the moment we arrived. The room was spotless, and the bed was incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep. I would highly recommend this place to anyone seeking a relaxing getaway. Overall, it was a truly memorable experience, and I can't wait to return someday. We are excited to have the opportunity to return. Also, it's near all the convenience stores and night markets

Surprised by how convenient the room was… we were a family of 4 and the room had 2 toilets and 2 sinks, it was really convenient… best sleep throughout our Taiwan trip on their beds and the rooms were new enough… we moved to another hotel for another part of the stay but we wished to have stayed longer… self check in/out worked well and was easy to dial for help for anything which arrived promptly… highly recommended

Check-in was very inconvenient. There was no receptionist at the desk. There are kiosks only. I couldn't search my booking on the system by both my name and booking number. I had to ring to check-in. Right after my phone call, one receptionist came over. She helped to find my booking. However, I had to wait until 3.00pm. (I arrived at the hotel at 2.20pm in very hot summer). The hotel does not allow early check-ins even one minute. If you can bear with this inflexible arrangement, please stay here.

Sorely disappointed that the service has been horrendous, especially the staff manning the buffet counter. We asked if we could take a look at the offerings prior but she replied to us (in a weary, absolutely done with life, annoyed) tone that the menu changes every day.

Have travelled to Taiwan numerous times, this is the first time where there was zero hospitality.

For the price, the rooms, while spacious but poorly designed. It is not that close to Feng Chia Market as reviewed online.

Would not recommend.

The experience is very high tech. When you enter the hotel you will be greeted by robots.

No receptionists, no valet and others. You check in by your self and ask assistance to carry your baggage to your room.

reviews.text:
Reasonable price, clean, and very easy to stay at. The security is a bit concerning since there are no staff around all the time, but there are cameras, and the lobby door locks at night—only accessible with a key card. Taiwan is generally safe, but it still felt a little unsettling.

The real dealbreaker, though, was the bed mattress. I almost gave this place five stars, but the moment I lay down, I wanted to cry. The mattress was way too soft, to the point where my back was killing me and I couldn’t sleep at all. I was planning to stay longer, but after that first night, I just couldn’t do it.

If they upgrade the mattress, it’s an easy 5-star stay. Super convenient, clean, fast booking, and the smoothest check-in/check-out process ever.

Overall not bad. the place is relatively new, the rooms are spacious and clean. the location is pretty good.

cons:
-the beds aren’t great. too soft and too short
-the staff is totally indifferent
-smart TV with no Netflix login

Booked at last minute but turned out to be one of the best hotels we stayed in Taichung. Convenient walk to night market, park. The room is spacious and clean. Customer service is also nice and genuine. Definitely will come back if we would travel to Taiwan again.

We stayed for two nights. Service was very friendly, room spacious with a window in our case and clean. We travelled with our bikes and had plenty of space for them.
Breakfast place « Mico » accross the street is very good.

Not recommend. Not worth to stay. I stayed a night during 228 memorial long weekend. Paid more than NT4000 for a night. No heater and the bed is too soft with uncomfortable feeling. If i know the price for normal day is 700-1000, I wouldn’t stay here. This hotel raised the price in weekend or holidays. Price raising is understandable but the service or facilities should be improved.

reviews.text:
2nd floor restaurant for breakfast provided a great selection of authentic Chinese style. Excellent waitress services, cordial conversations, and comfortable seating made our two days of stay a memorable experience.
Definitely exceeded my expectations.
Walking distance to Fengjia Night Market as well as some great eateries for breakfast. The room is also spacious for 3 adults and 1 toddler. There's also a nice coffee bar in the lobby.

room is very clean and nice. however, location is abit odd as it is beside many shophouses so the walk to the night market may be abit dark however it is a quick walk which makes it convenient! breakfast was nice as well

Overall, it’s a nice place to stay.

The room is spacious, clean, and well-organized, with easy access and wheelchair-friendly features. The lobby offers plenty of comfortable sofas and includes a pantry with complimentary coffee and tea, along with available restrooms.

The staff are also friendly.

In terms of location, it’s excellent—a short walk to the famous night market, yet set off the main road, so it’s quiet with no traffic noise.

However, the downside, in my opinion, is the breakfast. The selection could be more varied, and the taste leaves much to be desired. I would rather spend money and walk down the street for a better breakfast.

Rooms are clean and spacious enough for a two queen size beds which i stayed in.
Service is good. Staff came at once when i need help with my aircon.
Location is very near 逢甲夜市with alot of stalls offering great food. Price is of course slightly higher compared to other night markets. However, it is very lively and i have a good experience there. Some stalls will close early so you have to be there earlier than 11pm.

reviews.text: We had a decent stay here. The staff was very friendly although they didn’t speak English very well. They also had the option to store your luggage which is nice. But the whole time we’re there we had to use our data because the wifi didn’t work at all. The room we booked was big but not that clean there were some hairs in the bathroom that are clearly not ours. The bedroom area was clean. The location is very nice since you can easily go in the city and you are nearby the station. The breakfast menu was okay. But I would say the hotel to expensive for what you get.

It is rated as a 3 Star Hotel
To me, should be a 2 Star
Rust and soap scum on the shower
Mold and mildew in the grout
Burn mark on bathroom counter
No toilet paper had to go to front desk and ask for more
No soap for sink
Only shower towel, no face towel. Towel felt thin and cheap and hard, like it's 20 years old
Shower soap dish has what looked like old melted bar soap in the soap dish but no bar soap for the shower, it was liquid soap
Cheap and stained carpeting
Thin walls, can hear neighbors
Constant humming like a machine
Hear running water off and on, as if someone is showering next door or when they flush the toilet or a leaky toilet, not sure but the running water noise was coming from the walls
Dirty window inside and out
Unstable and slow wifi
Gave us 2 key cards for the door but only one worked
Come to find out in the morning, my daughter's room next to our room had a water leak from her ac vent and it soaked half her bed. She said she was too tired in the middle of the night to switch rooms.
I looked at her room and her room was in worse condition than mine. Her shower looked like it hadn't been washed for several months. The gasket around her shower door was falling out

Pro
Great view of old Taichung Station and plaza
Right across the street from Station
Good ac
Staff was nice
Location is awesome. Very convenient to the train station

Not a good value for the price
Stay somewhere else
I would rather pay a bit more and walk a bit longer for a better room

Absolutely horrible, arrived and to my shock they did not provide towel, when I went to the receptionist to ask for towel, rudely she told me they ran out and just gave me floor mats and said use this, u can take it or leave it. I was shocked by the receptionist response.

The WiFi also is horrible it let's me connect but it always shows connected without Internet.

Bed is uncomfortable and the room is noisy. Thank God this was the last place i will be staying before returning back to my country. I was so tempted to cut short the stay and just take the next flight back. Really do not recommend this hotel to anyone. The only saving grace is the 7-11 that is right downstairs and it's right by the train station.

This hotel is not worth the price. The room was small and not really clean. The shower head holder was broken, and we didn't even get a piece of soap. The AC doesn't really work since it's centrally controlled, which means the room doesn't cool down (we got it down to a cozy 25 degrees Celsius). The laundry room and the gym are closed. The proximity to the train station is the only saving grace for this (otherwise I would only give one star). It seems like the owner doesn't care about this place and just wants to make as much profit as they can before selling it for cheap.
Room was big and the A/C was alright. Breakfast was okay. Not too much choice, it was the same for the drinks. Wifi unfortunately didn’t work at all.

Other than, this a wonderful experience.

10/17 -Another beautiful stay. (OCTOBER). I always feel..
TAKEN CARE OF! Ms
Lai was on duty at the front desk. This lady knows about customer service. Ate to my heart's delight. 👍
Three stays at Talmud this September. The front desk staff is friendly and very accommodating. I'm trying to figure how they: Are so reasonably priced...and can give you a very good breakfast...included/Serve snacks and drink 24hrs...included. Great location, close to transport, shopping malls and a huge nightmarket.  Have nice rooms, clean beds and professional service...ON PAR WITH BIGGER HOTELS? Great value Talmud...your service is appreciated.

This is a neighborhood local hotel with almost a busy short staying tourist a perfect quiet rest for evening. My staying experience was comfortable air conditioned room (cool & nice), well there is no fancy tea/ coffee, for those I don’t care much. Comfort clean bed is what I care. Shower & restroom very clean new feeling, enough to satisfy me to give 3 stars overall!
Breakfast was decent for taiwan standard, room is strategic located 15min walk from fengchia. The only cons is late checkout is charged per hour. All thr staffs was very nice and friendly.
Breakfast is great with variety of choices & vegetarian friendly. Great breakfast service

reviews.text:
Loved this hotel!
Rooms are spacious and clean and contemporary, the toilet is great and modern, with a Japanese style toilet!

Not relevant but a personal opinion:
The only downside (not everyone would be bothered) is that when you turn the lights to sleep, it doesn't get 100% dark. You still see the TV light, the emergency light, the corridor light, the light switches lights, the Aircon light, etc etc... little lights that actual bother me and need to cover. Once again, personal opinion but I wish they had more empathy when installing stuff in the rooms.

This is such an affordable and nice hotel in the very heart of Taichung. You can take the public transportation next to the hotel and easily explore the city without own car. The rooms are beautiful and spacious, and QUIET!!! The staff is really nice and help whenever they are needed. I absolutely can recommend this stay if you visit Taichung! And yes, will be back

We truly loved our stay here. They had delicious snacks in the pantry. The room was bright and clean and the staff were extremely friendly. Thank you to blue sky hotel for such a great stay for our first time in Taichung ! 🥰

Wished we could've stayed at this hotel longer! Only had a one night stay here but loved everything about this hotel. Friendly staff, great location and excellent rooms that are spacious and thoughtfully designed with very comfortable beds.

Very nice and very clean. We extremely liked the decor. We never saw any bugs or anything like that. Internet worked great. Staff was very friendly.
Oh my gosh the shower was amazing. Very hot and very good water pressure.

Staff was not helpful, it has a sign that states there might be police inspection at night and we are obligated to open the door for police inspections. The room and towels smell like cigarettes smoke, I think it’s a smoke friendly hotel. Location is bad whereby the taxi driver doesn’t know where the hotel is. Will not come back again and not recommended if there is other options.
The room is spacious and the price is very very reasonable. Its near LWH. Also when i came it at 12pm they let me check in already
Good place, nice environment, excellent faculty, highly recommend and have parking place which is a plus.
Simply cheap.

A mediocre and truly dated hotel. Positive: Very friendly and helpful staff. There are also three washing machines. Otherwise: Rooms are quite worn; the heating in the left dryer doesn't work, and the drum in the right one stops as soon as there are more than five items of clothing in it. For cockroach hunters, there's plenty of wild prey. Hence only 2 stars.

reviews.text: We stayed at Hotel Initial-Taichung for 4 nights. We requested our room to be clean before we left the hotel in the morning. When we returned at night, we noticed housekeeping did not clean our room. We asked the front desk for clean towels because we were too tired and just wanted to shower and sleep. Next day, we let the front desk know that no housekeeping cleaned our room yesterday and asked them to make sure housekeeping cleaned our room today. They apologized and said will make sure housekeeping clean our room. We left the hotel in the morning, when we returned in the afternoon to put away our shopping goodies in our room. We noticed housekeeping has not clean our room yet. We let the front desk to know and asked to clean our room. They assured us to send housekeeping to clean our room. However, when we returned at night, housekeeping only replaced towels in our room. They didn't make our bed and clean the floor.

Straightforward checking in and out processes. Room is comfortable and clean, comes with all the amenities required. Location is close to the Gancheng bus station, convenient for those catching the tourist shuttle bus to sun moon lake.
Room was decent. Location wise, its ok. Not the nearest to the main train station, but not a far walk. Would stay here if I were to visit TaiChung again.

Room hygiene is low, it is dusty on the table, basin, and also the phone. The bathroom mat has dirt. The aircond is very loud, the wind blows directly to the bed from top, it is making my face dry. The dusty environment triggered sneezing. Somehow the bedding made us itchy as well, recommend to wear long sleep wears.

Soundproofing is extremely low. We can hear people talking and walking very clearly. There is a toilet next to our room, the flushing and water tank refill noise are so loud, it woke me up a few times in the night.

Walkable distance from Taichung Station, not extremely near, yet not far either. In the middle of Asean area, convenient access to eateries.

Customer service is neutral. Water dispenser is provided, with free coffee too. To be frank this hotel is too expensive for the value it is providing. Not recommended.

Staff speaks fluent English, and hotels are clean, but room space and design is terrible to the point I that if i open my luggage on the floor i wont have any space to move or sit. Great thing they provide free snacks in the lobby and they stream movies as well 😂 its a nice touch that i never seen in other hotels

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at the Golden Tulip Taichung! The hotel is modern, clean, and very comfortable. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, always ready to assist with a smile. The location is great too—peaceful but close to many attractions.

One of the highlights of my trip was visiting the nearby temples. They are beautiful, full of history and tradition, and offer a calm and spiritual atmosphere. It's a perfect combination of modern comfort at the hotel and cultural exploration just around the corner.

Highly recommend both the hotel and taking time to explore the local temples!

I love the location of this hotel.  Its close to the port, also a local community park where I can go and absorb the local vibe while taking a jog.

I also love that it is close to my favorite local hidden gem we discovered call Yocano coffee.  It is absolutely buttery and delicious.

I highly recommend this hotel for the location, convenience and they speak English.
Fantastic experience! Huge thanks to Ivy! Her attentive, friendly, and efficient service made all the difference. Definitely recommend!
We use this for a rest before we join our shop for a 6 week rotation. It's a nice hotel, but very limited for food & drink options.

Very nice rooms, everything is set up very comfortable, very clean! The shower and toilet work perfectly! Beds are wide and comfortable, two pillows for single beds, four pillows for king beds. Close to Mitsui outlet.

reviews.text: Staff were willing to change my reservation from a triple to a double room after my friends who were supposed to come with me couldn’t anymore. Very good location near Calligraphy Greenway and across from Sixth Market. There was a mosquito problem in my room, and I was awoken two nights in a row from their itchy bites, but they didn’t have any plug-in mosquito repellent available. They should probably look into the issue: I am wondering if the mosquitoes are coming in through the shower drain since I’m very careful about closing my room door. I could also hear stomping from upstairs in the evenings; and because it’s central, I also heard revellers yelling outside late into the night. Cute hotel at a reasonable rate though, and it had ample power outlets for me to plug in and charge all my devices.

Great location and reasonable price. Perhaps not the best choice for light sleepers as noise from the street can definitely be heard even late at night, but not outrageously so.

Wifi worked fine and staff was very friendly.

The room is very dated. Bed is very firm. Aircon doesn’t work well. The wifi is really unstable and we are in Taiwan! Location was great but also means high traffic noise. Bathroom is noisy. Poor quality of soap and shampoo. Do provide daily water and snacks like popcorn and tea egg at the lobby. Would be 5 stars if there is some renovation done or at least, fix the wifi and invest in the room. Cups and kettles were not clean too.

The location is near the SOGO Department store and many restaurants, very convenient. The room is spacious and the bathroom has shower and clean.  The staff is very friendly. I stayed twice and in my last stay I forgot my eye drops when I left. I called the hotel from Taipei and they promptly mailed the eye drops to the hotel I was at in Taipei. They really provide good service and I will go back there.
Hotel is clean & tidy and the front desk in charge person Ms Tong are so helpful 😀👍

reviews.text: Had a great stay at the Splendor Hotel for a conference.  The room was nice and breakfast buffet was exceptional!  The staff was probably the most notable -- Bruce Yu at the front desk was most helpful when we had minor air conditioning issues in the bedroom of the suite.  He had maintenance right on it and even offered a fan to spread the A/C from the main room.  We really enjoyed are stay!

I recently stayed at this hotel from Oct 2 to 5 with my friends in a room for four, and it was awesome! The room was big and nicely decorated, with clean and comfy beds. The check-in was very easy and the stuff very friendly. After we went up to the room we saw some stains on the bed sheets but after we reported it to the stuff they changed the sheet immediately. All in all the room is good for the price.

I had such a great experience at this hotel, thanks in large part to Tina at the front desk. She was warm, welcoming, and went out of her way to help me adjust my stay. Her patience, attentiveness, and professionalism made the whole process and stay effortless and stress-free. She was also incredibly helpful in answering all my questions and making sure I had everything I needed throughout my stay.

My room was clean, spacious, and incredibly comfortable, with a modern yet cozy feel. The air conditioning kept the room nice and cool, the Wi-Fi was fast and the location was convenient — just a short walk to Taichung Train Station. I felt well taken care of and would absolutely stay here again.
Just a short walk from Taichung Station. The room is clean and modern. They have self check-in system, great for introverts like me! Would come again.

The environment was very welcoming and clean. I felt very safe and comfortable. The staff were wonderful - so helpful and so friendly, especially Lily! This was my very first time in Taichung and Lily made me feel so welcome, like I had just arrived home. The lobby is very cool and they had a complimentary homemade herbal drink available during check-in. Lily gave me fantastic recommendations and there was so much to see in the area that was within walking distance. During my very brief stay, I went to an iconic Taiwan cafe called Hausic 1035, recommended by Lily from Check INN. The vibes were so lovely and modern and fresh. I loved the coffee and the design and atmosphere were perfect. I also visited the original 春水堂 (Chun Shui Tang) and had a delicious dinner. I ended the night at Don Don, a cute spot for 芋圓 (Taiwanese sweet potato/taro balls on ice). There were so many other places I wanted to visit if I only had more time. Check INN was the perfect spot and I will absolutely be returning when I come back to Taichung.

reviews.text: Stayed here for four days on a business trip with my family. Most of the staff were helpful and attentive, which is commendable. However, I still want to reflect couple issues with our four-person family room, room "816". First, there were unexplained plumbing noises both at night and during the day. Second, the bathroom ventilation system wasn't working. When I reported it to the front desk, they did only suggest me to bring a dehumidifier to bathroom rather than check the problem. Finally, even the hair dryer wasn't working; it didn't produce hot air. Fortunately, a different room solved most of the issues!

The breakfast was mediocre, which was a bit disappointing for a 4-star hotel—I expected a better buffet. The room was clean but somewhat outdated. None of us slept well, and the beds definitely need an upgrade. They also didn’t provide any toiletries, which can be inconvenient for foreign tourists. The only upside was the location. Given the price range, I’ll likely choose a different hotel next time I visit Taichung.

We proceed to change our next day lunch reservation for the family gathering. Initially we spoke to a gentleman on the phone who refused to tell us his name and told us that the availability was all he had and that was all. We went to the restaurant and spoke to Gloria Kuo, she gave us options either that or a room which could accommodate 20 people. She was friendly and would work with us to accommodate the changes. reviews.text:
Location – ★★★★★
The hotel is conveniently located about a 10-minute walk from Fengchia Night Market. There’s a bar and KTV on the ground floor, but thanks to excellent soundproofing, there was no noise disturbance at all. Even though the property sits right along a main road, the rooms remain pleasantly quiet. Full marks for this.

Room – ★★★☆☆
The room itself is dated, and the carpet clearly hasn’t been maintained well — to the point where I felt uneasy walking barefoot. On the positive side, the bed was very comfortable and free from dust, which I greatly appreciated given my dust allergy. We enjoyed a restful sleep, and the pillows were of good quality. The bathroom, while functional, was small and the floor was extremely slippery. Although a warning sign was provided, I’m not sure why it was that slick — it gave the impression of not being cleaned properly. Overall, I would rate the room 3 stars.

Breakfast Buffet – ★★☆☆☆
Breakfast was a disappointment. The selection was very limited, and on our second day, we decided to eat elsewhere as there are plenty of good breakfast spots nearby. Additionally, there is a 200 NTD charge for children, which feels steep for the small spread offered. It would be much fairer if children up to 12 years old could dine free. While the food tasted good, the variety simply wasn’t there. What surprised me most was being required to clear our own plates, cups, and utensils — something more fitting for a fast-food setting than a hotel. The dining area is also quite small, which makes this policy even more inconvenient. I would rate breakfast 2 stars.

Overall
While the staff were friendly and accommodating, the condition of the room and the underwhelming breakfast experience left me disappointed. I would not choose to stay here again on my next visit.

reviews.text:
Room was clean. The room was a decent size. Everyone at the front desk was nice and helpful. On the 6th floor, the hotel has a washing machine (with a supply of detergent) and a dryer that guests can use for free. They also have a kitchen and living room area just above the first floor. I stayed in the area because I wanted to be able to walk to Fengchia Night Market. But, next time, I won’t stay in the area because the smell of stinky tofu at night is so strong that you can’t open the window. One suggestion I would make to the hotel owner is to use a different towel cleaning company because the detergent used to wash the towels smell slightly bad.

At Fengchia Night Market, be sure to get the pepper meat cakes where they cook them by sticking them to the sides of an oven. They have similar things at Raohe Night Market in Taipei. Other recommended places to eat are PAUL cafe, Shann Rice Bar at Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, 9th floor, and Shan Shin restaurant.

Innk is a decent hotel in a great location near lots of food and a great place to explore Taichung. Overall experience is good however the checkout experience was not very nice. We were under constant calls even before the checkout time to ask us to check out. Its not a pleasant experience feeling under pressure and unwelcome. Also we couldn't locate one of our cards that we know is in the room somewhere so we were charged extra.
I think the hotel can do more to relax on this point, train the staff to be more relaxed and considerate then would be a better experience.

Our stay was great until checkout. Just 10 minutes before checkout time, the front desk called telling us we had to leave immediately or pay extra — even though the next guests check in at 3 PM. We spent a lot of money here and simply needed a few minutes to pack, yet there was zero flexibility or courtesy.

On top of that, they warned we’d be charged if we lost our room keys. These strict, unfriendly policies are not what a service-oriented hotel should have. The hotel needs to change these rules — this is supposed to be hospitality, not enforcement.

We loved our stay at Innk Hotel.
Family of 5 and we got a studio room with two double beds and bathroom upstairs. Big livingroom, terrasse, bathroom downstairs.
It was very comfortable staying there and the staff where very helpful. I had some inquiries before we arrived. They wrote a post it note and handed it to me when we checked in.
Which bus we should take to the different places we wanted to go and how long time it would be walking after getting off the bus. They where also very helpful with our daytrip out of Taichung.
Very easy to get to Fengjia Night Market and a lot of stuff to eat just downstairs.
A very cozy hotel. I stayed here with my family of 5. We love that it’s really close to Fengjia night market so it’s very lively ! And many eateries around too. Highly recommend !

reviews.text: If you’re visiting Taichung, this is the hotel to pick—friendly staff, new and spotless rooms. Despite being close to Fengjia Night Market, it’s quiet, and there are lots of great breakfast spots within walking distance. I’d stay here again.

The hotel was excellent – the lobby smelled pleasant, and the staff were very helpful. They even assisted us with using the washing machine. The room was quite spacious, and the bathroom was clean. I would rate it 5 out of 5.

Impressed with this boutique hotel. Spotless, love wood flooring without carpets, open wardrobe, luggage rack, free snacks and bottled water. Room is nice but a little tight for 2 persons but since I'm alone, it's comfortable. Bathroom is a good size, standing shower with good water pressure and heats up fast, Jap style bidet toilet with warm toilet seat. Basically it has everything you need in a room for a short stay, except disposable toiletries which you can purchase at the reception. They do provide hair and body wash in the shower and interestingly, no rack for you to put toiletries if you brought your own. Bed and pillow are firm, the way I like it.

They provide free non-alcoholic drinks at the bar every night (1 per pax per room so I was given 6 coupons). Basically you can order anything

What a wonderful find! We did a quick overnight stop here and will definitely be returning. The staff were very accommodating of our daughter, offering extra bedding and very quick service. Also, a really nice touch to be offered a welcome mocktail upon arrival. Would love to try their cocktails next time as the bar staff look very professional! Room was comfortable and overall the interior design is very tasteful. Small gym but enough for a quick morning workout. The only thing to pay attention to is the lack of onsite parking.

Normally, I never ever provide review to any hotels I stayed no matter how good they are, but this hotel is exceptional, here’s why:

If you ever want to find a hotel that located 700m away from FengJia night market, a comfortable distance to walk back after all the good food, this is the hotel that you definitely you do not wish to miss. They completely changed my view towards Taiwan’s accommodation standards.

1) Staffs are incredibly well mannered and very patient towards all our questions
2) All snacks and drinks in the rooms are yours to consume. For free.
3) The room’s brightness and designs are so carefully designed that you can’t really notice if there’s anymore weakness from it
4) Two beverage voucher to claim from the bar for free. Alcohol beverage require top up at a very reasonable amount.
5) Shampoos, lotions, all are high quality products.
6) Beds are so comfortable. Duvet covers and pillows are properly cleaned.
7) Room service is swiftly and efficiently done.

I am currently still in Taipei at the moment but I started miss this hotel already. :(

Kudos to all the teams that handled this hotel. I wish you all the very best. Will definitely 100% stay in this hotel again when I’m in Taichung

reviews.text:
The room doesn't look like the pictures. It's very dated with stains on all the furniture.

Prove is reasonable for the area, but they tried to charge me for parking, which was included in the price. I negotiated the $150 off the room rate, as they only take cash, and they didn't put up a fuss, but I would have preferred if it was all included as it was supposed to be.

The communication with the owner was also difficult, since he didn't speak English, and only started using WhatsApp AFTER we'd arrived trying to find the car park. More detailed instructions for where to park, including photos, would have been good to receive BEFORE we got there, but there's no way of sending photos through Agoda.

The person who met us at the reception after we'd parked was very good and he spoke good English, which was a relief.

For one night, it's fine. But I did feel dirty in the room.

From booking, key collection, parking, and check-in instructions, everything was clear and smooth. The room was comfortable and clean, and the owner thoughtfully left a small gift of toothbrushes and cups for the children.

The view from the high-rise building is truly stunning, and the hotel's location is perfect. You can go out for a late night meal on Meicun Road and still be within walking distance of your room. It was a fantastic stay, and the weekday rate is an excellent value! Highly recommended!

We chose this accommodation to take our kids to visit the National Museum of Natural Science. The location is incredibly convenient, within walking distance, with no need to queue for parking. There's also a wide variety of restaurants nearby, and best of all, the views from the higher floors are fantastic.

From check-in to check-out, the owner's attentiveness was evident.

This is truly the most super, super, super worthwhile accommodation I've stayed in Taichung so far! The view from the 31st floor is truly breathtaking. The view from the two large windows is truly soothing and perfect for daydreaming and relaxing. 🤩 The room was spacious, and it was comfortable for four people to sit on the floor while eating and watching TV. They even provided delicious cookies. 🍪 The big TV was so luxurious, and the children gave us a TV. 🌝 Although the room had an old-style hotel design, it was well maintained and very clean. It was so comfortable that I didn't want to go home. 🥹 The design of the bathroom and the corridor outside is very similar to that of the Tokyo Disneyland Hotel. I think the lighting is good and it really looks like it. 🤣 There are even flowers along the corridor. 🌷🌷🌷 Coincidentally, everyone in our group had stayed at the Tokyo Disneyland Hotel before, and we really thought this old-style design was very Disney-like. The Disney-style hotel, this retro Disney feel is so lovely 🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻
Not to mention the staff was incredibly nice, from booking and arranging everything to showing us all the great places to eat, drink, and play nearby. They even prepared a projector for us to use for my birthday celebration 📽️, and were so worried we wouldn't miss the beautiful sunset. It was so adorable 😍 A five-star review isn't enough; I need 100 stars. 💫 There's a staff member on the first floor who can help with your luggage. You can check out and then come back to pick it up. Thank you, staff! 🙏 This is truly five-star service. We're so grateful to Xingcao for giving us such a wonderful stay and experience. We've decided to stay here again when we visit Taichung. 🥺🥰☺️

The top floor offers panoramic views from two windows, thoughtful furnishings, and thoughtfully designed accessories.

Due to its age, maintenance is challenging, and imperfect.

The price, accommodation, and channel selection are comprehensive.

Independent air conditioning and blankets placed in the cabinets allow for a relaxing and restful night's sleep.
