reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my time visiting Taichung and staying at this hotel was a big reason.

The location is fantastic and the rooms are nice and clean. The highlight for me though is the staff. They are so friendly and hospitable. They offered plenty of tips to help me make the most out of my time visiting Taichung. Would absolutely stay here again!

Loved the Japanese vibe.  The rooms are small but complete with amenities, hair dryer, fridge, safe, tv. U just have to be creative in storing your stuff.
There is eating area with coffee machine and microwave oven. We borrow 2 pin charger from staff and they are very accommodating.
Location very good，room service out outstanding. very clean. The front desk lady is really nice. I will come back In the future.

Best service ever. I lost my phone and I couldn't believe Petet Qiu helped me from the night until the next morning. I texted my wife using his phone, he took me to the Police Station & Information Center. He prepapred me umbrella, he helped me to withdraw cash, he carried my heavy gifts, luggage. The room is nice with good scent, no cockroaches, and the staff is nice too. They offer nesle beverages for free. Everything here worth every pennies. Recommend to try. It actually saved my life. I can buy a new phone but Peter Qiu saved my data, you know. So please choose them. Best service ever.

The motel provides a good stay overall.   Very convenient walkable location to/from the Taiwan Rail train station of TaiChung.  Although the room is not as spacious as shown in photos, it is just enough for 1 person.  Bathroom is clean.

At the 2/F registration area, there is free water (room temp & hot), tea bags & various types of coffee one can get from the machine.  There is a shared fridge too, if anyone needs to put things there.

A couple things the motel can improve:

1) It is unknown to me that beds will not be tidied up like in a normal hotel/motel, even after I have put the "Please tidy up room" sign on the door.

With all the instructions and signs given, this piece of information should be provided to all guests --- for example by messaging before guest arrival, or more preferred when guests check-in at the reception.

2)  The shower door is not tight after closing, so water easily splashes out at both gaps of the shower door.  I pointed the shower head down while shower, so tried not to splash water out, but still cannot avoid the floor to be wet outside the shower.

3)  The bed's flat sheet is not fixed around the bed.

Besides these hiccups, which I hope it could improve these soon, overall the motel is worth staying there.

reviews.text:
I stayed 4 nights in June with family of 3.
-The hotel sells hourly or few hours rate, so it is quite noisy during late night and early morning. Room sound insulation is very poor. Did not have good night sleep at all.
-Bathroom door doesn't have lock
-Doesn't have bus stop or MRT station nearby to the main attractions of Taichung.
-Elevator has no security control. Anyone can use it.
-Room and common area are clean and spacious. Free snacks and drinks

Highly recommended!!!
The room is spacious, has all the amenities you need, and best of all, the price is very affordable. It's definitely worth the money.

Quick check-in, lots of plug-ins, strong shower water pressure, clean room, good chair, good desk & drawers, colorful amenities, Philips Smart TV, Panasonic washlet, everything is fine EXCEPT poorly soundproofed walls and doors. You can hear the noise from your neighbor much more clearly than the splash from your bathroom.
Still, this renovated hotel is highly recommended. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I lost my valuables at this hotel. They are real silver earrings and a necklace. Normally, I wouldn't have put them near the sink, but I was so tired and had an early morning tour that I forgot to store them somewhere else. When I returned to my room after the tour, the room had been cleaned, but my valuables were gone. I had a suspicion that someone had stolen them, but I couldn't prove it because I didn't have any evidence. I checked all my luggage, but I couldn't find them, so I told the hotel front desk. I exchanged emails with the hotel all day, and I decided to meet with the manager at 9 p.m. to talk about the incident. However, the manager I met at 9 p.m. was not fully aware of the situation. I had been emailing the hotel about the incident since the morning, and I didn't understand why I had to explain everything to the manager again. The manager even suspected my mother, who was staying with me, which made me very angry. I am a Korean travel blogger and have many SNS followers. The hotel did not take any action until I told them about this. I told them that I would not confirm that she was a thief, but I would leave a review on my blog, SNS, and Google to be honest about what happened.Regarding this, the hotel said that they should send me an email saying that they will not take legal action. Then, out of the blue, they said they would refund my accommodation fee. The hotel's response to the refund made me feel like the perpetrator, which made me even more upset. I ended up going to the police station and reporting the theft. They refunded me the hotel fee, but the amount was less than 1/3 of the price of the money I lost. Since they are no longer being manufactured, I can't buy the earrings and necklace again. These are the products I have been wearing the most for 10 years and because of that incident, I had to spend one day of my trip in ruins. I cried all day and felt really bad.
I can't say for sure that the housekeeper is the thief, but I think it's reasonable to suspect that only the earring and necklace were missing after the room was cleaned. In order for this hotel to be maintained, they need to retrain the staff or hire new people.
The hotel was so cold I couldn't sleep. My nose was freezing all night and the humidity was so high that my whole family caught a cold.
Convenient with lots of nice food downstairs

reviews.text: Great place.  Superb bed. Friendly English speaking staff.  Free laundry room including soap.  Right next to train station and nearby night markets

We stayed here for 3 nights during our stay in Taichung. We are a family of 3 (with a 1 year old baby)

Pros -
- Superb location, just 3 minutes from Taichung station where we had arrived at from Hualien.
- Loads of eateries around the hotel, most in walking distance.
- Staff is friendly and helpful with all our requests.
- Free laundry and a nice waiting area. We used this twice during our 3 day stay.
- Free-flow water and coffee supply on the ground floor. The coffee wasn't great though.
- Comfortable bed, not too hard/soft.
- Our request for a baby cot was fulfilled, though it meant compromising on the space in the little room.
- Good shower pressure. We were provided with a baby tub, which made bathing our baby easier.

Cons -
- Rooms can be cramped and if you are tall, the bed can be restrictive.
- Temperature control in the rooms is. a bit painful, it can get too hot or too cold over the course of the night.
- WiFi is just ok, downstairs is better.

Acceptable stay for 3 nights in Taichung. Room was acceptable for 2 pax, bed size is queen. Room wall abit thin which can hear sound if someone is making love. Breakfast was acceptable,  not much variety. Location is near Taichung station. Easy to take to HSR Taichung to Taoyuan International Airport. One thing is Taichung train maps is very little and abit inconvenient to try to some places. You will need to book Uber.
Hotel staff surprised me with a birthday cake! I am very touched and happy! Besides that, hotel staff were very helpful to my requests too! Free breakfast from 7am to 10am!

I stayed in this hotel this Nov and was very happy with it. It's a walking distance from the train station. Apart from the room is on the smaller side, the rooms including the bathroom are spot less. As soon as we checked in, the lovely staff (Helen Chen who needs a special mention as she was very friendly and helpful while we were there) recommended nice places to go and visit. We had great fun visiting those places. We booked day trips via the hotel, the pick up point for one of them was a little bit of walk from the hotel, when we were on the mini bus, the driver/tour guide got a call from the hotel staff to check if we have been picked up. I left a few charging cables on the table during the day, and the room service staff winded and tied them up neatly for me. The breakfast buffet has a good amount of varieties, the foods are very fresh and services are great. The hotel has free laundry room to use, has nice sitting areas if you want to catch up with friends and drink machines are provided as well for free. There is a kids play room. Surprisingly, the hotel also has a big scale so we can easily check our luggage weight before check out. Thank you CityInn and hope to visit you again in the future.

reviews.text:
“A suitable option for accommodation”
- The location is in the center of taichung, easy to catch bus and a lot of restaurants nearly
- The facilitation of this hotel is overall fine with sufficient stuffs/devices. Only for the laundry, it is a self laundry services using coin. The washing machines seem ok but it takes so long for the drier to dry the clothes
- Some employees are friendly with good English & very supportive (but not all employees are friendly)
- Affordable prices with breakfast option (the breakfast dishes are quite the same day by day but overall they are on average)
2 attached images are the view from my room

This place felt more like a motel than a hotel by American standards. The room was small with very low ceilings, which created a claustrophobic feeling.

Most importantly, the cleaning service was poor. The floors weren't vacuumed, and the bathroom was not properly cleaned. I found hair all over the floor, and facial powder was left in the sink. Furthermore, the kettle had a concerning amount of white, calcified mineral buildup at the bottom.  Obviously, it wasn't cleaned.

This was an unpleasant experience for my first trip to Taichung, and I would not recommend this hotel.

Room is quite small but clean & comfy enough. Location is very strategic, very near to the bus stop & 15 minutes walk to Yizhong night market. Breakfast is good & they have option menu for vegetarian.

This hotel is an extremely perfect choice for you if you are low-budget but still prioritize convenience and walking accessibility. It is very close to Taichung TRA Station & Gancheng Bus Station which is a major transfer point connecting to all places around the city (including Sun Moon Lake), there are also convenience stores, restaurants, outlets and a big park, all with in just 5 minute walking. Nearby night markets are around 7 minute walking
Everything is super clean and modern but the price is surprisingly affordable compared to other accommodations. All staffs are available in English. You are allowed to leave your luggages before checkin and after checkout, please ask the staff for more info

Check in was a little slow, but I cannot complain for the space and price.

Amenities are included; hair dryer, shampoo, body wash, towels. Conditioner is not provided and I used the body wash to wash my hands.

The hotel and the room is a bit nicer than I’m used to 😂. It’s clean, comfortable, and spacious. It’s also next to a bus stop and Taichung train station. Not to be confused with the high speed rail, which is further out.

The other guests staying were pretty polite and quiet overall, but I did notice the noise from the streets was noticeable during the day.

reviews.text: Hotel location is unbeatable. Super accessible in the centre of Taichung and at an unbeatable value too. One complaint I would say is that although checkin is at 4pm on the dot, it does seem like the employees are instructed to not allow early check in. We arrived at the hotel around 2pm hoping for a chance to check in early which is usually allowed at most hotels unless they are still cleaning rooms. We are told by the hotel staff that the rooms are being cleaned and to wait a bit longer. At 3:45 I come back and I’m told the same thing. As soon as 4pm rolls around I walk up again and before I can even ask if any rooms are done being cleaned, I’m told I can self check in at the kiosk along with all of the other guests waiting in the lobby. I really doubt that in 15 minutes all the rooms were miraculously cleaned and ready to go. It almost seems as if they are instructed to not allow early check in, or simply do not care enough to go out of their way to explain to guests why. It would have been more transparent to simply say that they don’t allow early check in. My assumption was that if at 3:45 none of the rooms are done being cleaned, that I would have no chance of checking in at 4pm. A but misleading. The cleanliness of the room was also ok, on par with that of a 3 star hotel, for the price paid I have no complaints.

Worst checkout experience ever. Check in time is 4pm and checkout time is 11am without any consideration even for 1 minute early check in nor checkout later than 1 minute. 2 staff wearing specs on duty on 25 May 2025 during daytime, one male and one female should be terminated from the front desk service and exit hotel industry. Requested for late check out at 10.15am on that day but wasn’t granted even for 30 minutes with the reason one of my friends is a chronic disease patient under special treatment and we needed a bit of time to prepare ourselves. That guy wearing specs asked me to send my friend to the hospital instead of taking 30 minute extra in the room. Both of them asked us to pay NT300 for more 30 minutes late checkout. Sharp at 11am they called to urge for checkout. Every 10 minutes they called to the room whilst we ready and took a bit extra time to prepare for checkout. They even checked on the cctv to make sure we were out. They questioned my friend whom had a surgery but recovering to go to the hospital which I felt very insulting. They even asked for her ID card to make sure she’s the citizen and I was arguing with them that the 30 minute late checkout has nothing to do with taking her ID for verification. My friend was staying with us in the same hotel from 22-24 May whilst we stayed from 20-25 May for 2 bookings. The hotel is not worth for a long stay not just with the way they treated us for not granted that 30 minute of late checkout more so I even brought an extra booking for them since my friend made another new reservation in the same hotel just because to spend some quality times with us due to her sickness. She wasn’t able to return home and stayed the final evening with us with the approval from the night shift lady staff and they even provided extra blanket and bedsheet. These 2 fellars asked us to pay for the extra person on the last evening whilst it wasn’t informed by the night shift staff and the most stupid respond is they didn’t know the night shift granted us the approval for my friend whom checkout out from another booking stayed with us just for 1 evening. This has nothing to do with us with their miscommunication. They checked the cctv throughout to make sure we didn’t lie for what we explained. I’ve never felt so insulted by any hotel service like how GUIDE HOTEL Taichung ZiYou, 承携行旅 had done on 25 May 2025. Both with my friend whom is sick and my friend traveling with me.

The AC never worked properly. During the summer, the lowest can go until 25 degC and upon complaining  they just mentioned it is normal. This is a ridiculous and brainless answer. Middle of the night, the entire main switch panel fallen and cutoff the entire power of the room. Again complained in the next morning but no action was taken, we had to fix ourselves. The housekeeping is the worst ever. Please do not expect cleaning service, they only replenished the towels, tissues and beverage. We have to wash the cups, clean the toilet, basin and table. For the whole week we stayed, never changed nor tidied up the linen nor pillow case. I only appreciate the staff working night shift between 23-24 May 2025 who were accommodating keeping our dried food in the chiller as the minibar in the room is hotter and higher temperatures than the room temperature. Well, everything is normal to them when the minibar and the room were hot. You just need to accept.

My visit to Taiwan was disastrous on our last day which ruined my entire experience. This is the third times and I won’t go Taiwan again because of the Taiwanese hospitality. Both of these hotel staff made a big mistakes in treating the guests. My Taiwanese friend felt so sorry with the situation and certainly ashamed with the hospitality we received on the day we departed from Taiwan.

very spacious room. very strong smell of moisture when opening the room door. was given the room at level 8, got a locked door was told is for Karaoke it made me felt very uneasy throughout the stay (unable to change as hotel was fully booked) no windows as well. i had difficulty with my basin drainage, informed guest service before leaving in the morning, when i returned, issue wasnt solved yet. Tried to call guest service via phone but no one picked up as well, had to go to lobby to seek for assistance. location was friendly, got bus options to various location. breakfast provided have to go to another location.

On arrival we could not check in until 4pm but on check out we had to vacate room by 11am

Outside in the smoking area there were untold amount of cigarette butts which was tidied up when I mentioned this to the staff
Taiwan is promoting itself in Australia but I am afraid they are falling we short

reviews.text:
My mother stayed at this hotel for 5 nights. The full amount for the stay was paid in cash after check-in.

On the plus side, the location is unbeatable, close to the Maple Garden and the expensive Qi-qi area.

Unfortunately, the stay was plagued by some serious problems. The room wasn't in the best condition, as you can see from the pictures, it was very humid, and even the air conditioning didn't help. So I brought my own Panasonic dehumidifier to make the room comfortable to sleep in and get the humidity below 60%.

The biggest problem was that after two nights there was a power cut and the hotel staff turned on some diesel generators in the basement. The worst part was that the carbon monoxide from these generators went up to the second floor and filled the air in the corridor. I got a call from my mum that her room was starting to smell like smoke. My girlfriend and I had to come late in the evening to assess the situation and speak to the management. The receptionist was nice and respectful, but there was nothing she could do about the situation. So we all went up the stairs to the room and had to turn back because of the thick smoke, even the receptionist could not breathe properly. We then tried to find a solution, but turning off the generators was not an option, nor was getting another room as the hotel was apparently fully booked. Basically there was nothing the hotel could do, just let it be, I was shocked. My mum could not stay and sleep in a state like that, with her room filled with smoke, so we took her home and asked for a refund for this crazy trouble. The next day a manager said we could only get 1500NT$ off as compensation but my mum paid more than 12,500NT$ for the whole stay and the manager refused to cancel the other nights or give any more refund.

Because of this terrible customer service we have just booked another hotel (Marriot Fairfield) and will never return to this place. The fear of carbon monoxide poisoning while sleeping is a life threatening situation and absolutely unacceptable and should not be ignored by hotel management.

The hotel staffs were professional and friendly. Convenient location, there were a FamilyMart, many beverage shops and restaurants nearby.
If you drove yourself, the hotel had its own parking lot with plenty of spaces. If it was full, you would need to use a nearby paid parking lot.

They offered snacks and drinks in the refrigerator at no extra charge. There was a capsule coffee machine and a few complimentary pods. The room came with a makeup mirror with great lighting, which was perfect for girls.

From the moment I arrived until the time of my departure, every aspect of my stay exceeded my expectations.
First and foremost, I want to commend your staff for their exceptional hospitality and warmth. From the front desk to housekeeping, every member of your team went above and beyond to ensure that my needs were not only met but exceeded. Their friendliness, attentiveness, and genuine care made me feel welcomed and valued throughout my stay. It's evident that your staff takes great pride in providing exceptional service, and their dedication truly sets your hotel apart.
Furthermore, I was thoroughly impressed by the impeccable cleanliness maintained throughout the hotel. From the lobby to my guest room, every area was spotless and well-maintained. The attention to detail in cleaning and sanitation did not go unnoticed, and it provided me with a sense of comfort and reassurance, especially during these times.

The staff are the most attentive, helpful and friendliest that I have ever met. They even offered to pack us a hot breakfast to go when they found out we had to leave early in the morning.
The hotel rooms are also modern and clean. The next time we are in Taichung, we will definitely book this hotel again.

Loved the bathtub cause I could watch the TV while sitting in the tub 🤭 I also told the hotel that I planned to celebrate my birthday there in advance so they prepared some balloons for me in the room, very sweet! They also gave me a bottle of red wine as a gift which I didn’t expect at all but I really appreciate the gesture. Overall, the hotel is definitely worth staying at. Oh, I also liked the tv cause it was big

There are only 2 things stopping me from giving this hotel the full 5 stars. 1. There is way too much light leaking into the room. They have black out curtains but on the top area so much light comes in it defeats the purpose of having black out curtains. 2. The door closing speed and sound. If this hotel (and all other hotels in Taiwan) can figure out how to have doors that close quietly and securely that would be make it a super special hotel. There must be some way to make it so doors are soft closing and quiet closing. Imagine if the hotel was full and you have all different types of guests and people start opening and closing doors from 6am all the way to check out time and you’re trying to get more sleep because you want to start your day later than others. Well thats not going to happen with these doors. Someone in the hotel industry in Asia needs to figure out how to solve this problem. Whoever solves this issue will become a rich rich person.

reviews.text: Great hotel! My partner and I stayed here for our first time in Kaohsiung (and first time in Taiwan) and I would highly recommend it. We only had one day in the city so we were out and about all day but got a great night’s sleep given Tai Urban Resort’s creature comforts. The walk to the Sanduo MRT was fairly quick and it is easy to get on the LRT as well if you go in the other direction. Staff spoke English so this is a great option if you do not know much Mandarin.

We really enjoyed our stay here at TAI Urban Resort on our last night in Kaohsiung. We had stayed elsewhere prior in Kaohsiung and TAI has a really lovely lobby on the upper level, many many nooks for reading and is architecturally designed very well. The inclusion of taiwanese snacks to enjoy in the tatami area of your room is lovely, as well as high quality amenities like dyson hair dryers and direct access via parking underground. Wish we had spent some more time reading the books and enjoying the different nooks, but maybe next time!

Not a walkable location. They only have limited room for valet but it is not first come first serve, they will turn away guests even when they have space available because they are anticipating a busy night and will tell you to park your own can in the basement instead. The gym is shared with locals who are members and the pool maybe be very windy because it is outdoors so it depends on the weather if you can swim. To get to your room you have to take two separate elevators and the wait is often 5 minutes or more per elevator, which doesn’t seem too long but adds up when you are in a rush. You cannot order food to your door and you have to make the trip to the 25th floor then down to the 1st floor then back to the 25th and then walk to a different set of elevators then go to your floor. Overall it seems you are better off staying a luxury brand nearby for the same price or cheaper.

During our recent stay in Kaohsiung, we had the pleasure of experiencing a new hotel called TAI Urban Resort located conveniently close to Kaohsiung Port and the iconic 85 Sky Tower. The hotel, with its book-themed decor, provided a unique and comforting ambiance that made our stay truly memorable.

From the moment we entered the lobby, we were greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere. The book-themed design was evident throughout the hotel, with cozy reading nooks and literary quotes adorning the walls. This thoughtful decor created a serene environment, perfect for relaxation and unwinding after a day of exploring the city.

Our room was spacious and well-appointed, continuing the book theme with elegant touches that made it feel like a home away from home. The bed was incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep. The room also featured modern amenities.

One of the highlights of our stay was the hotel's infinity pool. Located in the middle of the building, the pool offered breathtaking views of Kaohsiung Port and the 85 Sky Tower. Swimming in the infinity pool while taking in the stunning cityscape was an unforgettable experience. The pool area also had comfortable lounge chairs and a bar, making it an ideal spot to relax and enjoy the view.

Overall, our stay at this new hotel TAI Urban Resort it was exceptional. The combination of the comforting book theme, the amazing atmosphere, and the stunning infinity pool and views made it a standout choice for anyone visiting Kaohsiung. We highly recommend it for a memorable and relaxing stay.

We had a fantastic stay! The hotel’s decor blends literary charm with modern elegance. With its tall glass windows and high floor location, the entire space feels open, stylish, and full of character.

All public facilities are located on the upper floors, allowing guests to enjoy panoramic city views. The infinity pool on the 24th floor was a highlight. lounging by the pool with a breeze and a view was incredibly relaxing.

Our rooms were spacious and beautifully designed. My mom stayed in a Japanese style room with two queen beds and a tatami tea area. It quickly became the go to spot for our family to gather, relax, and enjoy the view together. My husband and I stayed in a king room, which was also large, comfortable, and had an amazing view.

The staff were all friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall warm and pleasant atmosphere. The bookstore on the 7th floor is operated by the hotel itself and reflects its literary theme throughout the space, such a charming touch!

Breakfast buffet was exceptional, the ingredients were fresh and high quality. Each guest was served a portion of cherry duck and a hot spring egg, both absolutely delicious. The coffee was rich and aromatic, one of the best we’ve had at any hotel.

Out of all the hotels we’ve stayed at, this was truly one of the best. Highly recommended!

(25-26th July 25)

For $1,222+$117(for breakfast buffet), it's an excellent value. Spacious room, adequately furnished with 1 task chair 2, lounge chairs, they have everything you need for a hotel room plus 1 pair of washer dryer on 9th and 11th floors with an ice machine in the laundry room, which is a standard provision in the USA but almost never in Taiwan. Several bus lines run right by the hotel and across the road stands the tram or light rail stop, right in front of the municipal hospital.

The rooms are clean and spacious, the service is prompt and helpful, and the hotel is located near lots of easy to access public transportation. Couldn't recommend enough! The staff are also very friendly and helpful!

The total impression is quite good.  We rent a room with bedroom and living room separated, spacious enough for a comfortable period of 7-day quarantine.  The service is excellent in every way. The bed is very comfy, and the room is equipped with almost everything we need.  The housekeeper answered our request always in a timely manner.  The only thing we were not satisfied is the meals.  In first 4 days, we had 4 times chicken leg or chicken drumstick lunch/dinner box, even though they were ordered from different restaurants. We wrote to the housekeeper to suggest to have more varieties of meals, and she/he said to send our suggestion to the persons in charge.  I do appreciate their attitude.  Keep up the good work !  Your effort is not in vain.

We stayed here for three days for our quarantine and had a quite nice stay. The service was excellent and our room was clean and spacious. On the Flip side the air conditioning was quite loud and the pictures while showing our room, made us believe that the interior would be nicer. It possible the use uber eats to get stuff delivered to the hotel. The stuff will bring it up to your room

reviews.text: Overall, an average hotel in need of TLC. The bad: the beds were so soft that when you lie down you fall into the center of the bed. Very uncomfortable. There is a smell from the halls and carpets that smells of dampness or mold. In general it just needs a good deep clean and minor renovation to really be a gem. There is no breakfast but that is reflected in the price. When we arrived there were a group of people all gathered at the front door smoking and we entered with kids it was no a great first impression. The Good: the facilites are decent for a city hotel, books to rent and you can add your own books to the collection, the swimming pool is open nearly all day from 9-9 and if you enjoy an outdoor pool, this isn't bad. The game area for kids is good but again needs a good clean. If the hotel made these changes they could charge slightly more and have better reputation. I probably wouldn't go back to stay there just maybe use the pool.

We got a great price for this place, so expectations were low... however ratings aren't legitimate. Deluxe room is just an average room at best.
Pool had moss growing where the tile grout should be.
Fences falling down and building framing rusted through.
This place is tired and needs a full restoration to live up to the hotel rating it has.   Drop a star level and I would have given this feedback.

We're in Taiwan for 8 weeks in July and August with our 5 and 8 year olds. We decided to stay at this hotel as it offers probably the best kids facilities in all of Taiwan for what it charges all in the same place. Extremely spacious softplay castle with trampoline park, swimming pool, and children's electric car tracks! It's peaceful, not many people, great air-conditioning to keep you cool. I'd definitely come back to this hotel next time and wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone with children.
An inexpensive hotel with an outdoor pool. The room was big with a bathtub. 10min walk to the night market and loads of bars along the way. Parking is easy.

The temperature control did not work. I have stayed in many hotels before, so I have something to compare with. reviews.text: After 6 weeks in Asia and multiple hotels I can say the bed, duvet, pillow, AC combination here was finally perfect for me to sleep all night. 10th floor was quiet. Free decent coffee, squash and snacks. The room was very clean.

Staff were nice. The shower broke on our first night and had no hot water. We informed the staff and the next day there was water. The bathroom lights flicker occasionally, and the hairdryer is not very strong. The bed is soft but the pillow sinks in too much and your body might end up being sore tomorrow. Location is right next to a 7/11 so it’s quite nice.

The Dirtiest Hotel I’ve Ever Stayed At — A Truly Miserable Experience

I’ve traveled extensively, but this hotel was by far the dirtiest I’ve ever encountered. While the facilities themselves seemed relatively new, the lack of basic cleaning was shocking and unacceptable.

What Happened:

Upon checking in, we walked into our room only to find the floor covered in dust and someone else’s hair — everywhere. It looked like the room hadn’t been cleaned at all. I assumed it must have been a mistake and politely asked to be moved to a room that had already been cleaned.

To our dismay, the second room was just as filthy. Dust and hair were scattered all over the room and even the bathroom. I asked the front desk if there was any room that had been properly cleaned. Their answer? “The hotel is fully booked tonight.”

What followed was even more unbelievable. The staff member told me, “If you don’t like how we clean, we can refund you. Feel free to find another hotel.”
It was already 10:00 PM — a time when most travelers are winding down, not scrambling to find alternative lodging after being basically told to leave.

With no other options, we had no choice but to spend the night surrounded by filth. I hardly slept and felt absolutely miserable.

To make matters worse, I developed a dust allergy reaction afterward — sneezing nonstop, with an itchy throat and runny nose for almost a week.
This hotel not only failed to provide a basic level of cleanliness, but it also caused a serious health issue.

I will never stay here again, and I strongly recommend that others avoid this hotel entirely.

I stayed at the Royal Fine Hotel in Kaohsiung to relax and recharge, and it definitely served that purpose. The bed was extremely comfortable, the room was spacious, and the bathroom had all the amenities I needed. The location was convenient for exploring the city, and the price felt like great value for a modern, well-kept hotel.

While the staff were fairly friendly and helped with recommendations, they could be a bit more welcoming. It would have been nice if they acknowledged guests more often as they came and went. However, overall, this was a pleasant and comfortable stay that was worth the money.
A standard, basic hotel room, ok for a night or two. Kettle and small fridge with complimentary tea and coffee. Efficient check-in and checkout. Easy walk to Liuhe Night Market.

I paid $60 usd  per night to stay in the deluxe double room for my stay in September. I was surprised with how luxurious the bathroom was. The space had clearly been recently renovated and had a separate shower and bathtub.

Bed was large and comfortable enough.
I also used the laundry machine for $40 TND per load. Machine works so that's good 👍

If you want to pay more you can probably get something better down the street but if you're on a budget then I would stay here.
Great centralized location. Check in was so fast and easy! Lovely room and kind staff.

I liked it a lot. I got the cheapest room (no towel or toiletries, but I have my own with me; no window), it was a good deal. 7/11 very close. Washer and dryer downstairs $40 each (free detergent). reviews.text:

They offer to play Nintendo Switch, football table and free pop corn.
Location is great. 10min walk to Formosa boulevard, from where you can go everywhere. Famous Night Market 5min walking.

Would totally recommend this Hotel!

Wow! We can honestly say that the Legend Hotel in Kaohsiung was one of the best places our family of five has ever stayed. If you are a family traveling with children, stop looking and just book this hotel. It's that good.

From the moment you walk in, you can see how special this place is. The hotel is stunningly designed with a cool, modern, and fun vibe. Our kids (ages 9, 7, and 4) immediately fell in love with our room and had the best time just exploring the different floors to see all the unique decorations. The hotel itself felt like part of the adventure!

The staff's attitude is simply amazing – every single person was warm, helpful, and went out of their way to make us feel welcome. And then there's the lobby. It's gorgeous, and it's a paradise for kids and adults alike. They offer complimentary popcorn coffee, and drinks 24/7. The kids were in heaven, and it was such a wonderful and generous touch that made us feel truly taken care of.

On top of all the fun, the hotel is incredibly practical. The Wi-Fi is excellent and fast. Having a supermarket right below the hotel and a dedicated hotel parking lot made our stay completely seamless and stress-free. The location is an absolute 10/10 – you are right next to the famous Liuhe Night Market and just a short walk from the Formosa Boulevard MRT station, making it the perfect base to explore everything Kaohsiung has to offer.

We cannot recommend Legend Hotel Liuhe highly enough. It made our trip to Kaohsiung absolutely memorable. We're already trying to find an excuse to come back!

Excellent! Convenient location and very friendly staff! Great place with kids too!
Can do your laundry for free as well if needed.

A good hotel even for a long stay. Good value for money. The rooms are clean and big. They have a separate laundry room and a play area for kids as well. Have a 300m walk to the metro station. The front desk is very supportive. The interior wall art is very pretty. Closer to the night market.

reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights. The room is big and clean. The soundproof is good. I do enjoy staying in the room. The 2 morning breakfast serve are cold, hope it can improve. All the lady receptionists are not friendly and they do not greet guests. Do not feel welcome at all. Hope it service standard can improve.
Weak sound proof. Terrible family with kids made noise. And, I can hear the noise clearly in my room. Smells from bathroom. The hotel provide gift if guest give 5 stars in their review....

The hotel is located central to many restaurants, retail, parks, waterfront piers, and a night market.  Very walkable location.  The hotel is very clean with comfortable beds. The breakfast is wonderful with a nice selection of foods!  I rated the hotel a 4 star because the music was always so loud in the reception and breakfast area that you could not carry on a conversation.   I wasn't able to hear the desk clerk asking me questions at check-in due to the music being loud.  It definitely impacted the breakfast area. Also, I am allergic to feathers, and they only had feather pillows, no other choice, which caused some health issues for me during my stay.

The TV was great and the hotel was value for money, you don't have high expectations when you pay so cheap, compared to Taipei city.

We didn't like the location (very dirty), the view (almost scary) and the breakfast (we preferred buying food from 7/11 nearby).

Simple, clean and well organised hotel. Excellent breakfast ( Taiwan style- dont expect Western!!!). Well positioned in downtown Kaohsuing. Lots of local good food outlets nearby, and 10-15 minutes walk from a main MRT line. Would we go back? Most certainly.

reviews.text: Clean with good WIFI. An older hotel in a safe area to walk in but not much to visit. Main train station is a short walk. The fast train to Taipei is about a half hour away.

Terrible hotel. Awful service. Room smelled of stale cigarette smoke. We arrived 1 hour early, they charged us an extra 300 NTD to check in, even though the room was ready.
Bed was a very soft mattress. The 2 pillows were foam. We asked for 2 extra pillows - we were charged 100NTD per pillow. Disgusting service. Unnecessary money-grabbing in my opinion.
The breakfast was barely edible. Honestly, the worst hotel breakfast I've ever tried to eat. No western options at all.
The location of this hotel is the only redeeming quality and selling point. But there are hundreds of hotels in this area. DON'T choose this one.

Our two bedroom room was large with king sized beds. The bathroom was especially big, having two sinks and a shower, in addition to the two person jacuzzi.
The room and furnishings were in good condition, the exceptions being the two worn chairs and the musty smell we noticed upon entering the room. After that initial impression we weren't further bothered by the smell, so keeping the windows open must have cleared it out for the most part.
The air condition was quite good, a must in the Taiwan summer heat.
The view was a not too busy Kaohsiung back alley. Not too pretty, but charming with the going about of the locals. Unfortunately the day time back alley smells and night time mosquitoes meant the windows needed to be kept closed more often then we'd have preferred. Lucky the air conditioning was good!
The jacuzzi was very enjoyable, outfitted with a TV. The shower had good pressure. The beds were comfortable and also had a TV setup.
The hotel staff were friendly and helpful. The food they provided did the job, but wasn't nearly the best Taiwan has to offer.
We were doing a ten night quarantine stay with our three year old and didn't go too crazy, so that says alot by itself.
The hotel definitely needs a renovation but the service from the concierge was very great. The hotel is near the Kaohsiung Metro Station.
Convenient location, located close to the station and there is a large bath tub. The rooms were quite big and reception service was nice, free snacks were provided.

reviews.text:
This is a lovely hotel located right in front of Kaohsiung Station. The staffs are so friendly and accommodating. Loved the QR-based transactions for checking in and out, as well as generating combination codes for the keyless door. Appreciate the thoughful innovation as we definitely crossed misplacing the keycards off our minds.

Our room is at the 8F. The hallway is narrow but usually empty; although there are other guests in the other rooms, we rarely walk in together in the hallway. Separate room door for toilet and shower, so we can really thoughtfully utilize the usage. Staff does daily cleaning and provides fresh towel.

I will consider booking this again in my next trip to KHH.

Booked this hotel because it was so close to the train station and I walked by it the times I was in Taiwan. I loved the decor and the bed was very comfortable. The room I stayed in, the bathroom had no dry/wet separation so all my stuff got wet after my shower. From reading other reviews, apparently there are rooms that have the dry/wet separation, I just didn’t book the right one appropriately. It also does not have a mirror in the bathroom so I had to put my contacts on in front of one of the mirrors in the bedroom. This is the first time I encountered these issues in Taiwan. I couldn't get my tv to work when I first got into the room but they fixed the issue while I was out of the room so it was no biggie. The walls are pretty thin. I could hear my neighbor next door so I was sure he was able to hear me in my room. I didn’t like seeing earplugs on the nightstand because that meant noise. There wasn’t much noise when I went to bed but I put them on anyway just in case. Banging from upstairs around 3:30 woke me up from sleep along with conversation in the hallway kept me up. You can hear all kinds of loud noises from outside the room and downstairs in the morning while I was still trying to sleep. I can hear this all while wearing earplugs. Like most people have mentioned in their reviews, the soundproofing is quite bad. There doesn’t seem to be any kind of real improvement going on regarding it, only the earplugs which is just a temporary fix. I needed to extend my stay but decided to book somewhere else.

The best hotel to stay at in Kaoshiung, especially as it is just 2 min walk away from the main station there. Hotel looks modern and very chic. Rooms are well sized and appreciate the separate bathroom and shower sections. Staff were so friendly.

Absolutely liked everything about this hotel. From delicious snacks in the lobby, the interior design to spacious room, especially friendly and helpful front desk staff and great location, everything exceeded my expectations.Thank you, will visit again soon.

The hotel is perfectly located, just a few minutes walking from the central station and shopping area. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. Breakfast is not a buffet style but a prepared taiwanese style breakfast which is delicious and absolutely worth the 200TD.

reviews.text: Best place to stay! People here are way to nice, very clean, very comfortable. We loved it! Look for Lala Yin, she's the best!

Location:
I wanted a hotel where I could nap at any time without hearing the hustle and bustle of city life. This place fits the bill perfectly—it’s not next to an MRT station or a night market, so it’s quiet.

A bus stop just a minute away connects you to the MRT and the rest of Kaohsiung with no more than one transfer.

The area feels very safe, with two police stations within a 5-minute walk.

PX Mart is also 5 minutes away for any essentials or forgotten items.

The LRT to Dream Mall and also both Gushan Ferrys are easily accessible.

Google Maps shows plenty of public transit options, and Uber wait times are consistently under 5 minutes.

Amenities:
This is the kind of hotel that doesn’t nickel-and-dime you.

Complimentary bottled water (and sometimes tea and drinks at the front desk) is a nice touch.

The bidet with a heated seat was a must-have—and they delivered.

The basic gym has four types of cardio machines and a weight pulley system up to 150+ lbs.

On the rooftop, there are coin-operated washers, a detergent dispenser, and dryers, with clear instructions in both English and Chinese.

Breakfast options include both buffet and personalized meals, and the staff even customized a very specific health-conscious, religious-friendly meal for us.

Service:
Outstanding. The staff are multilingual, always warm, and extremely accommodating. They went above and beyond—whether it was adjusting meals for the pickiest eater or honoring eco-friendly room cleaning requests. They even kept a full notepad of our very specific preferences and still served us with a smile.

TL;DR: Exceptional service, quiet location, thoughtful amenities. I’d definitely stay here again.

A decent hotel. One confusing policy -
The gym opens only at 10:00, but breakfast is served 7:00-9:30. And checkout is at 11:00… which makes the gym practically useless. I tried to ask them to open it earlier, but in a typical Chinese style, they are extremely inflexible.

It is clean and quiet hotel with comfortable rooms and very kind team at the reception desk. Localisation is approx 20 minuts walk to the metro station. District was not super elegant, but I felt safe in streets.

This is my 2nd time staying at Kaohsiung A Hotel and so fortunate that I got a big room in the corner... It has bath tub which I need to make my body relax. Since it is in the corner, of course the space is big and no doubt for it cleanliness. The staff were helpful with my requests. Breakfast is OK, a lot of things to be chosen. The area is not a busy area but for me is ok, since I have busy day time. So, I need to rest at night... They have coffee shop in lobby area which I didnt have time to try... Hopefully when I go to Kaoshiung again and will stay here again, I will try their coffee...

The room quite spacious .but the noise insulation not very good. So we can hear noise during nightime.
The breakfast is simple and quite ok..

The room was spacious enough to fit 3–4 people, clean, and located in a quiet area. We’d definitely stay here again the next time we visit Kaohsiung!

I was happy during the stay.

The room was spacious and clean, facilities are new, the bed is comfy, and staffs are very friendly. There will be no water bottle, but they place water dispencer on each floor.

I booked 1 double bed room but got upgraded to a 2 double bed room with window.

reviews.text: The water drain in the shower is pretty clogged. Water doesn’t go down as quickly. And when I changed to another room, similar problem happened. By the second time I asked to change rooms, I was asked not to test the drainage before moving in. Bad service and bad facilities.

It's cheap. That's it. Zero services and zero service offered. There is a 7/11 right next door so there's that. Parking is very close as well for about $3 per turn. It's in the heart of downtown Kaohsiung do there's places to eat everywhere
There are bed bugs in the room. Absolutely disgusting. I don’t think the whole hotel is clean. Don’t stay in this hotel unless you want to get bitten.

Bring ear plugs. Bring an eye mask. You’ll sleep better. The room is cramped but comfortable. The water pressure is strong. The WiFi is excellent. The problem is there is no insulation for the sound of other guests coming and going. The room doors essentially slam shut. The cleaning staff in the morning are also unintentionally noisy (carts and plastic wrappers). Unless you expect to be up by 6:30/7:00 in the morning, bring ear plugs.
Bring an eye mask as even my “windowless” room had a bathroom window with a curtain that wasn’t sufficiently dark, and the lights from various electronic devices in the room such as TV and WiFi created enough light to see well by once my eyes adjusted.
On the plus side, the staff was very friendly and helpful. The amenities were also excellent. It was not a bad place to stay, very basic but comfortable enough. That said: ear plugs and eye masks are a must for a good night sleep.

family friendly and cosy rooms, restaurants are good but there’s one experience that i felt bad was halfway to finishing our breakfast the air conditioning suddenly blew hard and i started to get allergic. i keep on sneezing that i hurriedly left. inconvenience to others eating hearing someone sneezing repeatedly 😞

Stay here for 2 days ,
Front desk was cooperative,
In-house restaurant available with Chinese and European food manu on different floor, eat lunch and dinner here for one day most item was same for both time but fresh made.
Food not available for late arrival,
Located in the middle of town.
Good to stay here

The hotel is a little old. Not very close to any MRT( metro station). The closest one is about 17 mins walk from the hotel. People in the hotel are very kind and friendly. reviews.text: Very good location, a 5 to 8 minute walk to the Formosa Boulevard Station (depending on the entrance). The building is old and is shared among different airbnbs, thus using a common elevator. The place is fairly clean, but we did see a cockroach in the balcony. The owner is great, straightforward and very generous. They provide free snacks (cookies, instant noodles, fruits, steamed buns, etc.)  and drinks for guests, which my sister and I were very grateful for. Will stay here again in a heartbeat.

Room very spacious. We're a family of 3 and there's plenty of room for us and our luggages. Rapid service and friendly staff. We booked after seeing all the excellent reviews. Free fruits and drinks available. There's even a washing machine available for use. What more do we need right? Very happy 😁

Very friendly staffs, location and service are great. Room is abit old and there are a lot of insects though. Free drinks and finger food are provided which is good. Might be noisy at times as the rooms are near the living area

I'd give this 3.5 if I could. It worked well for my purpose, but I can't say it was as good as the reviews said. The location is excellent, close to the metro and local train station, the free food and drinks are great (unlimited free water, and trying a bunch of different drinks was great), and the price was quite reasonable which played a big part in my rating.

However while the important things were clean, like the sheets and sinks, the shelves were dusty, and the room was very rundown, including black scrape marks on the floor, cracked walls, and a bathroom door that wouldn't stay shut. After telling the owner he came right away and spent a good 5-10 minutes trying to fix it but couldn't, so I had to put a small stopper every time I used the bathroom which obviously isn't ideal.

On top of that, the soundproofing is quite poor. I appreciated the decibel meter, and with earplugs I had no problem sleeping, but if the room beside you multiple people you'll definitely hear them talking. For a few days, and for a cheap and good location, it worked for me,

Better than a 5 star hotel! This place is absolutely amazing. They give out free food and drinks (many many choices available for drinks and foods), free use of laundry machine, and an everyday refill of disposable amenities. The owner and staff are friendly and the location is perfectly situated near convenience stores, pharmacies, night markets, and train stations. Will definitely stay here again once back in Kaohsiung.

Oh, you can listen to music with loud speaker provided in the room also.

It was my first time visiting Kaohsiung, and I’m really glad I chose CU Hotel. The location is excellent—very close to the MRT station, which made getting around the city super convenient. The hotel looks modern, clean, and well-maintained. For the price, it’s definitely great value for money. I had a comfortable stay and would absolutely stay here again next time!

I really enjoyed my stay. The hotel was extremely close to the the train and mrt stations. I somehow botched the self check-in but the reception was able to help me with getting it sorted. My room was spacious and the bed was so comfortable. There was minimal noise. The only time you can really hear people is when you are out in the hallway. I was able to plug all my devices into the headboard plus other places around the room. They have everything I needed, even the hand soap at the sink which almost every hotel has gotten rid of but should have so kudos!! They have the brand of tea I drink so even better! Love the washer/dryer amenity. The only thing I can think of that can make the place better is to have more washers and dryers so people don't have to wait. I will definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Kaohsiung.

Decent sized rooms, hotel situated within walking distance of Kaohsiung metro and train station as well as night market at Formosa boulevard. - good location if you are coming in via TRA train, no need for transfers within metro.

reviews.text:
Absolutely the Worst Hotel Experience in Taiwan
❌ Absurd Check-In/Out Time Policy—Feels Like a Scam
Despite paying for a single night, the hotel only permitted me to stay for less than 18 hours. Check-in is strictly at 4:00 PM, and check-out is at 11:00 AM. That’s completely unreasonable for any hotel, especially when you consider most international travelers arrive earlier. I was exhausted and asked to check in slightly earlier due to health reasons, but they refused—even though the lobby was empty and my room was likely ready.

❌ Zero Empathy, Cold Staff, No Flexibility
I explained that I’m a foreign traveler recovering from thyroid cancer, struggling with fatigue and hormonal imbalance. I arrived early because I had to check out from student housing, and had nowhere else to go. Still, the hotel showed no compassion or basic hospitality. The hotel only permitted me to sit in the lobby for hours, offering no support or assistance.

❌ Unhygienic Facilities—Dirty Shared Toilet
The shared restroom on the first floor smelled absolutely awful. It was dirty, poorly maintained, and simply unacceptable for a hotel claiming to be 3-star standard.

❌ Not Worth the Money at All
For the price I paid, I expected at least a clean, professional space and decent customer service. Instead, I received the worst service I’ve experienced in my entire stay in Taiwan.

⚠️ Final Verdict: NEVER AGAIN. HIGHLY NOT RECOMMENDED.
Avoid this place if you are an international traveler, a solo female traveler, or someone with health issues. There are better, kinder, and more professional hotels even at a lower price.

The hotel is located 10mins away from LRT, it’s quite far especially you carrying a big luggage.
Unfortunately, the room is little bit dirty with stain on wall and there’s a lot of mosquito.
The air cond is not cold enough since it is using centralised system for the whole buildings.

Small rooms but they make it up with all amenities. Everything u need is provided. Neat and clean room. We had the river view from the window which was a beautiful sight to wake up too. We walked around easily to cafes, restaurants and bus stand. Overall satisfactory stay
Nothing too special to say here, ok hotel in a good location. Was good for 2 nights
The room is old and full of mold, and it was not very clean. The bathroom is specially old and dirty.

The breakfast here is an Asian style breakfast - so be ready for that. There is a lot of dishes to choose from. So we did enjoy the steamed buns, and the included opportunity to get a more region-traditional breakfast.
Free snacks on the 1st floor are amazing! Convenient location, friendly staffs. Many restaurants, some night markets near by. We loved the view from the room.
Despite I experienced even a typhoon during my stay and reached a country a bit hard to get to, in overall my stay in this hotel was pleasant and nice. Memorable.

Recently I stayed in this property for two nights with family and an infant. The staff are really polite and understanding. The room is big and comfortable.
Highly recommended. I will prefer this hotel whenever I visit Kaohsiung in the near future.

reviews.text:
The receptionist wasn't friendly and didn't speak English. I arrived at 2:45 pm, and she informed me that check-in was at 4 pm. I waited in the resting area, but there was no WiFi in that corner.

Two other couples arrived after me and received their rooms before mine. I waited for 45 minutes, and the room was still not ready. I waited until 3:50 pm when she finally gave me the room key.

I had booked a double room but received a Quadruple Room, which left half of the room space unusable. The bathroom had a bathtub but no curtain, causing the entire bathroom to get wet after a shower. The towels were old and torn. I was surprised that they provided such towels to customers.

The only positive aspect was the location, as it was very close to the BTS Formosa Boulevard Station. However, there were very long stairways to Exit 11 for the hotel. With a big suitcase, I had to use the lift at Exit 9, which required an additional 100 meters of walking.

Before checking in, I received a message from the hotel asking for a 10/10 review, which I found inappropriate. After this experience, I cannot give them a 10/10 rating. They would only deserve a 2 stars.
lovation is very near the night market and room is clean . love the bath tub

Cozy and comfy stay near the Liou He Night Market.

We enjoyed two days and two nights of staycation and food here.

Will come back again in the future.

Traveling with my family, including two young children, and we woke up on the second day to the heavy smell of someone smoking. Totally unacceptable.

If you keep your expectations low, this might have been okay. Not the cleanest, no features worth speaking of, but the lack of enforcement on the no smoking policy is a dealbreaker for sure. When we raised the issue with the front desk, the attendant came in and said he didn't smell any smoke and gave us the runaround. "No smoking" sign has no meaning here.

This hotel has no-smoking signs displayed everywhere inside the hotel. If someone was smoking in their room, Smell of smoke was so bad and you will not be able to stand for it. The hotel service personnel will just open the alley door and use a big fan to blow it.

reviews.text: The guy at the front office speaks English very well. He was friendly and helpful. We booked a non-smoking room, but it smelled very heavily. He gave us directly another room and apologized. This room had a light smell, but it was acceptable. The size of the room is small, but enough for two. It was clean. Our room was located at the end of the corridor, so it was quiet. Not very soundproof, but luckily the other guests were quiet. Only one big towel provided and a small disposable towel and some amenities. The bed was comfortable (to European standards, not too hard), but the double bed has two single mattresses, which was a bit annoying in the middle. AC worked well, but you can't control the temperature, only the wind speed. For me it was OK, but some might find it too cold. The shower didn't had a curtain. Location is very convenient and the free parking was just across the street.

Great deal a luxury stay for the budget traveler. Nice breakfast that was different for both days we were here. Typical Chinese breakfast cooked vegetable and protein dishes, fresh greens, rice porridge, and toast. No real western options. Room was nice enough although a few attention to details. Our queen bed as two twins pushed together, less than classy. No light switch near the bed made getting to bed an adventure. Wall paper and floors slightly peeling and could be a bit cleaner. Other wise a great stay with friendly english speaking staff.

The place is really small, the outlet is on the middle of the bed which makes it quite difficult to sleep while charging. Around midnight, there were guys partying in the other room making loud noises. Also, one time we ordered KFC delivery to the hotel and the sticker was ripped as if it was opened, unlike other times. I think the male employee on the reception just decided to open and see what's inside the bag because he wasn't so pleasant when we first checked into the hotel either.
The staff are friendly and helpful. Location was nice, very near with night market. There got their own parking lot but not included. Selection given when booking.
Very good hotel with friendly staff and delicious breakfast. Room was clean and the location is near Liuhe Night Market. Also close to the subway station, which makes going around very convenient.

reviews.text:
What a comfortable hotel to stay at in Kaohsiung! We only needed it for one night, but the hotel is comfortable enough for an extended stay as well. The hotel lobby is located on the 11th floor of the building, which seemed unusual at first, but it felt completely safe. Our room was spacious and offered a great view of the city, even from the bathroom. The soundproofing was decent, which was important for me as a light sleeper.

The amenities included complimentary ice cream, snacks, tea, and water. There was a small conference room set up as a fitness center, but we didn’t have time to use it. The complimentary breakfast buffet offered a variety of delicious options, including hot items, salad, and congee. Overall, it was a great value for our stay!

It is also located along the red line MRT, which easily connects you go the airport or the HSR!

The hotel’s room really spacious and located convenient - few mins walk to train station, 7-11 and supermarkets. But can hear the noice from next rooms.
Good service n worth for the price. Recommended!

Heyyyy :3 Thank u so much for my wonderful stay! I stayed in the Hub Hotel for 3 days and it was amazing. I was specifically looking for a hotel where I can rest and enjoy holidays and the hub hotel was the best choice ❣️🥰❣️ I love the big choice of delicious breakfast and the cute mini gym with the massage chair! I could stay there the whole day :D and there is free ice cream!!!!!! Uhhhhh thank u so much for the most comfortable bed, I had the best sleep and I loved my room💕 thank u dear staff and dear hub hotel. I can only recommend it with 5 🌟. ❤️❤️❤️

On this month-long trip to Asia, I have been fortunate to stay at five 5* hotels. While Hub Hotel isn't in this category, the beautiful room took me by surprise and easily became my second favorite hotel of this entire trip!

For its price, the room (I sprang for the Exquisite room) is spacious, well-designed with plenty of natural lighting (I got lucky with a corner unit facing the funky, cool shaped Kaohsiung Port Cruise Terminal), has a washlet! and I LOVE the restroom and shower tiles, was equipped with a 55" Google TV and its preloaded movies, casting capabilities and general TV that made for great entertainment, while the location is stellar (only a 3 mins walk from the R8 station -- take exit 1... don't listen to Google Maps' instruction 😅) and can't go wrong with included breakfast + 24h snax in the lobby and wonderful service from the entire staff. It made working from this hotel for the past five days so delightful.

The only downside is that Hub Hotel is on the 11th floor of a building that is shared with 5 other "hotels" on other floors and businesses so the elevator is almost always in use, though there are 5 lifts that move quickly.

Will even consider other Hub Hotel locations when I'm back in Taiwan next year!

Nice staff, good service

Spacious room, excellent amenities

- instant coffee, tea bag, bottles of water in room (can be refilled)
- 24hrs of coffee (americano, latte and mocha etc) and ice cream available in common area
- tiny gym room
- outdoor garden with washing machine and drying machine at the corner (TWD30 for each, ~1hr for washing and ~0.5hr for drying)

reviews.text:
I can tell you everything that I look for in a hotel is exceeded - I would definitely recommend and anytime I'm coming back to this city i would plan on staying here again
Excellent service - a wonderful clean quiet room with good working g wifi and Aircon  🇨🇦❤️🇹🇼🌍😀

Decent location, service was quick and adaptable due to an error (not their fault), rooms were clean and comfortable. Relatively modern. Breakfast buffet was worth it - good variety and tasty. 24hr free snack bar and a place sit and eat your night market food! Liuhe night market is less than a 10 min walk away and the MRT is fairly close as well.

Hub Hotel Cisian Branch was a great stay.

First of all, the rooms were really nice quality with a Japanese style toilet, really nice breakfast included, a 24/7 ice cream/ tea/ coffee/ snack bar + a great sitting area to wind down, elevator, and a beautiful hotel design. It was definetely reasonably priced for the time that we got it which was a few days before the trip.

Secondly, the location was great. It's a 5-7 minute walk from the Liouhe Night Market and next door to a Poya and hotpot restaurant. The place has a lot of YouBikes, including one right in front of it. It took only 12-15 minutes to bike to Pier 2/ the Ferry Station to go to Cijin Island.

Finally, the staff was great and super understanding. My husband slept really well but for some reason, I couldn't sleep well the first night due to some electrical sound. I asked the staff about it the next night and the on duty staff helped me to check the room and helped fix the problem.I was extremely grateful considering I was exhausted that day and just wanted a smooth sleep. I slept well the next night- I wish I had asked earlier!

I didn't ride the bus from the local Kaohsiung sites to the hotel but it was definetely bus accessible. There's a bus that goes from the hotel to most of the touristy places. Would recommend to come!

We had the best experience at Hub Hotel! The room including the bathroom was tidy and clean which came with a smart toilet! We had free breakfast and menu changes daily. It was complete from the main dish, appetizers, cereals, coffee, tea, and even hot milk tea. The salad and soup are my favorites! Unlimited ice cream, coffee, tea, and snacks were available 24/7. The staff were very accomodating and nice. Toiletries were always refilled. The blower had cold air! We were able to watch Netflix on the TV. The hotel is just a bit far from the station but can be walked. It was also near Liuhe Night Market so we were able to go there! There were so many convenience stores nearby too. When we were leaving, the staff also booked us a cab to the airport. Overall, I’d rate it 100/10! This should be a 5-star hotel. I’ll definitely book here again if I return to Kaohsiung!

Superior Double Room

Spacious enough. Free unlimited ice cream and coffee for 24 hours in their cafeteria. Which is great if you just want to chill out.

Rooms are also great value for money. They provided earplugs incase of noise at night but during our stay it is quiet.

A bit walking distance to the Cianjin station.

reviews.text:
Whatever you do, DO NOT GO IN THIS HOTEL. I NEVER saw a hotel this FILTHY : the bedsheets had brown (!!!) and grey spots EVERYWHERE, the ground was oily and full of unidentified drops, the nightstands and the desk had spots of the predecessor clients, and we found toothpaste in the shower. Everything looked like it had NOT BEEN CLEAN after the last client. We even tried another room and it was THE SAME !!!

According to other reviews, we are not the first to remark the lack of hygiene of this place.
YOU CAN FIND WAY BETTER FOR WAY CHEAPER ELSEWHERE. This place is not worth neither your time, your money, or a night of your sleep.

Here is what happen :
When we arrived in the room, we first notice a large area where the ground was oily, near the coffee table area (I did not take picture of that). As oily as I could not set down my foot without sliding. We called the reception, and they came immediately cleaning, admitting that this was not okay.

But that’s when we started to take a closer look, and there were many spots, traces of drops of something, as well as other oily areas. I even found a spot of toothpaste in the shower, and the shower pipes where not clean either. And on the nightstands and desk, there were traces of something non determined, clearly a sign that IT HAS NOT BEEN CLEANED after the last guests.

But the WORST was when I went to bed, and I saw many grey traces and spots ON THE BEDSHEETS. That was the last straw.

We asked to change rooms, and the staff gave us another key very quickly, without discussion, almost as if they were used to this kind of complaint. Unfortunately, the second room was no better. The EXACT SAME PROBLEM were there: stained sheets, dirty shower, greasy floors. Even though this “upgrade” meant we had more beds, I felt completely UNCOMFORTABLE and UNSAFE staying there. If it hadn’t already been 1 a.m., I would have LEFT immediately.

The next day, I asked the hotel for a commercial gesture considering the state of the rooms. Their only answer was to propose an upgrade for my “next stay.” But there will never be a next stay, and I strongly advise not for you either.

15 August 2025. Housekeeper needs to check the side of the toilet bowl. Mirrors need to wipe. And the business rooms have a strong musty, old wood or moldy smell. Some of the corridors also have this smell. Reception staff have changed & they are all very professional, polite and more efficient now.

Here is my review . I got this booking. From the website from booking.com and they provide me a free room upgrade to an executive suite which surprised me.

The room is big and spacious ,  got the bathtub and take a good hot bath. And the tv have many channels to see.

The location is near Kaohsiung Train Station and have quite a variety of choice for public transport, and it is a walking distance to Liuhe night market who will like to drop by there to have a bite.

It is also a walking distance to a 7-11 which is convenient for people who like to make a small purchase for essential.

They even provide a gym and breakfast buffet for people who like to eat at hotel.

What I didn't like is,
1. The breakfast choice is limited and there is not much selection available for people to choose.
2. The gym facilities is kind of rundown and the treadmill seem to be not able to run safely due to the unstable track.
3. The gym opening hour is 9.30am to 9pm which is kinda of odd as usually people prefer to gym in the morning before breakfast when we are travelling.
4.  Unwilling service, we request a late checkout for 15 mins but the staff ask if late checkout must pay another 800ntd for an hour extension  and the price is ridiculously high.

I paid extra for the double room with an extra sofa to watch tv on and was pleased with the spacious interior. Attaching a picture of the floor plan.

No issues with the cleanliness, although I thought the towels felt damp on the first use. After several more uses, I still found them feeling cold and damp, hence I concluded it is not actually damp, but it is the material of the towel that causes it to feel that way.

Lift is veeeeery slow.

Janitors tended to be a little noisy while cleaning the adjacent rooms, but nothing major.

Rooom is tiny. I traveled with group, 8 rooms 3-5 Mar 2025. Right after receiving room, one room found an underwear on the bed, under the blanket. One room found socks.
Location is near night market and MRT

reviews.text:
The hotel is quite run down. The carpet in the room is all dusty and full of stains. The wallpaper was partially coming off the wall in our room. The room itself an bathroom are spacious, not however well maintained. The rooms are also badly soundproofed and did smelled old maybe even like a former smoking room.
A plus were the free snacks you can get at a snack counter in the lobby.

Hotel advertises to have free parking and breakfast (something really important for me). However, you will just get a distant parking space (8 min away by walking) and a 7-11 coupon of 100 NTD for breakfast ! Didn’t receive welcoming drink as others said. Room was clean but smelt a bit like smoking. View was bad. The AC was nice and strong. Price was fair.

It’s alright. The room smelled a lot like mildew but other than that it wasn’t too bad for the price. What I found weird is them charging you a deposit if you want an extra key. We booked a room for two people so we expected to have two keys but they only gave us one and we had to give them a deposit of 200 ntd for the second card key. The deposit was returned but still.. it kind of ruined our impression of the hotel a little. They do offer complimentary drinks that we didn’t get to try sadly and they have free snacks in the lobby which is nice.

We stayed one night here.
The experience is fine, we are happy with welcome snack and complimentary beverages. Just one thing needs maintaining immediately, the switch in room 609 is tricky and kind of failed, it turned failing again even after it got temporarily fixed.
Overall the staying is satisfying.

We stayed here for one night back in November. There were 4 of us in the group and we basically came over to experience and enjoy the Saffa festival on Cijin beach. We arrived for check in after 12pm and I have to say, I was a little disappointed at how we were greeted by the woman at the front desk. She didn’t even say hello and went right down to business. We were told that we couldn’t check in until 2 or 3pm. We asked if we could just put our bags in the room because we would be returning late due to the festival celebrations but we were denied that. Then we asked if we could have some water but the receptionist said we would need to pay for the water. So we paid. The receptionist just seemed unfriendly. I think she said her name was Maggie. The location of this hotel isn’t the best as it’s a bit of a walk to the nearest station. The room itself was nice and clean and quite big which was nice since we were a big group. They have some free snacks in the reception which was a nice touch since we came back just after midnight and fancied some snacks.
